article_content: Just after President John F. Kennedy was shot while his motorcade moved through downtown Dallas, Associated Press reporter Peggy Simpson dashed to the scene. She closely followed the police officers heading to the building from where the shots were fired, staying nearby to collect information and promptly reporting updates to her editors. At 84 years old, Simpson is one of the last remaining firsthand witnesses sharing their memories as the 60th anniversary of the assassination is marked. Stephen Fagin, the curator at The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza, emphasizes how critical and rare these direct witness accounts have become. Many original voices are gone, making these oral histories precious links to history. Simpson, retired Secret Service Agent Clint Hill, and others are featured in National Geographic’s new three-part series 'JFK: One Day in America.' The series merges their stories with rarely-seen archival film—some of it newly colorized—to enrich the historic narrative. According to director Ella Wright, these personal stories offer deep emotional insight into that period. Dealey Plaza, the site of the shooting, draws visitors who want to understand its historical meaning. Fagin believes the assassination dramatically shaped American society in the 1960s, marking a major cultural turning point. President Joe Biden, who was a college student at the time, remembered spending that day with his classmates, glued to the news. He referenced Kennedy’s enduring optimism for America, urging people to carry on his work. On November 22, 1963, Simpson’s original assignment was an evening fundraiser for Kennedy in Austin. With time before her departure from Dallas, she went to watch the president’s motorcade (not at Dealey Plaza). She only discovered the shooting after arriving at The Dallas Times Herald’s office, where she overheard staff discussing the breaking news. Simpson rushed to see the AP bureau chief send out the global update, then raced to the Texas School Book Depository to gather more details. At police headquarters later, Simpson described the hectic scene—Oswald’s rifle was shown to reporters, chaotic crowds filled the halls, and Oswald himself faced reporters’ questions. Two days later, while reporting on Oswald’s jail transfer, Simpson saw nightclub owner Jack Ruby shoot Oswald. She quickly called her editors with a live account, focused entirely on recounting what she witnessed. Simpson’s accounts now contribute to an oral history archive at The Sixth Floor Museum, which holds roughly 2,500 such recordings. Fagin says her story captures what it was like to report on history as it unfolded, and points to the urgent need to document more of these aging witnesses’ memories before they are lost.
translated_content: அமெரிக்காவின் ஜனாதிபதி ஜான் எஃப். கென்னடி அவர்களின் மோட்டர் கேட் டல்லாஸ் நகரில் சென்ற சமயத்தில் சுடுகாட்டப்பட்டதும், அசோசியேட்டட் பிரஸ் செய்தியாளர் பெகி சிம்ப்ஸன் உடனே சம்பவ இடத்திற்கு ஓடினார். சுட்டுகொள்ளப்பட்ட இடத்திலிருந்து போலீசாரும் வர, அவர்களுடன் அருகில் இருந்து தகவல்களை சேகரித்து உடனுக்குடன் தன் தணிகைத் தலைவர் குழுவுக்கு தெரிவித்து வந்தார். இப்போது அவருக்கு 84 வயதாகிறது; அந்த நாளை நேரில் பார்த்து நினைவுக்களை பகிரும் கடைசி சாட்சிகளில் ஒருவர் தான். டல்லாஸ் டீலி பிளாசாவில் உள்ள சிக்ஸ் ப்ளோர் மியூசியத்தின் கியுரேட்டர் ஸ்டீபன் பேகின், நேரடி சாட்சிகளின் அரியப்பொருளை மேலும் வலியுறுத்துகிறார். அந்த தொடர் மற்றும் நிகழ்வு நேரடி சாட்சிகள் பழையதாகும் முன்னர், இவை வரலாற்று முக்கியத்துவம் வாய்ந்தவை. சிம்ப்ஸன், ஓய்வுபெற்ற சீக்ரெட் சர்வீஸ் முகவர் கிளிண்ட் ஹில் மற்றும் பலர், நாஷனல் ஜியோகிராபிக் தயாரித்த 'JFK: One Day in America' என்ற புதிய மூன்று பகுதிகளாகும் தொடரில் இடம்பெற்றுள்ளனர். அரிய காப்பக காட்சிகளோடு (சிலவை புதிய நிறங்களில்) இணைத்து அந்த கால புன்னகையையும் உணர்ச்சிகளையும் கொண்டு வர முயற்சி செய்கின்றனர். இயக்குநர் எல்லா ரைட், உரையாடல்களில் அந்த உணர்வுகளை உணர்த்துவதாக கூறுகிறார். ஜான் எஃப். கென்னடி படுகொலை நடந்த டீலி பிளாசாவை இன்னும் பலர் வரலாற்று பார்வையாளர்களாக பார்வையிடுகின்றனர். பேகின், 1960களில் அமெரிக்க சமூகத்தை கருப்பக்கத்தின் வழியாக மாற்றிய ஒரு முக்கிய நிகழ்வாகவே இந்த சுடுகாட்டை கருதுகிறார். ஜோ பைடன், அக்காலத்தில் கல்லூரி மாணவராக இருந்த பொழுது, நண்பர்களுடன் நிமிடத்துக்கு நிமிடம் செய்தியை பார்த்த நாளை நினைவுகூர்ந்தார். அவர், கென்னடி வழங்கிய நம்பிக்கை நிறைந்த பார்வையை நினைவு கூரும் வகையில், அதன் பணியை மக்கள் தொடர வேண்டும் என தெரிவித்துள்ளார். 1963, நவம்பர் 22 அன்று சிம்ப்ஸனின் நியமனம் ஆஸ்டினில் நடைபெறும் இரவு நிதியஹார விழாவுக்காக இருந்தது. டல்லாஸ் நகரில் இருந்து கிளம்ப முன் நேரம் இருந்ததால், ஜனாதிபதி பேரணியை (டீலி பிளாசாவில் அல்ல) சென்றார். சம்பவம் நேர்ந்தது தெரியாமல் டல்லாஸ் டைம்ஸ் ஹெரால்டு அலுவலகம் வந்த போது, பழைய பத்திரிகைக்காரர்கள் பேசுவதைக் கேட்டு தான் முதல் முறையாக கென்னடி சுட்டுவேன் செய்தியை அறிந்தார். உடனடியாக அவர் AP பியூரோ தலைவர் செய்திகளை வெளியிடும் தருணத்தில் பார்வையிட்டார்; பின் கூடுதல் தகவலுக்காக டெக்சாஸ் ஸ்கூல் புக் டிபோசிடி கட்டடத்திற்கு ஓடினார். பின்னர் காவல் தலைமையகத்தில், சிம்ப்ஸன் செய்தியாளர்களின் கூட்டம், வெளியே காட்டப்பட்ட ஒஸ்வால்டின் துப்பாக்கி, மற்றும் ஒஸ்வால்டிடம் நிருபர்கள் கேள்வி கேட்ட பரபரப்பை விவரிக்கிறார். இரண்டு நாட்களுக்கு பிறகு, ஒஸ்வால்டை சிறைக்கும் பொழுது நைட்கிளப் உரிமையாளர் ஜாக் ரூபி வந்து, ஒஸ்வால்டை சுட்டார்; உடனே சிம்ப்ஸன் தன் அனுபவத்தை தொலைபேசியில் எடிட்டர்களுக்கு செவிமடுத்தார். சிம்ப்ஸனின் இந்த நினைவுகள் தற்போது சிக்ஸ் ப்ளோர் மியூசியத்தின் வாய்மொழி வரலாற்றுக் களஞ்சியத்தில் இதுவரை 2,500க்கும் மேற்பட்ட பதிவுகளுடன் சேர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. பேகின், வரலாற்றுப் பெரும்பாலான நிகழ்வுகளில் பத்திரிகையாளர்கள் நேரில் இருந்த அனுபவத்தை சிம்ப்ஸன் பிரதிபலிக்கிறார் என்கிறார். மேலும், உயர் வயதுக்கொண்ட சாட்சிகள் நினைவுகளை விரைவில் சேகரிக்க வேண்டிய அவசியத்தை வலியுறுத்துகிறார்.

article_content:
Nigeria capped their flawless run at the inaugural West Africa Trophy by securing an 18-run victory over a determined Rwanda side in the tournament final at Tafawa Balewa Cricket Oval, Lagos, on Sunday. Coach Steve Tikolo's team engineered a remarkable comeback, overcoming the East Africans, who were close to claiming their first win over Nigeria during the 10-day event.

After losing three wickets during the powerplay in the first innings, Nigeria’s Yellow Greens didn’t resemble the dominant side that had defeated Rwanda three times earlier in the tournament. However, Man of the Match Isaac Danladi (44 runs) and new junior captain Ridwan Abdulkareem (39 runs) forged a crucial partnership that pushed Nigeria past the century mark. Abdulkareem was eventually dismissed on the final ball of the innings, and despite two more wickets falling in the 20th over, Nigeria posted 103 runs for the loss of seven wickets.

Rwanda’s chase started well, maintaining an average of five runs per over in the first 30 balls and losing just one wicket in the opening 10 overs. Nigeria, however, tightened their bowling, restricting Rwanda to 63 runs after 16 overs and claiming six more wickets, making the 104-run target unreachable. Chimelie Udekewe polished off the match by taking the seventh wicket, sealing Nigeria’s unbeaten record—winning all ten matches in the tournament.

After the match, Rwanda’s coach Lee Booth admitted his team gave their all but praised Nigeria’s dominance, stating, “Nigeria are clearly the best side in this tournament. Anything short of victory would have been harsh on them.”

article_content: Japan has made one change to their starting lineup for their crucial Rugby World Cup Pool D match against Argentina in Nantes this Sunday. Siosaia Fifita moves onto the left wing for this decisive game, where victory would secure a place in the quarter-finals. Japan needs either a win or a try-scoring bonus-point in a draw—while also preventing Argentina from claiming a bonus point—to qualify for the knockout stages for a second consecutive World Cup. Coach Jamie Joseph said, "The players are in really good condition, both mentally and physically. We've had an up and down season, but I feel that we're starting to play some of our best rugby at the right time." Joseph has opted to keep most of the team that defeated Samoa 28-22 in the previous game, with Fifita replacing Jone Naikabula on the wing. Kotaro Matsushima remains on the other wing, while Lomano Lemeki continues at fullback following his strong performance against Samoa. Ryoto Nakamura and Dylan Riley partner in the centers. Flyhalf Rikiya Matsuda—who has missed only one kick at goal in three tournament games—starts alongside scrum-half Naoto Saito. Captain Kazuki Himeno lines up at number eight, joined in the back row by Michael Leitch and Pieter Labuschagne. Jack Cornelsen and Amato Fakatava form the second row, while the front row includes hooker Shota Horie between props Keita Inagaki and Jiwon Gu. Japan has lost five of its last six tests against Argentina, including the last three meetings, but has won nine of its last 11 pool matches at Rugby World Cups. "We just need to play 80 minutes of rugby and give our best, playing our style," Joseph, who hails from New Zealand, added. "We've been preparing for this game over the last three years, so we're really looking forward to it." Japan lineup: 1-Keita Inagaki, 2-Shota Horie, 3-Jiwon Gu, 4-Jack Cornelsen, 5-Amato Fakatava, 6-Michael Leitch, 7-Pieter Labuschagne, 8-Kazuki Himeno (capt), 9-Naoto Saito, 10-Rikiya Matsuda, 11-Siosaia Fifita, 12-Ryoto Nakamura, 13-Dylan Riley, 14-Kotaro Matsushima, 15-Lomano Lemeki. Replacements: 16-Atsushi Sakate, 17-Craig Millar, 18-Asaeli Ai Valu, 19-Warner Dearns, 20-Amanaki Saumaki, 21-Yutaka Nagare, 22-Ryohei Yamanaka, 23-Jone Naikabula.

article_content: There are indications that the release timeframe for the next major Windows update, potentially Windows 12, has been hinted at by Intel. Intel discussed its expectations for 2024 at the Citi 2023 Global Technology Conference, predicting a strong year for its client processors. This optimism aligns with Intel's upcoming Meteor Lake processors, which are scheduled to launch in 2024. Importantly, Intel referenced a 'Windows refresh' expected in 2024. Although Windows 12 was not mentioned directly, this suggests a significant update is coming. "We actually think 2024 is going to be a pretty good year for client [processors], in particular, because of the Windows refresh. And we still think that the installed base is pretty old and does require a refresh and we think next year may be the start of that, given the Windows catalyst. So we’re optimistic about how things will play out beginning in 2024," an Intel representative stated, as reported by PC Gamer. The term 'Windows refresh' is somewhat vague, but it likely refers to a major new version rather than a routine update. Microsoft often releases patches, but a substantial redesign would match up with Intel's new Meteor Lake architecture, which includes compute, GPU, IO, and AI dies. Meteor Lake is expected to focus on laptops at first, with Arrow Lake-S targeted for desktops in the latter part of 2024. If the processors are well integrated with a redesigned Windows OS, it could encourage wider adoption of both the new CPUs and the operating system. Although specific information about Windows 12 remains sparse, and Intel's comments were not definitive, Microsoft has already started weaving AI features like Copilot into Windows 11, potentially laying the groundwork for the next version. It's expected that Windows 12 will deepen this AI integration, and hardware such as the neural processing unit in Meteor Lake could support these advancements. With Windows 11 adoption slowing down, Windows 12 might accelerate user upgrades and signify the phase-out of Windows 10. While Intel's statement is not an official confirmation, it serves as a strong indication that a major Windows release may arrive in 2024.

Windows 12 நேரடியாக எங்கும் குறிப்பிடப்படவில்லை என்றாலும், இது ஒரு பெரிய புதுப்பிப்பை அறிமுகப்படுத்தும் அறிகுறி என்று சொல்லப்படுகிறது. "2024 வாடிக்கையாளர் [பிராசஸர்களுக்கு] நல்ல ஆண்டு ஆகும், குறிப்பாக Windows refresh காரணமாக. நிறுவியிருந்த பத்தொன்பது வசதிகள் பழையவை, அதனால் புதுப்பிப்பு தேவை. அடுத்த ஆண்டு Windows காரணமாக அந்த புதுப்பிப்பு ஆரம்பமாகும் என்று நாங்கள் நம்புகிறோம். எனவே 2024 எப்படி உருவாகும் என்று நாங்கள் நம்பிக்கையுடன் இருக்கிறோம்," என Intel பிரதிநிதி PC Gamer-க்கு கூறினார். 'Windows refresh' என்ற சொல் தெளிவற்றாலும், இது வழக்கமான திருத்தம் அல்லாமல் புதிய முக்கிய பதிப்பைக் குறிப்பிடுகிறது. Microsoft பொதுவாக சிறிய பச்சுகளை வெளியிடுகிறது, ஆனால் பெரிய மாற்றம் Intel Meteor Lake ஆக்கப்பொதுவான கட்டமைப்புடன் பொருந்தும். இதில் கணினி, GPU, IO, மற்றும் AI ஈஞ்சின் அடங்கும். Meteor Lake முதலில் லேப்டாப்புகளில் வெளிவரும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது; Arrow Lake-S டெஸ்க்டாப்புகளுக்கு 2024 இரண்டாம் பாதியில் வெளிவரும். இந்த ப்ராசஸர்கள் மாறியுள்ள Windows ஓஎஸுடன் சம்மந்தப்பட்டு வந்தால், புதிய CPU-களுக்கும் புதிய ஓஎஸுக்கும் விரைவான ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளலை ஏற்படுத்தும். Windows 12 குறித்த தகவல்கள் மிகக் குறைவு; Intel குறிப்புகள் உறுதி செய்யவில்லை, ஆனால் Microsoft ஏற்கனவே Copilot போன்ற AI அம்சங்களை Windows 11-ல் சேர்த்து வருகிறது; இது அடுத்த பதிப்பு வளர்ச்சிக்கு அடிப்படையாக இருக்கிறது. Windows 12 AI ஒருங்கிணைப்பை மேலும் வலுப்படுத்தும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது; Meteor Lake-இன் Neural Processing Unit எனும் ஹார்ட்வேர் இவற்றை பலப்படுத்தும். Windows 11 ஏற்றுக்கொள்வது மெதுவாகியுள்ளது; Windows 12 புதிய மேம்பாடுகள் மூலம் விரைவில் பயனர்கள் மற்றும் நிறுவனங்களை இடம்பெயர்க்கும்; அதே சமயம், Windows 10 உட்பட பழைய பதிப்புகளை முடிவிடும். Intel-ன் இந்த அறிக்கை அதிகாரபூர்வ உறுதிப்படுத்தல் அல்ல, ஆனால் 2024-ல் முக்கியமான Windows வெளியீடு வரும் வாய்ப்பு அதிகம் என இது காட்டுகிறது.

article_content: Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days are one of the best times to save on a variety of its products, including Kindles, Fire TV Sticks, Echo smart speakers, Fire tablets, and more. While this piece spotlights Kindle deals, we’ve also listed standout offers on other Amazon devices. On October 11, we updated this guide with ongoing offers and new markdowns on the Kindle Paperwhite Fabric Cover and Strapsicle E-Reader Hand Strap. Our team tests these gadgets throughout the year, curating the best live deals. Products that sell out or lose their discount will be crossed out, and updates will continue as the event goes on. Purchases through these links may generate a commission that supports our work. Kindle e-readers are loved for their simplicity, reliability, and impressive battery life. They hold thousands of books and can bring back the joy of reading. See our Best Amazon Kindles guide for more info. Last Prime Day, the Kindle Paperwhite—highly recommended by WIRED—dropped to $95 ($55 off), the lowest we’ve seen. It offers strong battery life, a warm backlight perfect for evenings, and USB-C charging. The Signature Edition costs $140 ($50 off) and comes with more storage, wireless charging, and auto-adjusting light. The Kindle Paperwhite Kids Edition remains at a similar price to July’s Prime Day, making it a great choice for kids. It’s waterproof and includes a warm, adjustable light. Special versions like the Warrior Cats edition cost $120, ideal for fans of the book series. The regular Kindle Kids model is $80 ($40 off), but without waterproofing or adjustable lighting. Both kids’ models come with a protective case, one year of Amazon Kids+, and a no-questions-asked two-year replacement warranty. The basic Kindle is the smallest and most affordable, priced at $65 ($35 off) in the last sale. Its 6-inch screen may be too compact for some but is handy for one-handed reading. However, it’s not waterproof and the backlight doesn’t adjust. Kindle Scribe is Amazon’s first e-reader for digital handwriting, featuring a 10.2-inch screen and a stylus. You can write notes and use digital sticky notes—though not directly in eBook margins. The base 16GB model has a basic pen, with options for more storage and a premium pen. If you prefer real buttons for page-turning, the Kindle Oasis is the high-end choice, though it may be due for an upgrade soon. Accessory deals include the Kindle Paperwhite Fabric Cover and Strapsicle Hand Strap—both discounted to help make reading more comfortable. The Echo Dot (5th Gen) comes at a discount and includes a free smart plug (worth about $20). It’s a top Alexa speaker for automating small tasks like controlling lights and appliances. The version with a built-in clock is $45 ($15 off). The Echo Pop, a smaller Alexa speaker, is also bundled with a smart plug and discounted. For boosting home Wi-Fi, the Eero Pro 6E mesh router is simple to set up and covers up to 2,000 square feet, with or without a subscription. Packs of two or three are available at reduced prices. The Echo Show 8 heads Amazon’s smart display lineup on sale, bundled with a free Alexa Together trial or a Philips Hue bulb for a bit more. Don’t forget to cancel Alexa Together if you don’t want extra fees. Amazon’s Fire TV Stick 4K and new 4K Max are part of the sale, providing reliable streaming, especially for those already invested in Amazon’s ecosystem.

மேலும் விழாக் காலத்தில் வழிகாட்டி தொடர்ந்து புதுப்பித்துக்கொள்ளப்படும். இந்த இணையதள இணைப்புகள் மூலம் நீங்கள் வாங்கினால் எங்களுக்கு உத்தியோகபூர்வமாக சிறிய கமிஷன் கிடைக்கும்; இது எங்கள் பத்திரிகை சேவையை ஆதரிக்க உதவுகிறது. கிண்டில் ஈ-ரீடர்கள் அவர் எளிமை, நம்பகத்தன்மை மற்றும் நீண்ட பேட்டரி ஆயுளுக்காக மிக விரும்பப்படுகின்றன. இவை ஆயிரக்கணக்கான புத்தகங்களை சேமித்து வைக்க முடியும்; வாசிப்பை மீண்டும் ஒரு சந்தோஷ அனுபவமாக்கும். மேலும் தகவலுக்கு எங்கள் சிறந்த அமேசான் கிண்டில்கள் வழிகாட்டியைப் பார்க்கவும். கடந்த ப்ரைம் டே-யில், WIRED பரிந்துரைத்த கிண்டில் பேப்பர்வைட் $95 ($55 தள்ளுபடி) என்ற மிகக் குறைந்த விலையில் கிடைத்தது. இது பல வாரங்கள் நிலைக்கும் பேட்டரி, இரவுக்கு ஏற்ற வெப்ப ஒளி மற்றும் USB-C சார்ஜிங் வழங்குகிறது. சிக்னேச்சர் எடிசன் $140 ($50 தள்ளுபடி): கூடுதல் சேமிப்பு, வயர்லெஸ் சார்ஜிங் மற்றும் தானாக ஒளி ஒவ்வேற்ப்படுத்தும் வசதியுடன் வருகிறது. கிண்டில் பேப்பர்வைட் கிட்ஸ் எடிசன் ஜூலை ப்ரைம் டே விலைக்கே கிடைக்கிறது; கடந்த விற்பனையில் $65 ($35 தள்ளுபடி) மட்டுமே. 6-இன்ச் திரை சிலருக்கு சிறியதாகத் தோன்றலாம் ஆனால் ஒரே கையில் வைத்திருக்க ஏற்றது. ஆனால் இது நீர்ச்சோர்வு எதிர்ப்பு இல்லை; அகல ஒளிக்கட்ட அட்வான்ஸ்ட்டான மாற்றியும் இல்லை. கிண்டில் ஸ்கிரைப், அமேசானின் முதல் டிஜிட்டல் எழுத்து வசதியுள்ள ஈ-ரீடர்; article_content: A solar eclipse will be visible across the United States and the Americas on Saturday, October 14, 2023. For safe viewing, it is essential to use certified solar eclipse glasses or handheld viewers—regular sunglasses are unsafe for this purpose. To ensure everyone has access, the Solar Eclipse Activities for Libraries (SEAL) project, funded by the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation, is distributing 5 million pairs of solar viewing glasses to 13,000 public libraries nationwide. Attendees can check an interactive map to find participating libraries in their area. According to astronomer Andrew Fraknoi, it is best to visit libraries early, as supplies are limited and unlikely to last until the day of the eclipse. Each library typically receives about 500 pairs, and recipients are advised to store glasses in an envelope to protect their special coating. Libraries saw record attendance during the 2017 eclipse, and a similar high interest is expected this year. Additionally, a NASA-funded project led by the Astronomical Society of the Pacific is deploying Eclipse Ambassadors to distribute free glasses at community events, focusing on underserved populations. Science museums, planetariums, and college bookstores may also offer programs or events where eclipse glasses are distributed. For those purchasing glasses, the American Astronomical Society recommends buying from vetted suppliers such as American Paper Optics and Rainbow Symphony (in collaboration with Thousand Oaks Optical). Only glasses that meet the ISO 12312-2 international safety standard should be used. Most of the U.S. and all of the Americas will experience a partial solar eclipse, with cities like New York seeing 23% coverage and Los Angeles reaching 71%. A narrow path about 125 miles wide, stretching from Oregon through Texas, will observe the annular ‘ring of fire’ effect. This occurs because the moon appears too small to cover the sun entirely, leaving a bright ring visible. Everyone observing the eclipse, even those in the direct path, must use proper viewing glasses at all times. Additional information, including detailed guides and updates about the eclipse, can be found on WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com and through trusted astronomy sources.

Suzanna van de Lagemaat, a geologist from Utrecht University, has reconstructed a giant tectonic plate called Pontus that had previously gone undetected. This ancient plate, believed to have covered about a quarter of the Pacific Ocean’s size, was anticipated years ago by Utrecht researchers based on remnants identified deep in the Earth’s mantle.

Through extensive research in mountain chains across Japan, Borneo, the Philippines, New Guinea, and New Zealand, Van de Lagemaat uncovered geological clues. To her amazement, she discovered that oceanic rock fragments in northern Borneo, once thought to belong to another missing plate, actually connect to Pontus—and these rocks originated much farther north than previously supposed.

Her analysis revealed that, millions of years ago, Pontus formed a single vast plate system spreading from southern Japan to New Zealand, lasting at least 150 million years. Remnants have also been found in Palawan and the South China Sea.

The study used refined geological mapping, magnetic analysis, and seismic data to trace these ancient plates. Buried plate fragments in the mantle are detected due to their distinct effects on earthquake waves, letting scientists glimpse into the distant past.

Earlier assumptions placed Pontus relics in northern Japan, but Van de Lagemaat’s detailed mapping shifted this view. Under the guidance of Douwe van Hinsbergen, her findings settle ongoing debates in geology. The results are detailed in Gondwana Research.

article_content: Australia’s newest streaming platform, Stan, launched on Australia Day. Developed as a joint venture between Fairfax and Nine Entertainment, Stan offers a subscription at $10 per month, providing access to over 750 TV shows, films, and documentaries. Stan’s debut comes ahead of Netflix’s launch in Australia and follows Foxtel and Seven Network’s Presto TV, highlighting the intensifying competition in the country’s online streaming market. Stan subscribers will gain early access to the much-anticipated ‘Breaking Bad’ spin-off, ‘Better Call Saul,’ premiering online on Monday, February 9. Additional exclusive titles available on Stan include ‘Transparent’ and ‘Mozart in the Jungle,’ with licensing deals in place with major content providers such as Sony, BBC Worldwide, ABC, SBS, and Viacom. This ensures Stan’s catalog features acclaimed shows like ‘Masters of Sex,’ ‘Hannibal,’ ‘Ray Donovan,’ ‘Californication,’ ‘The Good Wife,’ ‘Sherlock,’ ‘Call the Midwife,’ ‘Top Gear,’ and ‘Doctor Who.’ Australian content is also featured prominently, with series such as ‘Ja’mie Private School Girl,’ ‘Redfern Now,’ ‘Rake,’ and full seasons of ‘Underbelly,’ ‘House Husbands,’ and ‘Love Child’ included in the line-up. Rebel Wilson is the face of Stan’s advertising campaign, notably appearing in gold mermaid attire for the promos. Mike Sneesby, CEO of Stan, stated: ‘We know there’s been speculation about Stan’s launch date. While we’ve had to keep it confidential, we’re proud to announce the launch of Australia’s new streaming service on Australia Day.’ Netflix is scheduled to launch in Australia on March 31, with a monthly price of $9.99. However, there is ongoing uncertainty about whether popular original series such as ‘House of Cards’ and ‘Orange Is The New Black’ will be available at launch, due to existing licensing agreements with Foxtel. Foxtel and Seven Network’s Presto TV, which began service on January 18, offers a separate subscription at $9.99 per month for either movies or TV shows, or $14.99 for both, including titles like HBO’s ‘The Newsroom’ and ‘Girls.’ Confirmed offerings as the competition intensifies are: Stan – major exclusives including ‘Better Call Saul,’ ‘Transparent,’ and ‘Fargo’; Netflix – shows such as ‘Marco Polo,’ ‘BoJack Horseman,’ ‘Uganda Be Kidding Me, Live from Chelsea Handler,’ ‘Bloodline,’ ‘Daredevil,’ ‘Sense8,’ and ‘Grace and Frankie’; Presto – classic and acclaimed series such as ‘The Sopranos,’ ‘The Wire,’ ‘Boardwalk Empire,’ ‘Dexter,’ and ‘Ray Donovan,’ with access to a range of HBO and Showtime titles. Some in-demand shows still in production may be missing the latest seasons on Presto due to rights limitations, but full series are expected eventually. Stan holds the exclusive Australian rights for both ‘Breaking Bad’ and its prequel ‘Better Call Saul,’ emphasizing its strong position in the evolving Australian streaming market.

article_content: Representatives from the Justice Department and FBI have been closely involved in the St. Louis County investigation into the shooting death of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri. They participated in witness interviews and had access to all grand jury testimony and evidence. In the coming weeks, as local authorities announce the results of the grand jury investigation and whether charges will be brought against the police officer involved, federal authorities are not expected to stand alongside county prosecutor Robert McCulloch. McCulloch has urged federal officials to coordinate the conclusion of the federal civil rights investigation and announce their findings jointly, but the Justice Department has declined, stating that a joint announcement could undermine the independence of the federal investigation. Both state and federal investigations are focused on different statutes. Justice Department representatives have told local authorities that the federal investigation will conclude independently and will not be bound to an artificial schedule. If, as many expect, the St. Louis County grand jury does not bring charges, the Justice Department may still review the state’s investigation to ensure it was properly conducted. This has raised tensions among local, state, and federal officials. Local leaders are frustrated by the prospect of another federal review, especially given that Justice Department and FBI representatives have observed or accessed most interviews and evidence. The handling of the case by the local prosecutor is also somewhat atypical, as all available evidence, including that supporting Officer Darren Wilson, has been presented to the grand jury—unlike most grand jury proceedings, which usually rely on a smaller set of witnesses and evidence. Despite disagreements, there has been some cooperation, with the FBI conducting some forensic tests used in the state case. As the investigation continues, federal and state officials, supported by members of Missouri’s congressional delegation, are working on reform proposals to improve strained relations between the Ferguson police and the predominantly African-American community. One proposal involves Ferguson Police Chief Thomas Jackson stepping down, with the St. Louis County Police Department assuming management of the local force. CNN’s reporting on these reform plans was met with resistance from city officials, who are cautious about rapid changes. Attorney General Eric Holder commented at the Washington Ideas Forum that broad changes in the Ferguson Police Department are appropriate. Last month, the Justice Department released a letter to the Ferguson Police Department, prohibiting officers from wearing wristbands bearing the statement 'I am Darren Wilson' while on duty. Justice Department officials have also expressed frustration with information leaks, which they attribute to local authorities attempting to shape public perception of the case. Another area of contention may arise at the conclusion of the grand jury process if local officials seek to publicly release all case evidence. Federal officials may oppose this if their investigation remains open, due to concerns about sharing sensitive materials.

In this passage, Robin shares a vivid account from her time as a weekend anchor in Chicago. As she prepares to deliver a news story live on air, she experiences overwhelming anxiety: her hands shake, her heart races, and her voice quivers. Despite years of experience, Robin finds herself struggling to stay composed, lost in thoughts of self-doubt and fear of professional failure. The episode is brief but feels endless, leaving her visibly unsettled. After the segment, colleagues Josh and Michael express concern, and Robin, still shaken, accepts a glass of water. She feels embarrassed and physically drained but resumes her duties with composure. Robin reflects on how, unlike lighthearted embarrassments from her past—such as a high school mishap during a choir performance—this professional stumble felt impossible to laugh off. Even after returning home, she remains fixated on the moment, overwhelmed by humiliation and anxiety. Her partner, Tim, gently checks in on her, offering support as she processes the incident. The excerpt illustrates the pressures and vulnerabilities that can come with performing in broadcast journalism.

article_content: Maxine Powell, celebrated for her influence on Motown Records’ artists and their polished presence, died Monday at age 98, according to the Detroit Free Press. Powell began working with Motown in 1964 as a personal development coach, instructing stars like Diana Ross and Marvin Gaye in poise, speech, and professional conduct. Her focus on etiquette and media skills distinguished Motown artists from their peers, providing them with unique tools for success. Mary Wilson of the Supremes recalled Powell’s advice that one day they might perform for royalty—a prediction that came true for many Motown acts. Motown founder Berry Gordy praised Powell’s disciplined but caring mentorship, highlighting her emphasis on elegance and proper conduct with reminders such as, 'Ladies, remember your gloves and walk with class.' Gordy credited Powell with giving Motown an unparalleled edge and called her an original in her own right. Smokey Robinson remembered Powell for her clear mind and profound impact, saying her influence would endure within Motown. Motown’s website notes that Powell was one of the label’s earliest personal development coaches, along with Maurice King and Cholly Atkins. Powell’s legacy endures through the generations of Motown artists she helped shape.

With the Super Bowl approaching and the NBA season just beginning, now may be an ideal time to upgrade your home theater. New blockbuster movies are constantly launching on streaming services, and TV prices have significantly decreased compared to five years ago. To help you find the best value, we've gathered the top TV deals currently available, including outstanding OLED and QLED options. These deals feature leading brands such as LG and Samsung, as well as budget-friendly choices like Roku, Hisense, and TCL.

If you want a smart TV with essential features and are unconcerned about size, the 40-inch Roku TV is a strong pick. Though it offers Full HD (1080p) rather than 4K resolution, it’s well-suited for dorm rooms, workspaces, or garages, and comes equipped with built-in Roku Smart technology for hassle-free streaming—no extra devices required.

For an affordable 4K option, Vizio’s V-Series is a noteworthy candidate. Known for its budget-friendly yet quality TVs, Vizio provides a solid mid-sized home theater experience with features such as a 60Hz refresh rate, Active Pixel Tuning, and Gaming Mode—making it suitable for sports and gaming enthusiasts.

Insignia presents another affordable 4K solution with smart capabilities powered by Fire TV. This TV supports HDR, ensuring vivid brightness and rich colors when playing games or watching movies, and provides seamless access to dozens of streaming services beyond Amazon Prime.

Hisense stands out with its R6 Series, offering an uncommon size between 55 and 60 inches. Built-in Roku technology makes streaming easy, and it supports HDR, HDR10, Dolby Vision, and Dolby Sound, creating a cinema-like experience at home. The Motion Rate 120 tech simulates a 120fps frame rate, enhancing sports viewing.

The 65-inch onn. Roku TV is a straightforward, economically priced 4K TV, similar in features to the Hisense model but larger. It includes smartphone remote control compatibility, a stand, and the ability to be wall mounted using a standard VESA mount.

Stepping up in both price and performance, TCL’s Q-Series QLED TV boasts superb color range, deeper blacks, and enhanced brightness, coupled with settings like Motion Rate 240 and MEMC Frame Insertion for smoother action scenes.

Samsung’s TU690T model, while not QLED, delivers impressive UHD visuals through a direct-lit display and Crystal Processor 4K. PurColor technology ensures vibrant, accurate colors, and integration with Google Assistant allows for smart home convenience.

The LG UR7800’s standout feature is its massive 86-inch display, ideal for creating a cinematic feel at home. While not a QLED model, it offers quality 4K resolution and includes Filmmaker Mode for movies presented in the director’s intended style.

Sony’s Bravia line, renowned for performance, includes a non-OLED, non-QLED version powered by the Cognitive Processor XR. This technology optimizes on-screen images, enhancing clarity and brightness based on content.

LG’s QNED TV introduces NanoCell LCD technology with quantum dots and Mini-LEDs, providing better color accuracy and crisper images. This 8K-ready TV is ahead of the curve, with display technology that anticipates future standards.

OLED fans may consider LG’s highly acclaimed OLED model, offering individually lit pixels for perfect blacks, vivid colors, and no light bleed. Advanced processing features like Active Pixel Tuning and Filmmaker Mode round out its premium specs.

Samsung’s OLED S90C model boasts a billion color shades thanks to self-illuminating pixels and a Neural Quantum Processor, which upscales content to 4K, making even older shows look sharp.

If you're preparing for the 8K era, Samsung’s QN800 QLED TV combines quantum dots and Mini-LEDs to deliver crisp imagery and billions of colors. Its Neural Processor also upscales existing content to take advantage of the high resolution.

For the ultimate in performance, the Sony Bravia XR A80L delivers a giant OLED display and an advanced processor that precisely adjusts image properties in real time. XR Triluminos Pro enhances color depth and accuracy, making it a top-tier choice for home theater aficionados.

article_content: In New Jersey, a high school senior named Rachel Canning made headlines by taking her parents to court. She alleges they made her leave home just as she turned 18 and stopped all financial assistance, including payments for her current schooling and college plans. In her lawsuit, Canning asked the court to compel her parents to pay outstanding private school fees, cover her living and transport expenses, use college savings for her education, and settle her legal costs. The judge recently denied her requests for high school tuition and living expenses, with decisions regarding college costs set for discussion in a future hearing. The case features clashing viewpoints. Rachel, an honors student and cheerleader, insists she was abruptly cut off and risks losing her college opportunity. Her parents, Sean and Elizabeth Canning, reject this, saying Rachel left of her own accord amid disputes over their household rules. Both sides have raised further allegations: parental disapproval of Rachel's boyfriend and claims of abuse contrast with reports that Rachel broke curfew and faced suspension from school. Most online commentary has criticized Rachel, describing her as entitled or ungrateful. Some commentators, including educators, view her lawsuit as a symptom of children who expect privileges without effort, though a few also blame parenting approaches for fostering this mindset. Certain opinions advocate that Rachel should complete her education independently to develop appreciation and resilience. Others sympathize with the parents, warning that removing hurdles for children may prevent valuable life lessons. A small minority point out that, while rare, there are cases where children might legitimately sue their parents. Experts emphasize that deep-seated family communication problems are at the heart of this dispute, urging counseling as a constructive path forward. article_content: Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers has acknowledged adopting a more ‘autocratic’ style this season, primarily due to the intense demands of the Champions League. The team now faces a decisive showdown with Basel on Tuesday—a situation reminiscent of Liverpool's notable 2004/05 comeback against Olympiakos, which set the stage for their later triumph in Istanbul. Rodgers noted that the crowded fixture list, particularly because of European commitments, has made it difficult to blend in his nine new summer acquisitions. After a costly 3-1 defeat to Crystal Palace that left Liverpool in 12th place, Rodgers decided he needed to be more direct and assertive with his team. "I’ve had significantly less time on the training ground this season. Integrating nine new players without proper coaching time is a real challenge," Rodgers stated. "Initially at Liverpool, I focused on instilling my principles. Once those were understood, I loosened up a bit. But after the Palace loss, I felt the need to return to a more hands-on, clear form of management. In the end, it’s about finding ways to win." With that in mind, Rodgers omitted some of the new players—including Emre Can, Adam Lallana, Dejan Lovren, and Lazar Markovic—from the squad in the recent 2-2 draw against Ludogorets. The goal was to simplify tactics and clarify instructions. Liverpool's Champions League journey has been difficult, with three defeats in five matches—two against Real Madrid. Their path to the last-16 now hinges on beating Basel and overcoming the head-to-head disadvantage from a 1-0 first-leg loss. Captain Steven Gerrard was benched during the scoreless draw with Sunderland to conserve energy for this crucial tie. The situation strongly echoes the drama of the Olympiakos match ten years ago, when Liverpool needed three second-half goals. Driven by the Anfield crowd, goals by Florent Sinama-Pongolle, Neil Mellor, and Steven Gerrard secured a memorable win, propelling the team towards their eventual Champions League victory. Despite a tough European campaign, Rodgers remains optimistic. "The Champions League is always a challenge, and it’s not necessarily the favorites who go furthest. Our focus is solely on qualifying from the group. If we achieve that, anything could happen," Rodgers commented, looking ahead to another lively night at Anfield.

Childbirth is an intense experience, often bringing out unexpected sides in women—sometimes leading to surprising outbursts or comic moments. Recently, a Reddit thread invited doctors and nurses to share the most unusual or funny comments they've heard from mothers during labor. The original AskReddit question, posted about 20 days ago, has already attracted over 3,000 comments, filled with hilarious and memorable birthing stories.

Contributors described a range of experiences: from mothers under the influence of painkillers requesting barbecue ribs during contractions, to gas-induced declarations like "I'm lady Darth Vader!" Some stories involve frantic or comical reactions, such as a mother objecting to the use of forceps by shouting, "Those are salad tongs! You are NOT putting any goddamn kitchenware in there!" Another recounted a mother trying to set up her ex-partner with a doctor in the delivery room, between screams of pain.

Other anecdotes include panic-driven refusals to give birth ("I don't wanna do this. I'm going the f**k home."), humorous complaints about hospital amenities, and delirious confusion caused by medications. Through these shared stories, both professionals and parents highlight the unpredictable, stressful, and often funny reality of childbirth. article_content: In Bellevue, Washington, police are intensifying their response to shoplifting by staging undercover stakeouts near local malls. Officers coordinate with store security through text messaging to identify and apprehend suspected shoplifters. In a recent incident, they arrested a man for allegedly stealing a pair of white Nike sneakers. This is part of a broader effort to address the rising concerns about retail theft, fueled by widely shared videos of organized thefts. Loss prevention experts note that recent policy changes and coordinated law enforcement have led to progress. Tony Sheppard of ThinkLP credits the INFORM Act, which compels online sites such as Facebook Marketplace and OfferUp to collect information on frequent sellers to prevent the sale of stolen goods. Additionally, states like California have established multi-agency task forces, and in places like Los Angeles, these teams have doubled in size thanks to increased support from the California Highway Patrol. Yet, shoplifting continues to be a persistent issue. Some feel the problem has grown due to reduced consequences for theft during the pandemic and viral media coverage encouraging a sense of impunity. Sgt. Casey Hiam from Bellevue explains that their stakeouts aim to deter theft by demonstrating swift consequences—highlighting that even minor shoplifting can lead to jail time. Measuring retail theft remains difficult because many businesses don't consistently report incidents to the police. Data from the National Retail Federation reveals that most store managers consider organized retail crime a growing concern, though precise statistics remain unclear. To safeguard employees and avoid liability, many retailers now direct staff not to confront shoplifters, and the high cost of employing security personnel or off-duty officers means some companies absorb the losses instead. Not all retail employees are satisfied with this policy. Macy's workers in Seattle have staged strikes, demanding both higher wages and stronger security measures. Employees such as Jeanne Peterson and Kathy Henderson describe increased job-related stress from theft and potential violence. Macy’s maintains that protecting workers and customers is its top priority, but some staff say they've been suspended for intervening or contacting police. As a result, many employees report ongoing anxiety and a difficult work environment.

article_content: Watching the animals at The Gentle Barn react to popsicles is truly delightful. If you’ve ever wondered whether cows, horses, donkeys, chickens, goats, pigs, ducks, sheep, emus, or alpacas enjoy popsicles, these videos let you see their reactions. Some are excited about the treats, while others are a bit confused—but all are adorable, whether they’re munching the snacks or turning them down. The Gentle Barn is a farm animal sanctuary with 23 years of experience rescuing animals. Operating in California, Tennessee, and Missouri, its mission is to create a kinder world by saving, rehabilitating, and sheltering animals, as well as welcoming people who seek hope. They want to inspire visitors to appreciate the intelligence, affection, and magic of animals. Founded by Ellie Laks and Jay Weiner, The Gentle Barn first started in the San Fernando Valley, California, then moved in 2003 to a six-acre site in Santa Clarita, CA. The property offers large pastures for horses and cows, a red-and-white barnyard for smaller animals, an organic vegetable garden, shady trees, and mountain views. Nearly 200 animals live there. They’ve added locations in Nashville, Tennessee, and St. Louis, Missouri, and hope to open Gentle Barns across the country so more people can interact with animals and understand that we all deserve respect and freedom. Since opening, The Gentle Barn has saved thousands of animals and hosted over 500,000 visitors. Don’t miss these sweet videos of the animals trying popsicles—their reactions are the best! #popsicles #rescueanimals #farmanimalsanctuary

He also alleges that Menzies, once listed among David Cameron’s favored political candidates, requested that he bring drugs and wear certain underwear. While Santos is trying to broker a deal to tell more, sources say his actions are motivated by financial demands.

article_content: Authorities in Alabama have ruled Theresa Benn’s death a homicide after she went missing near Talladega Superspeedway during a race weekend in October. Benn was last seen at around 7:30 p.m. on October 19; her body was discovered more than a month later, on November 22, in the Jackson Shoals area of Choccolocco Creek. The Lincoln Police Department reported they are still waiting for DNA confirmation but are confident the remains found belong to Benn. According to statements, Benn’s husband, Kevin Dulaney, told police he left her near Eastaboga Road at about 2:15 a.m., after the two argued. Dulaney said she was last seen walking toward the racetrack. Police have yet to disclose the manner of Benn’s death but confirmed they are actively investigating leads in the homicide case. Lincoln Police Chief Darren Britton expressed condolences to Benn’s family and assured continued efforts toward solving the case. Following Benn’s disappearance, the Lincoln Police led a widespread search, assisted by Texas Equusearch, local volunteers, and multiple emergency agencies. Searchers used ATVs, boats, and conducted foot patrols throughout the area. The final known sighting of Benn, aged 42, was on Speedway Industrial Drive, close to the Talladega Superspeedway. Her family stated she was dropped off on the east end of Speedway Blvd near Mapco and Stuckey’s, wearing a black tank top, blue jeans with a rhinestone belt, and pink and brown cowboy boots, and carrying her purse and phone. Benn stood 5'5" tall, weighed 108 pounds, and had long dyed blonde hair. It is still unconfirmed whether Benn reached the Geico 500 race that Sunday, but police noted she did not attend Saturday’s race. Authorities continue to seek information from the public and acknowledged the significant support and assistance from all who participated in the search.

As winter nights turn cold and darkness falls early, few things are more comforting than a warm mug of hot chocolate. But with so many options on the shelves, which one is best? To help you decide, chocolate expert Jennifer Earle—a judge at the International Chocolate Awards and head of Chocolate Ecstasy Tours—tested seven popular drinking chocolates. Here are her verdicts:

Montezuma’s Chilli Drinking Chocolate (£6.29/300g): Chilli and chocolate make a classic pairing. This drink boasts a strong 73% chocolate content, though the chilli can be overpowering. It’s simple to prepare and contains 189 calories per serving. 4/5.

Hasslachers Hot Drinking Chocolate (£3.75/150g): Made from pure Colombian cacao (100%), this is Jennifer’s top pick. Drink it like an espresso or add milk and sugar. It’s a bit of a hassle to make—melt cocoa discs in a pan, then add milk—but at 150 calories a serving, it’s lighter than many. 5/5.

Cafe Direct Rich Hot Chocolate (£2/150g): Using Dominican Republic cocoa beans, this aromatic drink has 40% cocoa and no added salt or flavourings, with 162 calories per serving. Unfortunately, it’s grainy, reminiscent of a chocolate cup-a-soup. 3/5.

Galaxy Instant Hot Chocolate (£2.60/370g): The label suggests using hot water instead of milk, which keeps it low in calories (80 per serving). However, with only 3% Galaxy chocolate and many additives and sweeteners, experts found it unappealing—more like chocolate-flavoured water with a lumpy texture. 1/5.

Options Belgian Hot Chocolate Mint (£2/220g): At just 38 calories per serving, this low-calorie drink is surprisingly satisfying, tasting similar to after-dinner mint chocolates, with 20% cocoa. Acacia gum helps create a creamy texture, but some found the taste cloying. 2/5.

Cadbury’s Drinking Chocolate (£1.50/250g): For many—including Jennifer—Cadbury’s brings back fond childhood memories. At 25% cocoa and 165 calories per serving, the chocolate presence is mild, and the drink is very sweet, but nostalgia lends it appeal. 2/5.

Charbonnel and Walker The Chocolate Drink (£4.99/300g): Made with 51% cocoa flakes and a hint of vanilla, this drink smells like a quality chocolate bar. The sophisticated tin is a bonus. Though dissolving the flakes requires effort, the result is delicious and contains 193 calories per serving. 4/5.

Hans Sloane Rich Dark Drinking Chocolate (£4.99/270g): With 53% cocoa in chocolate beads (and 47% sugar), this drink is very sweet and high in calories (344 per serving). The beads are slow to dissolve, leaving lumps, and the sweetness is overpowering. 2/5.

Montezuma's Chilli Drinking Chocolate (£6.29/300g): மிளகாய் மற்றும் சாக்லெட் கலப்பு எப்போதும் சிறந்தது. இதில் 73% சாக்லெட் உள்ளது, ஆனால் மிளகாய் சுவை சற்று மேல் இருக்கலாம். எளிதில் தயாரிக்கலாம், 189 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம். மதிப்பீடு: 4/5.

Hasslachers Hot Drinking Chocolate (£3.75/150g): 100% கொலம்பியன் சாக்லெட். ஜெனிஃபருக்கு இது மிகவும் விருப்பு. எஸ்பிரஸ்சோ போல குடிக்கலாம், பால், சர்க்கரை சேர்க்கலாம். தயார் செய்ய சற்று கடினம் – சாக்லெட் வட்டங்களை உருக்கி பால் சேர்க்க வேண்டும். 150 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம். மதிப்பீடு: 5/5.

Cafe Direct Rich Hot Chocolate (£2/150g): டொமினிகன் குடியரசு சாக்லெட் விதையுடன் பிரமிக்கத் தக்க வாசனை. 40% சாக்லெட், சேர்க்கை யில்லை, 162 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம். ஆனால் சுவையில் கிரேனை தன்மை. மதிப்பீடு: 3/5.

Galaxy Instant Hot Chocolate (£2.60/370g): பசுமை உணவு (80 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம்), 3% சாக்லெட், இனிப்பூட்டிகள். இதில் சாக்லெட் முதலிய சுவை இல்லை, குழம்பும் இருக்கும். மதிப்பீடு: 1/5.

Options Belgian Hot Chocolate Mint (£2/220g): 38 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம்; மனதும் mint சாக்லெட்டாகவும் உள்ளது (20% சாக்லெட்), acacia gum காரணமாக கிரிமியும், சுவை சற்று போதுமான அல்லாத அளவில் இனிப்புள்ளது. மதிப்பீடு: 2/5.

Cadbury’s Drinking Chocolate (£1.50/250g): குழந்தை பருவ நினைவுகள் அதிகம், 25% சாக்லெட், 165 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம், மிக இனிப்பு. ஆனால் பழைய நினைவுகள் விசேஷம். மதிப்பீடு: 2/5.

Charbonnel and Walker The Chocolate Drink (£4.99/300g): 51% சாக்லெட் ஃப்ளேக்ஸ், வானிலா மணம், உயர்தரமான சாக்லெட் வாசனை. tin அழகு, உருக்கும் சிரமம் இருந்தாலும் ருசிகர சாக்லெட். 193 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம். மதிப்பீடு: 4/5.

Hans Sloane Rich Dark Drinking Chocolate (£4.99/270g): 53% சாக்லெட் மற்றும் 47% சர்க்கரை. அதிக இனிப்பும், 344 கலோரி/பரிமாற்றம், கரைய சுருக்கம், இனிப்பு சுவை அதிகம். மதிப்பீடு: 2/5.

Senator Adams Oshiomhole, representing Edo North, has described Edo State Governor Godwin Obaseki as his friend despite their political differences. Speaking at the 2023 Alaghodaro Summit in Benin City, Oshiomhole noted that friendship does not require agreement on every issue, emphasizing the importance of treating each other with love and respect. He stated, “Being friends doesn’t mean we can’t disagree or have different opinions, but we must treat ourselves with love and care. Regardless of what people say, we shouldn’t give the impression that differing views mean conflict. We belong to different political parties, but our shared dedication to Edo State and its citizens is far greater.”

Oshiomhole further argued that strong leadership involves uniting followers through respect and dialogue rather than division. He declared, “The language of leaders matters to followers. In democracy, ideology defines us, and even if we share similar goals, the path may differ. It should never be a cause for hostility.”

Governor Obaseki, in his remarks, highlighted his administration’s focus on six critical areas: institutional reforms, economic revolution, social welfare, infrastructure development, and more.

At the end of the summit, former Governor Chief John Odigie-Oyegun presented an eight-point communiqué, emphasizing the need for unity and sustainable growth in Edo North. The gathering aimed to set an agenda for the continued development and cohesion of the senatorial district.

“நமது பாசமும் பராமரிப்பும் முக்கியம்; நாம் ஒப்புக்கொள்ளவில்லை என்றால் கூட அது பகைமை அல்ல. நம்மால் உள்ளம் இணைந்து மக்கள் நலனில் அக்கறை செலுத்தவேண்டும்" என கூறினார்.

article_content: Burnley's key forward Danny Ings has pledged to stay at the club until the end of the current season. Ings' contract expires then, and several clubs have shown interest in signing him during the January transfer window. Ings delivered a standout performance in Burnley’s 2-2 draw with Manchester City on Sunday. Newcastle United, Southampton, Leicester City, West Bromwich Albion, and German club Wolfsburg have all expressed interest in the England Under-21 striker. In his first Premier League season, Ings has consistently impressed. While he is not revealing his plans beyond this season, he insists he will remain at Burnley for now and is focused on helping the club maintain its Premier League status. ‘That was the plan,’ said Ings. ‘I’m contracted until the end of the season and that’s how it will be. My aim is to fight for the team and do my best.’ The 22-year-old, who has been watched closely by England scouts, also said he will not be distracted by any transfer offers in January. ‘I’m not looking at that. I’ll just take the interest as a confidence boost and channel it into my performances for Burnley.’ ‘It’s easy for young players to lose focus, but I’m not that type of person. I have a job to do here and I’m contracted until the end of the season—that’s how it’s going to be.’ Burnley are still in the relegation zone, although only by goal difference following a recent upturn that has seen Sean Dyche's side lose just three of their last nine league matches. Burnley’s fitness and consistency have received praise after Dyche named an unchanged team for both the Boxing Day game against Liverpool and the draw at Manchester City, also choosing not to make any substitutions on Sunday. ‘We train as we play on the weekend,’ Ings said. ‘You can’t just flick a switch and expect to perform, especially in this league.’

article_content: A Minnesota man, Buford "Bucky" Rogers, was arrested after investigators found weapons and explosives in his home. Rogers was scheduled to appear in federal court in St. Paul on Monday afternoon. Rogers was taken into custody on Friday after a search of his home in Montevideo, Minnesota, resulted in the discovery of several explosives, including Molotov cocktails and a suspected pipe bomb, according to an affidavit by an FBI agent. The affidavit also stated that firearms, including a Romanian AK-M assault rifle, were found at the scene. Rogers, who has a prior felony conviction, was arrested for illegally possessing a firearm. "The FBI believes that law enforcement disrupted a terror attack and that the lives of several local residents were potentially saved," the FBI said in a statement. However, some law enforcement officials minimized the potential threat. One official said Rogers held anti-government views and that the case was being investigated as a domestic terrorism matter, not involving international groups like al Qaeda. According to court documents, Rogers acknowledged firing the assault rifle at a gun range on two occasions. Because of his 2011 third-degree burglary conviction, he is legally barred from possessing firearms. The documents do not specify Rogers' intentions regarding the explosives and guns, nor do they explain what prompted authorities to search his home.

article_content:
Twitter is often used to share emotions—whether happiness, sadness, or frustration. Now, researchers suggest it could also help identify post-natal depression in new mothers. Scientists at Microsoft, led by Dr. Eric Horvitz, found that certain changes in women’s Twitter use hinted at a risk for significant mood changes following childbirth. This insight could help provide support or treatment sooner for affected women.

Microsoft’s team analyzed publicly posted tweets, searching for messages that indicated a birth announcement. They examined the tweets of several hundred identified new mothers for three months before and after childbirth. Researchers looked at patterns such as time spent on Twitter, the people contacted, and changes in language—like increased use of the word ‘I’, which can flag introspection and has been associated with depression onset.

Dr. Horvitz and his team developed software that could predict, with over 70% accuracy, which women were at risk of post-natal depression based on their pre-birth tweets. Including tweets from the two weeks after childbirth raised accuracy to 80%. A follow-up study using Facebook posts confirmed that even before symptoms appear, changes in social media activity can signal vulnerability to depression.

Dr. Horvitz shared these findings at the annual meeting of the American Association for the Advancement of Science, suggesting that such research could lead to an early-warning app for expectant mothers. This app could offer information and support based on a woman’s social media activity, providing reassurance and helpful resources.

However, privacy remains a concern, as this method involves sensitive health data. Dr. Horvitz emphasized that any app would run privately on the user’s device.

Stuart Dobson, from the PANDAS Foundation, noted that many women with post-natal depression might prefer such home-based assessments over daunting medical appointments, though he questioned whether adequate support would follow a positive result.

ட்விட்டர் பொதுவாக மகிழ்ச்சி, துக்கம், ஏமாற்றம் போன்ற உணர்வுகளை பகிர்ந்து கொள்ள பயன்படுகிறது. இப்போது, கேள்விப்படும் போதிங்களே, புதிதாக தாயான பெண்களுக்கு பிறப்புக்குத் தொடர்ந்த மனச்சோர்வை (post-natal depression) அடையாளம் காணவும் ட்விட்டர் உதவலாம் என ஆராய்ச்சி எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. மைக்ரோசாஃப்ட் விஞ்ஞானிகள் டாக்டர் எரிக் ஹார்விட்ஸ் தலைமையில், பெண்களின் ட்விட்டர் பயன்படுத்தும் முறையில் ஏற்பட்ட மாற்றங்கள், குழந்தை பிறப்புக்குப் பின் மனநிலை மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்படும் அபாயம் இருப்பதை கண்டறிந்தனர். இந்த விரிவான தகவல் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட பெண்களுக்கு விரைவில் உதவிக்கோள் அளிக்க அல்லது தேவையான உதவிகளை வழங்க உதவும்.

article_content: The Kano State High Court, with Justice Ibrahim Karaye presiding, has found Benjamin Udeagwu and Benjamin Olamide guilty of internet fraud. The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) prosecuted the men, who both admitted guilt to their charges. Udeagwu posed as 'Brad George', a supposed American, in September 2023 and unlawfully obtained $50. Olamide, using the name 'Terry Vince', tricked multiple individuals in 2022, collecting $500 via email. EFCC lawyers Abubakar Elbadawi and Fatima Mustapha asked the court for convictions, while defense attorneys M.J. Ella and M.E. Ogah appealed for leniency, highlighting the defendants' first-time offences and regret. Justice Karaye sentenced Udeagwu to a year in jail or a N20,000 fine, and Olamide to two years or the same fine. The EFCC published the court's decision on its official X account.

article_content: Ash Regan has accused the Scottish Greens of 'petulance' after they expressed concerns regarding the relocation of her Holyrood office. Regan, who recently left the SNP to join the Alba Party, may be moved closer to the Greens as parliamentary offices are often grouped by party affiliation. The Greens have strongly supported legislation allowing individuals to self-identify their gender. Ms Regan resigned as a government minister last year to vote against gender reform proposals, stating that she could not support the plans in good conscience. The legislation aims to simplify and speed up the process of obtaining a Gender Recognition Certificate (GRC), removing the need for a medical diagnosis of gender dysphoria. On Saturday, Ms Regan became the first MSP from the Alba Party, led by Alex Salmond. According to The Scotsman, her potential office move has caused some discomfort among Green Party MSPs. BBC Scotland News reports that the matter has been raised with Holyrood's presiding officer, and Ms Regan visited offices on the same floor as Green MSPs this week. A spokesperson for Ash Regan expressed disappointment that suggestions by parliamentary authorities to make suitable office space available are being 'weaponised' by the Greens. They stated that the allocation of office space is determined collaboratively with parliamentary authorities, reflecting the independence and dignity of Scotland's legislature, and these decisions are not for any single party to dictate. They added that the Scottish Parliament is central to national democracy and should be treated with respect by all parties. The spokesperson criticized what they described as 'petulance', saying it was not in line with the expected conduct of elected members and emphasized the importance of working together for the good of Scotland. A Scottish Parliament spokesperson noted that the Corporate Body is required to provide office space and services to elected members and explores all options when a move is needed, but would not confirm whether any formal representations had been made. The Scottish Greens have been approached for comment.

அந்தத் திட்டங்களுக்கு ஆதரவு தர முடியாது என்று அவர் தெரிவித்தார். குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட சட்டம் பாலின அங்கீகாரம் பெறும் சான்றிதழ் (GRC) பெறும் முறையை எளிமைப்படுத்தவும் விரைவுபடுத்தவும் மருத்துவ அறிக்கையின் தேவையை நீக்கவும் முனைகிறது. சனிக்கிழமை அன்று, ஆல்பா கட்சியின் முதல் எம்எஸ்பியாக ரீகன் ஆனார்; இதை அலெக்ஸ் சால்மண்ட் தலைமையிலான கட்சி வழிநடத்துகிறது. தி ஸ்காட்ஸ்மேன் செய்தி வெளியிட்டபடி, அவரது அலுவலகம் இடம் மாற்றப்படுவது கிரீன்ஸ் எம்எஸ்பிக்களில் சிறிது கவலையை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. பிபிசி ஸ்காட்லந்து நியூஸ் இந்த விஷயம் ஹோலிரூட் முன்னிலை அலுவலரிடம் எடுத்துரையாடப்பட்டதாகவும், இந்த வாரம் ரீகன் கிரீன்ஸ் எம்எஸ்பிக்களின் மாடியில் உள்ள அலுவலகங்களை பார்த்ததாகவும் தெரிவித்தது. அஷ் ரீகன் சார்பில் பேசிய ஒருவர், அலுவலக இடத்துக்கு பாராளுமன்ற அதிகாரிகள் எடுத்த நடவடிக்கைகளை கிரீன்ஸ் கட்சி அரசியல் ஆயுதமாக்குவதாக வருந்தினார். அலுவலக இட ஒதுக்கீடு ஸ்காட்லாந்து பாராளுமன்றத்தின் சுதந்திரத்தையும் மரியாதையையும் பிரதிபலிக்கும் வகையில், பாராளுமன்ற அதிகாரிகளுடன் ஒருங்கிணைந்து தீர்மானிக்கப்படுகிறது; ஒரு கட்சி தனக்கே தீர்மானிக்க முடியாது என்றும் அவர் தெரிவித்தார். பாராளுமன்றம் நாட்டின் ஜனநாயகத்திற்கு முக்கியம் என்பதால் அனைத்துப் பார்டிக்களும் மரியாதையுடன் நடக்க வேண்டும் என்றும், எம்எஸ்பிக்களுக்கு எதிர்பார்க்கப்படும் நடத்தை இதுவல்ல என்றும், ஸ்காட்லாந்து மக்களின் நலனுக்காக ஒற்றுமையுடன் செயல்பட வேண்டும் என்றும் அவர் வலியுறுத்தினார். ஸ்காட்கிஷ் பாராளுமன்ற வளர்ச்சி நிறுவனம் தெரிவிப்பதாக ஸ்போக் பர்சன் கூறினார், தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட உறுப்பினர்களுக்குத் தேவையான அலுவலக வசதிகள் வழங்கப்பட வேண்டும் என்றும், அலுவலகம் மாற்றம் ஏற்பட்டால் அனைத்து விருப்பங்களும் பரிசீலிக்கப்படுகின்றன என்றும் தெரிவித்தனர்; எதாவது கோரிக்கை வந்ததா என்பது குறித்து அறிவிக்க முடியாது என்றும் கூறினர். ஸ்காட்டிஷ் கிரீன்ஸ் கட்சியின் கருத்து பெற முயற்சி செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

article_content: In a note to staff, NPR's VP of Content (Culture Programming) Yolanda Sangweni and Senior Director of Platform Integration, Beth Donovan, announced that Ciera Crawford has been promoted to Chief Arts and Culture Hub Editor. In her new role, Ciera will lead coverage on the culture desk, focusing on original reporting and the signature curation initiatives that distinguish NPR. She will prioritize collaboration across newsmagazines, newscasts, and podcasts that emphasize culture coverage. Over the past few months, Ciera has played an important role in the Arts & Culture Hub, helping align NPR's cultural coverage for its audiences. Her contributions have been key to developing a shared vision for NPR’s approach to culture. Ciera said, 'Everything I've done in my career has prepared me for this opportunity. As a longtime NPR listener and Virginia State University alumna, I am truly honored. I look forward to working with my colleagues network-wide to elevate NPR's culture coverage.' Ciera joined NPR in 2019 as a Producer, later becoming a Supervising Producer for All Things Considered before joining the culture desk in 2021. Please join us in congratulating Ciera on her promotion.

article_content: Lorena Ochoa, widely regarded as the world's best female golfer, revealed to CNN that meeting Tiger Woods in her youth inspired her to become the champion she is today. Ochoa and Woods first crossed paths as young competitors at the Junior World Championships, a tournament where Woods holds a record six wins and Ochoa five. Fifteen years later, both golfers met again at the Golf Writer's Association of America Awards in 2007, where each was honored as player of the year. In an interview with CNN’s Living Golf program, the 27-year-old Ochoa reflected on the impact of meeting Woods: 'You don’t realize the importance of things until you reflect back. I’m happy that things worked out for both of us.' Ochoa recalled, 'He was just a boy and I was a girl — we were both young and didn’t know what we were doing. I didn’t see him again for another 15 years, but when we met, I reminded him and showed him the pictures and he was amazed.' Beginning golf at the age of five, Ochoa has since claimed 26 LPGA Tour titles. Despite her success, she noted that staying at number one is more challenging than achieving it. 'It’s harder to remain number one than to get there—if you get distracted or stop practicing, you can quickly lose your spot,' Ochoa explained. Ochoa surpassed Annika Sörenstam to become the world’s top-ranked female golfer in 2007. Since then, she has won two major championships: the Women’s British Open and the Kraft Nabisco Championship. She also recently secured victory at the Honda LPGA Thailand and says her motivation to win remains strong. Ochoa shared, 'My life has changed a lot. I was preparing to reach this level, so it didn’t come as a surprise. It took me five years of being a professional to become number one in the world. It hasn’t been easy, but it’s been a lot of fun, and I want to stay here.' Her next major goal is the McDonald’s LPGA Championship, which will be held from June 11-14.

CNN-இன் Living Golf நிகழ்ச்சியில் 27 வயதாகும் ஓசோஆ, டைகர் வுட்ஸை சந்தித்ததில் ஏற்பட்ட தாக்கத்தை நினைவுபடுத்தினார்: 'சில விஷயங்களின் முக்கியத்துவம் போலிஸ் கூட முன்னோக்கி பார்த்தால் தான் புரியும். நமக்கு இது போல நடந்தது மிகவும் மகிழ்ச்சி.' ஓசோஆ கூறினார்: 'அவர் ஒரு பையன், நானும் ஒரு பெண் — சிறிய வயதில் இருப்பதால் எதையும் கவனிக்கவில்லை. 15 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு மீண்டும் சந்தித்தபோது பழைய புகைப்படங்களை அவருக்குக் காட்டினேன்; அவர் மிக ஆச்சரியப்பட்டார்.' ஓசோஆ, ஐந்தாம் வயதில் கூல்ப் விளையாட தொடங்கினார். தற்போது 26 LPGA டூர் பட்டங்களை பெற்றுள்ளார். வெற்றி பெற்றாலும், முதல் இடத்தை பாதுகாப்பது மிகவும் கடினம் என அவர் கூறுகிறார். article_content: A university student was shocked to discover that her Facebook profile photos had been stolen and used to advertise a casual sex website without her consent. Grace Marr, an English language student at Aston University in Birmingham, found out about the misuse when a friend of her mother's noticed her pictures in an online advertisement promoting 'hot singles in your area.' Three of Marr's photos were taken from her Facebook profile and used alongside the suggestive promotion. She only became aware of this after her mother’s friend, who works at a computer company, spotted the ad and reached out to inform her. Marr, 20, described her reaction as initially embarrassed and later increasingly concerned. She emphasized how unsettling it was to have her photos stolen and potentially edited for such uses, and she worried about the possibility that there might be further unauthorized uses she was unaware of. She spoke to student newspaper The Tab, describing the incident as 'creepy and gross,' and urging other young women to be cautious about their online privacy. Marr has since updated her Facebook privacy settings and advises others to regularly change their passwords and keep their social media profiles tightly secured. Marr hopes sharing her experience will help raise awareness about the risks of photo theft and encourage others to protect their online images and information.

article_content: NEW DELHI: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has issued a show-cause notice to Air India for failing to provide mandatory facilities to passengers who were either denied boarding or experienced delayed or cancelled flights. This marks the second time in eighteen months that the DGCA has taken action against Air India for this reason. Last June, the regulator fined Air India Rs 10 lakh for violating these rules and instructed the airline to promptly implement measures to address the issue, warning that further action would be taken if it failed to comply. In a recent statement, the DGCA indicated that Air India has not yet complied with last year’s directive.

The 54-year-old enjoyed local favorites like Mangalore buns, Mysore masala dosa, and masala chai, and later shared his gratitude and experience on social media. In his post, Rhodes explained that the man seated beside him wasn’t his driver but just another customer sharing his table, which is a common practice at local eateries. He mentioned that he had even first sat with two policemen and an airforce officer. His story received affectionate responses from Indian social media users, many of whom also reminisced about enjoying similar meals during their college days. A regular visitor to India, Rhodes has a daughter named India, and often delights in local experiences. Recently, he detailed a solo bike trip in Goa on a Royal Enfield, expressing his love for the everyday freedoms he enjoys in India.

article_content: Actor Daniel Escobar, best known for playing a teacher on Disney's 'Lizzie McGuire,' passed away in Los Angeles last Friday from complications related to diabetes, according to his agent. He was 49. Escobar featured in five episodes of the series in 2001 and reprised his role in 'The Lizzie McGuire Movie' (2003). His latest credited role was as a waiter in a 2011 episode of NBC's 'Whitney.' Throughout his career, Escobar made guest appearances in a range of TV shows, including as a photographer on 'Desperate Housewives' (2009), a chiropractor in 'Two and a Half Men' (2003), and a chef in 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' (2002). He also appeared in episodes of 'Weeds,' 'Charmed,' and 'How I Met Your Mother.' From 1999 to 2002, he played Lorenzo the waiter in four episodes of 'Dharma & Greg.' Escobar's film roles include portraying Emilio Ochoa in the 2001 movie 'Blow.' CNN's Carolyn Sung contributed to this report.

article_content: Nigeria's senior men's basketball team, D’Tigers, continued their remarkable run at the ongoing friendly tournament in China with a commanding 81-53 victory over highly-ranked Serbia, currently sixth in the FIBA world rankings. This follows an impressive 75-70 triumph against Team USA in their opening match of the tour. The D’Tigers began their China tour last week, with the series of matches scheduled to end on October 20. Although the team missed out on qualifying for the Paris 2024 Olympics during the August qualifiers in Lagos, the China Autumn Tour is one of several developmental programs initiated by the Nigeria Basketball Federation, led by Musa Ahmadu-Kida. Sponsored entirely by tournament organizers in China, the event gives a significant morale boost to players from Nigeria's local and international leagues, particularly after Nigeria ended its government-imposed ban on international basketball participation last year. In May 2022, supported by then-President Muhammadu Buhari, Nigeria's sports ministry withdrew all national basketball teams from international competitions for two years. This decision, prompted by ongoing leadership disputes within the Nigeria Basketball Federation and demands from players for better welfare, led to the formation of an Interim Management Committee.

article_content: A group of exceedingly rare bank notes from the 1880s, recently found in a U.S. banker's drawer, is expected to reach a total of $5.7 million at auction. These notes, originally worth $3,500, consist of three $1,000 bills and a single $500 note. The collection's standout piece is an 1882 $500 gold certificate—one of just two known examples—which alone could sell for $2.4 million. Remarkably, these notes have stayed in pristine condition for around 130 years. They include two 1882 $1,000 gold certificates and a 1890 $1,000 treasury note, with each projected to go for about $1.07 million. Gold certificates were once used as receipts by banks for gold deposits and later became legal tender, but a 1933 ban on private gold ownership rendered these notes illegal until the law was lifted in 1964. Heritage Auctions' director of rare currency, Dustin Johnston, commented that the $500 certificate is among the earliest made, and its only known counterpart is kept at the Smithsonian. He emphasized that such certificates were issued in limited quantities and suggested they survived due to simple oversight. Considering that $3,500 was a significant amount back then—when the average yearly salary was about $2,500—their survival is noteworthy. These historically valuable notes will be auctioned by Heritage Auctions in Orlando, Florida, on January 10, attracting much interest among collectors who await the final sale prices.

article_content: South Korea secured third place at the Asian Cup by defeating Uzbekistan 3-2 in Qatar, with Ji Dong-won scoring twice and Koo Ja-cheol opening the scoring. This victory means South Korea automatically qualifies for the next Asian Cup, to be held in Australia in 2014. South Korea dominated early, racing to a three-goal lead within 39 minutes, but Uzbekistan responded to create a tense final half-hour. After losing to Japan on penalties in the semifinal, South Korea started strongly, applying early pressure on Uzbekistan, who had previously lost 6-0 to Australia. Koo Ja-cheol opened the scoring in the 17th minute, finishing decisively after receiving a pass from Lee Yong-rae against Uzbek goalkeeper Ignatiy Nesterov. Ji Dong-won made it 2-0 ten minutes later with a composed low shot, and then scored again with a header in the 39th minute, putting South Korea firmly ahead. Uzbekistan found hope shortly before halftime when Hwang Jae-won fouled Timur Kapadze in the penalty area. Alexander Geynrikh's initial penalty was disallowed due to encroachment, but he converted on the retake. Geynrikh then scored his second by controlling a cross, beating Lee Jung-soo, and firing into the net, bringing Uzbekistan back into contention. Ji Dong-won hit the inside of the post in the 61st minute, and Uzbekistan mounted late pressure, but South Korea held on for the win.

article_content: Legoland Florida, the first Lego-themed outdoor park in the U.S. since Legoland California opened in 1999, opens this weekend in central Florida. Situated on the former grounds of Cypress Gardens—one of Florida’s earliest theme parks—the new park preserves much of the site’s historic charm and natural beauty. Cypress Gardens, popular in the 1950s and 1960s, was known for its Southern belles and legendary water-ski shows that appeared in movies and the Go-Go's 1982 'Vacation' music video. However, with the opening of Disney World in 1971, Cypress Gardens began to see declining attendance and ultimately closed in 2009 following several revival attempts. Legoland officials expressed excitement at acquiring the site, just an hour from Orlando. General Manager Adrian Jones commented on the site’s unique heritage and allure. While some critics questioned choosing a location associated with past failures, Jones believes the enduring popularity of Legos and the appeal of the gardens will draw visitors, citing strong annual pass sales. Legoland Florida honors Cypress Gardens’ traditions, offering a water ski show featuring a Lego pirate and greeting guests with a Southern belle made entirely from Lego bricks. Over the course of more than a year, Legoland transformed the 75-year-old park, updating facilities while maintaining the iconic cypress trees draped in Spanish moss. This week, annual pass holders got a sneak peek at the 150-acre park before its official opening. Families like Denise Valletutti’s expressed excitement for the park’s new attractions. As the largest of the five Legoland parks worldwide—which include locations in Denmark, England, Germany, and the United States—Legoland Florida is geared toward children ages 2 to 12 and features 50 rides and Miniland USA. Miniland USA showcases Florida landmarks, such as Kennedy Space Center, re-created in intricate Lego detail. Model building began two years ago, utilizing computer programs to translate designs into Lego bricks, and the models are reinforced with steel frames for stability. Park designer Bill Vollbrecht emphasized that all the Legos used are standard pieces available to consumers, making the experience relatable for children visiting the park.
