article_content: A father reported his son to the police after discovering nearly £3,000 had been spent on Xbox games using their family business’s credit card. Ian Holmes noticed that his 20-year-old son, Daniel Holmes, had made 77 transactions to Microsoft’s Xbox Live service. Although Daniel had been given access to the card for legitimate business reasons, he continued to use it without approval to buy gaming points and subscriptions. The expenditures, initially totaling £2,400, increased to £2,800 with interest and went unnoticed for much of 2013. Ian Holmes, who does not own an Xbox, realized the problem after spotting these charges on his statement. Prosecutor Lyndsey Baker told the court that, once confronted, Daniel admitted to the purchases but had no means to repay his father. Defense lawyer Tim Hook explained that Daniel had legitimate access at first, but misused it for repeated Xbox purchases, likening the behavior to gambling that escalated over time. Mr. Holmes initially asked his son to repay him, but, since Daniel was unemployed and unable to meet the £200 monthly repayments, the family had no alternative but to involve the police, leading to criminal proceedings. Probation officer Mel Wright stated Daniel’s actions seemed to spiral as he became more entrenched in making unauthorized purchases. North Devon Magistrates’ Court sentenced Daniel Holmes, from Ilfracombe, Devon, to 100 hours of unpaid community service and ordered him to pay £2,097.88 in compensation. Presiding magistrate Michael Buckley called it a ‘very sad case’, highlighting the unfortunate family situation.

article_content: Many Members of Parliament (MPs) skipped the final day of the parliamentary term as they began their six-week summer recess. At 4:19 pm on the previous day, the House of Commons was nearly empty as MPs left for their break. Speaker John Bercow officially adjourned the House at 5:20 pm, pausing all legislation, debates, and Prime Minister’s Questions until September 2. MPs state they will be working in their constituencies during the recess, especially with the general election less than two years away. Those with small majorities may use the time to connect with more voters. However, most MPs left early instead of remaining in Parliament. Prime Minister David Cameron, for example, was seen watching the cricket at Lord’s, marking the start of his summer holiday. He is anticipated to take breaks in Cornwall and Scotland. Reports indicate that both Cameron and his deputy, Nick Clegg, will be away at the same time, leaving William Hague and Theresa May in charge of government affairs. On the last day, only a few dozen MPs were present in the Commons to question Business Secretary Vince Cable at 9:30 am. By lunchtime, fewer than ten MPs were on the green benches, and by 5:00 pm, just three MPs remained before Parliament broke for the summer. In the 2012-13 session, the Commons sat only 145 times—the second lowest since 1945 for a year without a general election. Some predict attendance could be even lower this year. Matthew Sinclair, Chief Executive of the TaxPayers’ Alliance, noted that MPs should be active in their constituencies during the recess, but also raised concerns that the six-week break limits Parliamentary scrutiny. He said that important debates are often shortened and added, ‘This is bad for democracy, and reducing the length of recesses would allow more time for MPs to debate laws and hold the government to account.’ Since January, MPs have had a full five-day week in Westminster only eight times. Typically, they are in Parliament from Monday to Thursday and spend Fridays in their constituencies. Parliament had additional breaks in February, April, May, and June. Margaret Hodge, Labour MP and chair of Westminster’s spending watchdog, warned that the public views MPs as lazy and Parliament as providing poor value for money, particularly during a major economic crisis. She said, ‘Members of the public could be forgiven for thinking that MPs are lazy and that Parliament is not providing good value for money. We are not spending enough time in Westminster, and this creates a democratic gap.’

The European Union is evaluating a proposal that would bring kilometre-based road tolls to its member countries. The initiative seeks to make road pricing simpler and more consistent by having vehicles fitted with devices that track driving distance, ensuring motorists pay only for the kilometres they travel. EU Transport Commissioner Violeta Bulc, who is leading the discussion, says the system would unify current, fragmented road charging methods across Europe and make cross-border travel easier for both private drivers and freight operators.

The idea, however, has attracted strong opposition in Britain. UK government officials maintain that they do not plan to introduce such a tolling scheme and have described the proposal as unpopular. Robert Oxley from Business for Britain warns that additional tolls would burden UK motorists who already pay significant charges. Critics also argue that decisions on transportation policy should be managed locally rather than dictated by the EU.

According to Bulc, any new charging system would be based solely on the distance driven, not on how long someone spends on the road. She says discussions are still underway, including whether member nations like the UK might be able to choose whether or not to participate. The UK previously dropped a similar national road pricing project in 2007 due to widespread public resistance.

article_content: Many of the top-paying blue-collar jobs are skilled trades requiring technical skills and hands-on training, rather than a four-year college degree. These roles often offer substantial earning potential, sometimes exceeding six figures. The term 'blue-collar' can be traced to the early 20th century, referring to the durable blue fabrics—like denim or chambray—worn by manual workers to mask work-related stains. Blue-collar employees typically perform physical, outdoor tasks, often operating heavy machinery or relying on manual skill and strength. Common professions include electricians, welders, carpenters, plumbers, builders, landscapers, farmers, miners, and workers in manufacturing, factories, construction, and maintenance. Payment for blue-collar work is mostly hourly or per job, in contrast to the salaries and bonuses typical for office jobs. Much of the workforce gains expertise through apprenticeships, trade schools, or on-the-job experience, with many workers benefiting from union representation that provides job security, strong wages, and good benefits. Demand for skilled trades remains high, with these roles offering promising growth and earnings. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' National Occupational Employment and Wage Estimates, the highest-paying blue-collar jobs are identified using data from May 2022, released in April 2023, which reflect wage variations depending on location, experience, and sector.

article_content: Dr. Dara Norman, who serves as deputy director of the Community Science and Data Center (CSDC) at NOIRLab and is the president-elect of the American Astronomical Society, is passionate about access and equity in scientific research—issues frequently overlooked by those with privilege. Drawing on her background as an astronomer, she is committed to understanding and addressing obstacles that others face in the field. Whereas some scientists can work with physical experiments or samples, astronomy is fundamentally different: astronomers depend entirely on interpreting light from distant stars and galaxies. Dr. Norman notes that all information about these cosmic objects—such as their mass, temperature, age, position, and evolution—must be extracted from this light alone. Dr. Norman’s role involves ensuring other scientists can efficiently use telescope resources and analyze large astronomical data sets. As deputy director at CSDC, the central U.S. facility for optical and infrared telescopes funded by the National Science Foundation, she helps researchers gain access to telescope time through peer-reviewed proposals and supports effective use of both personal and archived data within the astronomical community.

Meta, Facebook's parent company, has decided to block political campaigns and advertisers in regulated industries from using its new generative AI advertising tools. This move comes as concerns grow over the potential for AI-generated ads to spread misinformation, especially during elections and within sensitive sectors.

The restrictions apply to areas like housing, jobs, credit, social issues, politics, health care, pharmaceuticals, and finance. Meta says these limitations are temporary and intended to help the company assess risks and build strong safety measures around the use of AI in sensitive ads. While the company already bans ads that promote information debunked by fact-checkers, it hadn't addressed the use of AI specifically until now.

Meta began testing its generative AI ad tools with selected advertisers earlier this year, and plans to make the tools available globally by next year—apart from restricted categories. The features allow advertisers to quickly create ad images, modify backgrounds, and generate alternative ad copies using simple text prompts.

Other tech companies are taking similar steps. Google has launched its own AI ad products and prevents political misuse by blocking political keywords and requiring clear disclaimers for AI-generated election content. TikTok and Snapchat have banned political ads outright, and X (formerly Twitter) has not introduced generative AI tools yet.

Nick Clegg, Meta’s head of policy, recently emphasized the need to update rules as AI's role in politics expands, pushing for new ways to identify and label AI-created material. Meta is also working on technology to watermark AI content and is preventing its AI assistant from generating images of well-known people.

Meta’s Oversight Board is reviewing the company’s treatment of misleading videos—such as a doctored video involving U.S. President Joe Biden—and considering whether exceptions for satire and parody should remain.

These efforts highlight the increased scrutiny on tech companies to curb misinformation and responsibly manage the growing influence of AI.

Marieme Jamme, born in Senegal, is a prominent leader in Africa’s technological evolution. As the CEO of Spot One Global Solutions, a UK-based firm supporting IT organizations’ entry into emerging markets, she encourages global investment in African IT infrastructure. Passionate about Africa’s future, Jamme frequently discusses what the continent needs and how she can contribute.

An international speaker, blogger, and co-founder of Africa Gathering—a platform connecting entrepreneurs and experts—Jamme works to ensure Africa’s narratives remain current and optimistic. “I try to protect Africa’s image and promote its positive stories because I see real potential,” she says.

Coming from a privileged background in Senegal, Jamme describes her early years as challenging, marked by a rebellious drive to succeed independently from her family’s influence. She moved to France in 1992 after her father’s passing, supporting herself with various jobs while pursuing her education. “I fought hard to become who I am. My passion for technology guided my path,” she reflects.

Jamme later settled in England, believing she could achieve more outside Africa, especially given persistent gender barriers on the continent. “In London, I have the freedom to make decisions and voice my opinions. I frequently travel to Africa to stay connected, but being based here allows me to advocate for change,” she explains.

She recognizes the transformative power of mobile technology and the expanding tech sector in Africa, which has improved lives and strengthened communities. Nevertheless, Jamme warns that increased investment interest demands cautious scrutiny of large organizations entering the African market. “Africa is now a prime investment destination. Ten years ago, few were interested, but today, everyone wants a stake because the tech industry is booming,” she observes.

For Jamme, ensuring Africa’s youth receive quality education is essential for creating new opportunities and fully utilizing technological advancements. Over the past five years, she has mentored young Africans, helping them launch businesses, strategize, and gain confidence on a global scale. She finds great fulfillment in empowering young leaders and driving progress on the continent. 

“I’m proud to have an African identity and to see our influence grow. We’re collaborating with governments and organizations to update Africa’s narrative, highlighting innovation and potential,” Jamme concludes.

Spot One Global Solutions என்ற ஐக்கிய இராச்சிய நிறுவனம் மூலம், அவர் வளர்ந்து வரும் சந்தைகளில் தகவல் தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் நுழைய உதவுகிறார் மற்றும் ஆபிரிக்க IT கட்டமைப்பில் உலகளாவிய முதலீட்டை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார். ஆன்மீக உற்சாகம் கொண்ட ஜம்மே, ஆபிரிக்காவின் தேவைகள் மற்றும் தன் பங்களிப்பு குறித்து திறமையாக பேசுகிறார்.

சர்வதேச பேச்சாளர், வலைப்பதிவாளர் மற்றும் விட்டியாசமான முயற்சி கொண்ட Africa Gathering என்ற தளத்தின் இணை நிறுவுனராகவும் ஜம்மே செயல்படுகிறார். “ஆபிரிக்காவின் நல்ல பெயரைக் காக்கவும், அதன் சாதனைகளைச் சொல்லவும் முயற்சி செய்கிறேன். எனக்கு இந்த கண்டத்தில் சிறந்த வாய்ப்புகள் இருப்பதை தெரிகிறது,” என்று அவர் கூறுகிறார்.

செனகலிலிருந்து செல்வாக்கான குடும்பத்தில் வந்த ஜம்மே, சிறுவயதில் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, குடும்பத்தின் ஆதரவின்றி வெற்றியடைந்தவர். 1992-ல் தந்தை இறந்த பிறகு, பிரான்சிற்கு இடம்பெயர்ந்து, பல்வேறு வேலைகளை செய்து கல்வியை முடித்தார். “இன்று நான் எனது கடினமான முயற்சியில் வளர்ந்தேன். தொழில்நுட்பம் மீது மிகுந்த ஆர்வம் எனக்கு வழிகாட்டியது,” என்று அவர் நினைவு கூறுகிறார்.

பின்னர் ஜம்மே இங்கிலாந்தில் குடியேறி, பாலின தடைகள் வசதியாக இல்லாத ஆபிரிக்காவைவிட அதிகம் சாதிக்க முடியும் என நம்புகிறார். “லண்டனில் சுதந்திரமாக முடிவெடுக்க முடிகிறது. அடிக்கடி ஆபிரிக்காவுக்கு சென்று, தொடர்பை நிலைநிறுத்துகிறேன். இங்கே இருப்பது எனக்கு பேசவும், எழுதவும், மாற்றத்தை உந்தவும் சுதந்திரத்தை அளிக்கிறது,” என அவர் கூறுகிறார்.

மொபைல் தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் வளர்ச்சியும், டெக் துறையின் வளர்வும் ஆபிரிக்காவில் வாழ்க்கையை மேம்படுத்தியுள்ளன, என்றாலும் மிகப்பெரிய நிறுவனங்கள் சந்தையில் நுழைவதில் எச்சரிக்கையுடன் இருத்தல் அவசியம் என்று அவர் எச்சரிக்கிறார். “ஆபிரிக்கா இப்போது முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு முக்கிய இலக்காக மாறியுள்ளது. 10 ஆண்டுகள் முன் எவரும் அக்கறை காட்டவில்லை; இன்று எல்லோருக்கும் ஆர்வம் அதிகம்,” என அவர் கூறுகிறார்.

ஆபிரிக்க இளைஞர்களுக்கு தரமான கல்வி வழங்குதல் வாய்ப்புகளை உருவாக்கவும், தொழில்நுட்ப வளர்ச்சியை பயன்படுத்தவும் முக்கியம் என அவர் வலியுறுத்துகிறார். கடந்த 5 ஆண்டுகளில் அவர் இளைஞர்களை வழி நடத்தி, தொழில்முனைவோராக உருவாக்க, வேளாண்மை மற்றும் தன்னம்பிக்கையை வளர்க்க உதவுகிறார். இளம் தலைமுறையை வலுப்படுத்தும் அக்கறையில் அவர் பெருமை அடைகிறார்.

“நான் ஒரு ஆபிரிக்கப் பெண் என்ற அடையாளத்தில் பெருமை படுகிறேன். நமது தாக்கம் வளர்ந்து வருவதை காண்கிறேன். ஆபிரிக்காவின் புதுமையையும், புதிய வாய்ப்புகளையும் முன்னிலைப்படுத்த அரசுகள் மற்றும் அமைப்புகளுடன் இணைந்து செயல்படுகிறோம்,” என்று ஜம்மே கூறுகிறார்.

UEFA president Michel Platini has expressed confidence that German Chancellor Angela Merkel would attend the final of Euro 2012 in Ukraine if Germany reaches the tournament’s climax in Kiev on July 1. Merkel, along with EU officials and other Western politicians, has threatened to boycott the month-long tournament—co-hosted by Ukraine and Poland—in solidarity with jailed Ukrainian opposition leader Yulia Tymoshenko.

In an exclusive CNN interview ahead of the Champions League final between Bayern Munich and Chelsea, Platini said, “I'm not worried about the situation. Politicians have their role, Ukrainians have theirs, and my role is not politics or religion, but to organize the Euro. Whatever politicians say, we’ll continue organizing the tournament. If Germany is in the final, I am certain Madame Merkel will attend.”

Merkel’s potential appearance would mark a shift from her earlier statements to the Bundestag, where she criticized ongoing oppression in Ukraine and Belarus.

No Regrets on Euro 2012 Hosts
Platini acknowledged awarding Euro 2012 to Poland and Ukraine was risky, but insists he has no regrets. “Four years ago, stadiums, roads, and accommodations were all inadequate. We took the risk and it was a good one.”

While coping with political fallout over Ukraine’s relations with the West, UEFA is also implementing Financial Fair Play (FFP) rules to keep clubs within spending limits. These rules are currently in effect and will be fully enforced in 2014. Questions have arisen about whether clubs like Manchester City—which spent heavily to win the English Premier League—could be excluded from the Champions League. Platini congratulated City but emphasized, “They know our expectations. If they meet FFP rules, they will play. Clubs had four years to prepare; we are not turning back.”

Opposes Goal-Line Technology
Platini, former French captain, remains strongly opposed to introducing goal-line technology, despite FIFA president Sepp Blatter’s support and moves toward adoption in the Premier League if approved by IFAB. Platini said, “I’m against technology in football. Approve goal-line tech, and soon it’s offside, then penalty area—there’s no end. Human officials are best. Fans want justice, but more referees offer that.”

Blatter wants goal-line technology at the 2014 World Cup, but Platini hopes for a change of heart. “I am football, he is political. He changes his stance. Last year, he was against, now for. Maybe next year, he’ll switch back.”

Champions League Final Outlook
Previewing the Chelsea-Bayern match, Platini believes the true finalists advanced, despite perceptions that Barcelona and Real Madrid were superior teams. “The results say it all: Chelsea beat Barcelona, Bayern beat Real Madrid. It’s been an unexpected, amazing year for the Champions League,” he said.

Next season will be the Champions League’s 20th anniversary. Platini named Liverpool’s 2005 triumph over AC Milan and Barcelona’s 2011 win over Manchester United as memorable finals.

article_content: Dyfed Powys Police, managing the largest policing region in England and Wales, have introduced a new patrol tractor decorated with official markings and blue flashing lights. While its top speed is only 20mph, the tractor is designed for use in the countryside, particularly in muddy or hard-to-reach locations. The force's aim is to improve relationships with rural residents in Mid and West Wales. Inspector Tim Davies emphasized the importance of connecting with these communities and encouraged people to openly discuss rural crime issues. Police plan to deploy the tractor when visiting farms or accessing remote areas beyond the reach of standard patrol vehicles. The initiative follows an increase in rural crime; thefts of farm equipment have risen sharply, and overall rural crime now costs the UK economy more than £40 million every year. The tractor, which was loaned to the force by a farm machinery firm, made its debut at the Royal Welsh Agricultural Show in Builth Wells. Local student Morgan Thompson, age 13, expressed excitement about the tractor, saying its impressive presence and flashing lights could be intimidating, regardless of its speed. In contrast, police in Manchester are considering the use of Segways for better officer visibility and mobility in urban areas. Recognizing the historic neglect of rural areas, Dyfed Powys Police have also set up a center focused on enhancing rural law enforcement.

article_content: Manchester City defender Pablo Zabaleta has emphasized the importance of both physical and mental sharpness when facing Barcelona—home to what he describes as 'perhaps the best strikeforce in the world.' Zabaleta gears up to take on his close friend Lionel Messi, alongside Barcelona’s formidable trio, in a Champions League clash at Etihad Stadium. Speaking ahead of the match, Zabaleta stressed, 'We’ll need to be at our physical peak to handle them. You have to put up a solid defence and restrict Suarez, Messi, and Neymar from having the space to create chances. They are among the best forwards in the world, and their attack is the envy of many.' The Argentine full-back, talking to El Mundo Deportivo, admitted, 'It will be a tough game. We’re confident we can achieve a better result than last year.' He also acknowledged that, despite early concerns over Barcelona’s form following the Christmas break, the team has recovered and produced a series of wins, trailing only a point behind Real Madrid in La Liga. 'The recent home defeat to Malaga doesn’t mean they’re in poor form—they’re playing well, they just lost that game. One result doesn’t change their status as one of Europe’s best teams,' Zabaleta said. Zabaleta highlighted Manchester City’s impressive 5-0 win over Newcastle as a confidence boost. He remains focused on controlling the game and keeping possession, noting the importance of defensive organisation and concentration. On Luis Suarez, Zabaleta observed, 'He is one of the best strikers worldwide. At Liverpool, he led the attack and was crucial, even while sharing space with Sturridge and Sterling. At Barcelona, he’s adapting, and despite not matching Messi and Neymar’s goal tally, he has made significant contributions. His recent goal against Levante shows his quality. I’m sure he’ll be important in this tie.' article_content: The United States faces critical choices on immigration reform. Its main challenge is managing unauthorized crossings at the southern border and addressing the presence of nearly ten million undocumented migrants, most of whom have lived in the country for over a decade. U.S. refugee policy is also an important factor. International Obligations and Refugee Protection As a signatory to the 1967 Protocol to the United Nations Convention relating to the Status of Refugees, the United States is obligated to protect those fleeing persecution and violence, regardless of how they enter the country. Though immigration laws and practices are evolving, debate continues over the scope of these obligations. Diverse Proposals and Controversies In Washington, D.C., immigration reform has often struggled to get legislative attention as other national priorities take focus. Former President Donald Trump has recently proposed strict policies, including potential mass arrests, detentions, and deportations of undocumented immigrants should he return to office in 2024. Trump’s Controversial Proposals Some proposals within the immigration debate include extreme measures, ranging from open borders to increased enforcement or even use of lethal force at the border. Trump’s approach focuses on heightened enforcement and deportations. Concerns and Responses Ben Johnson, Executive Director of the American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA), criticized these measures, warning against 'a return to a dark period of internment camps, ideological purity tests, and mass deportations that would harm American families, the economy, and our values.' Johnson further warned about possible violations of the 14th Amendment and creating a permanent underclass of non-citizens. He calls instead for rational and humane leadership. Balanced Approaches to Immigration Reform On the other hand, other immigration advocates recommend more balanced reforms—such as fixing the H1B visa program, protecting Dreamers, expanding humanitarian policies, connecting immigrants with American sponsors, and responding to the global crisis of displaced people. A Collective Effort for Reform Ultimately, meaningful immigration reform requires a blend of security and humanitarian values. Lawmakers and stakeholders must work together, prioritize bipartisan solutions, and dedicate the necessary time and effort for comprehensive change.

article_content: Hamburg is now home to the world’s first building powered by algae. Designed by Arup, this innovative structure is equipped with 129 glass-panel bioreactors on its southeast and southwest sides. Each panel, measuring 2.5 by 0.7 meters, contains microalgae that use sunlight to produce both biomass and heat, effectively supplying renewable energy to the building. Aside from energy production, these algae panels act as natural insulation and help muffle outside noise. The system is overseen by an energy management center that gathers solar thermal heat and harvested algae, storing the energy for future use in hot water generation. Jan Wurm, Arup’s Europe Research Leader, considers integrating biochemical energy systems into building facades a significant innovation. He believes this technology could offer sustainable energy solutions for urban environments. Arup's future-focused research imagines that by 2050, urban buildings will be dynamic and modular, with ‘living’ features that automatically adapt to weather and residents’ needs. Their concepts include maintenance drones, high-rise farms, walls with photovoltaic paint, and algae-powered energy cells—all aimed at greater efficiency and sustainability. As cities expand and populations become denser, Arup anticipates buildings of the future will achieve net-positive energy use, utilizing technologies like wind turbines, nanoparticles on walls to clean pollutants, advanced water recycling, smart systems, and integrated green spaces for supporting biodiversity. Surfaces may glow at night with energy-efficient organic LED lighting. At the same time, the construction company Mace, in partnership with EC Harris, is building the Kingdom Tower in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. article_content: As crowds gather at the National Mall to commemorate 50 years since the March on Washington, media discussions continue on whether the African-American community addresses violence within itself. This debate was revived by the tragic shooting of Christopher Lane, an Australian baseball player and college student, killed while jogging in Duncan, Oklahoma, on August 16. Following the arrest of three teenagers—first incorrectly described as all black, but actually two African-Americans and one white—the media drew comparisons to the previous year's shooting of Trayvon Martin by George Zimmerman. Despite both being tragic, such links often emphasized racial narratives rather than factual similarities. Reporting in both cases involved significant inaccuracies. In Martin’s case, Zimmerman was initially reported as white, fitting a narrative of racial profiling, though he identifies as Hispanic. Media outlets also misused photographs, such as wrongly depicting a white suspect in Lane’s case as black, or sharing unrelated images labeled as Trayvon Martin. Outlets including Fox News and The Daily Caller focused on the suspects' race in Lane’s killing, and criticized public figures like President Obama and Rev. Al Sharpton for not addressing Lane's murder as vocally as they did Martin's. Other details, such as a suspect’s past anti-white social media posts, further influenced public opinion. These incidents illustrate broader challenges in media coverage—real events often don’t fit neatly into established narratives, and selective reporting can reinforce stereotypes while overlooking important complexities about race, violence, and justice. Ultimately, these cases highlight the importance of careful, accurate reporting: avoiding bias, verifying facts, and resisting simplistic explanations that don't reflect the real stories or people involved. This commentary is the opinion of writer Eric Deggans.

article_content: Syrian state media report that Israeli forces launched missile strikes on the country's two main international airports, Damascus and Aleppo, temporarily putting them out of service. According to state media, the runways at both airports were damaged, and flights are being diverted to Latakia, a city in north-west Syria. Israel has not issued a comment about the strikes, but it has previously targeted locations in war-affected Syria connected to Iran. Iran's Foreign Minister, Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, was planning to visit Syria later in the week and had just arrived in Iraq as part of a regional tour that also includes Lebanon. Both Damascus and Aleppo airports accommodate civilian flights as well as military bases and are reportedly used as transit points for Iranian arms shipments to Hezbollah, a powerful group active in both Syria and Lebanon. A military source, quoted anonymously by Syrian state media, claimed the 'simultaneous' Israeli attacks damaged the runways at both airports, rendering them inoperative. The source characterized the strike as a 'desperate' attempt by Israel to divert attention from the ongoing conflict in Gaza. Iran's government, which is strongly opposed to Israel, expressed support for Hamas following its recent attack that killed 1,300 Israelis. Iran has condemned Israel's retaliatory airstrikes in Gaza, which have caused significant destruction. Palestinian officials report that more than 1,400 people have been killed in these bombings. Since the beginning of the Hamas assault, there have been some cross-border exchanges of fire between Israel and militants in southern Lebanon and Syria. Israel has deployed additional forces to the northern frontier in anticipation of possible attacks from Hezbollah. Iran, Hezbollah, and Russia remain key allies of Syrian president Bashar al-Assad in his conflict with opposition forces and the Islamic State (IS). Russia's foreign ministry condemned the Israeli missile strikes in Syria, claiming they endangered civilian lives and international air traffic. It further warned that such actions, in the context of the escalating Israeli-Palestinian conflict, could provoke dangerous regional escalation.

article_content: Authorities evacuated the small town of Northwood in northern Iowa on Thursday after a fire broke out at an agricultural chemical facility that stores sulfuric acid. The Iowa Highway Patrol, represented by Sgt. Scott Bright, reported that at least four people experienced breathing difficulties as a plume of smoke rose over the community, which is located near the Minnesota border. Worth County officials ordered all approximately 2,000 residents to leave Northwood and relocate to neighboring towns until it was safe to return. The facility involved deals in chemicals used for crop dusting, some of which contain sulfuric acid. Firefighters chose to let the fire burn itself out, with authorities stating that the smoke plume was not expected to threaten nearby communities. During the evacuation, residents were transported by bus to a community center in Kensett, six miles away along Highway 65. According to Don Preston, pastor at Bethel United Methodist Church in Manly, the center efficiently managed the influx, as many local residents had family or friends nearby who picked them up shortly after arrival. Northwood City Clerk Amber Julseth said around 230 people had been at the community center by early Thursday afternoon. Officials confirmed that everyone was safe and the evacuation order was lifted by midafternoon, as stated by Kensett City Clerk Lori McNalley. The incident echoed concerns raised by an April fire at a fertilizer company in West, Texas, where an explosion killed 15 people, mostly first responders. However, unlike the Texas incident, the Northwood fire resulted in no fatalities. CNN's Bill Kirkos contributed to this report.

article_content: Ronny Deila has spent most of his 38 years believing that his mother knew best, as she advised him that he couldn’t make a living from football and should pursue his education. Now, holding a green and white Celtic shirt as their new manager, Deila is proving her wrong. A qualified teacher, he balanced a playing career with his studies, never expecting football to become his profession. The Norwegian, formerly coach of Stromsgodset, is seen as a surprise choice as Celtic’s 18th manager. Some, like former striker Andy Walker, called the appointment 'underwhelming', especially for those expecting bigger names such as Henrik Larsson or Roy Keane. However, Deila presented himself at Celtic Park with quiet confidence, humility, and a willingness to learn. While many fans have praised the decision to 'think outside the box', some label Deila the 'cheap option'. The reality is that he represents a risk. He has never managed in the Champions League and must lead Celtic through three qualifying rounds in six weeks. Failure would bring immediate pressure. The question is how Deila, with no British football experience, will manage at a large club. At Stromsgodset, Deila led the team from 11th place to their first league title in 43 years after becoming head coach at 32. Critics note the lack of success among Norwegian managers in British football, pointing to Stale Solbakken, Egil Olsen, Henning Berg, and Ole Gunnar Solskjaer. Still, Deila highlights his unique approach and does not see himself as following in their footsteps. Expectations were for a Swede like Larsson or someone like Keane to replace Neil Lennon, but Deila stood out as a different choice, matching chief executive Peter Lawwell’s vision for the club. Deila’s salary is reasonable, he is experienced with limited budgets, and is known for developing young players and understanding the club’s financial strategies. After turning down Malmo last winter, Deila said Celtic 'felt right'. He also met major shareholder Dermot Desmond, who was quickly impressed. Initially considered for an assistant role, Deila was promoted to manager when Lennon left. His assistant is expected to be Scottish, with John Collins likely—a choice that will help him adapt to Scottish football's culture. Deila will not bring over his staff from Stromsgodset en masse, recognizing the importance of having Scottish and Celtic people involved. He speaks fluent English and German, is a father of twin daughters, and is a dedicated student of the game, having visited top European clubs to expand his coaching knowledge. A recommendation from Manchester City and visiting a Celtic-Barcelona match in Glasgow cemented Deila's admiration for the club. Inspired by the atmosphere at Celtic Park, he now aims to deliver quality football and create similar emotions for the fans as he leads Celtic forward.

article_content: Brittany Maynard, a 29-year-old diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, chose to end her life with the help of Oregon's Death with Dignity Act, according to Compassion & Choices. After relocating from California, Brittany passed away peacefully in the Portland home she had selected, surrounded by loved ones. News of her passing on Saturday quickly spread on social media, drawing widespread expressions of mourning. An official obituary shared Brittany’s final message, where she thanked her supporters and highlighted the power of gratitude and a positive mindset. Brittany graduated from UC Berkeley and earned a Master's in Education from UC Irvine. Prior to her diagnosis, she traveled extensively and volunteered at an animal rescue, living a life marked by compassion, education, and adventure. She is survived by her husband and his family, her mother, and stepfather. While she had hoped to have children, she reportedly had no regrets about the life she lived. Brittany’s story gained national attention after a video she posted explaining her choice reached over 9 million YouTube views. She became a prominent advocate for the 'death with dignity' movement, supporting the rights of terminally ill patients to choose how and when they die, though her stance also drew criticism. In her writings and videos, Brittany explained that moving to Oregon was necessary since death with dignity is only legal in a few states, and felt that this choice was right for herself and her family. She spoke openly about the difficulty of timing her decision, seeking to treasure each day but also fearing loss of autonomy due to her illness. By sharing her story and her experience with stage IV glioblastoma multiforme, Brittany Maynard became a significant voice in the discussion about end-of-life options.

Eric Trump, 30, son of businessman Donald Trump, has married Lara Yunaska in an elegant ceremony at Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach, Florida. The couple, together for six years, had their wedding at the Trump-owned estate this Saturday. Lara, who works as a journalist for CBS's Inside Edition and is a former personal trainer, attended the celebration with both wrists bandaged due to a recent riding accident, but appeared cheerful in photos shared by guests.

The Trump family, including Eric’s sister Ivanka Trump, attended the event. Lara wore a simple, elegant white dress and styled her blonde hair in a ponytail, clutching a glass of champagne. Eric, the youngest child of Donald Trump and his first wife Ivana, proposed to Lara last July at the Trump Seven Springs estate in Bedford, New York.

Wedding festivities started with a wine tasting at Trump Winery on Friday, followed by a black-tie ceremony at Mar-a-Lago and brunch on Sunday. Mar-a-Lago, built in the 1920s by heiress Marjorie Merriweather Post, is notable for its Mediterranean villa style and its expansive 62,000 square-foot estate on 20 acres. Donald Trump bought the property in 1985 and has renovated it with numerous amenities.

Lara, originally from Wilmington, North Carolina, graduated from North Carolina State University and the French Culinary Institute. The couple lives in New York City, often spending time with Ivanka Trump, Jared Kushner, and their children Arabella and Joseph. The wedding was planned by Jennifer Zabinski and event designer Preston Bailey, who worked to ensure Lara’s arm casts blended with her Vera Wang gown. article_content: Did you spot any birds today? Maybe a galah or a crow? If so, there's a good chance the bird you saw lives only in Australia. Of the approximately 850 bird species found in Australia, 45% are endemic, meaning they're unique to the country. The only other nation with more endemic bird species is Indonesia. Birds are the world's greatest travelers thanks to their wings. So why does Australia have such a high proportion of unique birds? The answer lies in climate and history. Over 45 million years ago, Australia split from Antarctica and moved northward. The journey and dramatic climate changes along the way shaped Australia's bird diversity. Originally, the continent was covered in lush rainforest, but as it drifted, the environment became much drier. Grasslands and eucalyptus woodlands began to spread. This drying wasn't consistent; especially in the past million years, ice ages brought alternating dry and wet periods—the most recent being the Holocene epoch, which covers the past 10,000 years. Beyond long-term changes, Australia's climate has always swung wildly from year to year, with long droughts and sudden floods. These conditions shaped which birds thrived. Australia's bird diversity partly comes from the original 'passengers'—ancient parrots and the ancestors of the world's first songbirds, including lyrebirds and scrub-birds. Both groups are highly adaptable, with larger brains compared to similar-sized birds elsewhere. As the climate dried, forest-loving birds were forced to the wetter edges of the continent, evolving into distinct species. When wetter periods returned, forests sometimes reconnected, but now held two or more separate species. A similar pattern happened with birds in arid areas, like grasswrens, which evolved into different species across isolated habitats. Parrots and cockatoos also diversified greatly, from tiny budgerigars to large black cockatoos. The ancient supercontinent Pangaea split into Gondwana and Laurasia about 200 million years ago. When Gondwana broke apart, continents like Australia began drifting north, carrying their unique animals. Unlike Africa, India, North and South America—which mixed their species after joining other landmasses—Australia remained largely isolated due to geographic and climate barriers. As Australia moved north, plate tectonics created islands that let Australian songbirds colonize Asia and beyond. Scientists believe all the world's 5,000+ songbird species originated from Australia. Few Asian or American species managed to colonize Australia, as those from tropical forests often couldn't handle Australia's dryness or evolutionary competition. Some, like certain finches, managed to arrive, but they are rare exceptions. Popular cage birds like budgerigars, cockatiels, and zebra finches come from Australia’s unpredictable arid zones, making them hardy and adaptable in captivity. They survive temperature extremes from -10°C to over 40°C and are opportunistic breeders. Australia shares many bird species with New Guinea due to being on the same continental plate, with shallow seas sometimes forming land bridges, enabling species like the cassowary to cross. Most other Australian bird groups, especially shorebirds and seabirds, face no water barrier. Still, most of Australia’s birds are found nowhere else, making them a national treasure to protect. குறிப்பாக கடந்த ஒரு மில்லியன் ஆண்டுகளில், பனிக்காலங்கள் உலர்ந்த மற்றும் ஈரமான காலங்களை மாற்றிக் கொண்டவை—சமீபத்தியது ஹோலோசீன் காலம், 10,000 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு மேல். நீண்டகால மாற்றங்கள் மட்டுமின்றி, ஆண்டுதோறும் ஆஸ்திரேலியாவின் காலநிலை கடுமையாக மாறுவது வழக்கம்; நீண்ட வறட்சியும் திடீர் வெள்ளமும் உள்ளன. இந்த நிலைகள் பறவைகள் எவை வாழும் என்பதை தீர்மானித்தது. ஆஸ்திரேலிய பறவை பல்வேறு வகைகள் அதன் காலநிலை மற்றும் பழம்பெரும் 'பயணிகள்' — பழைய காகா பறவைகள், உலகில் முதல் பாடும் பறவை முன்னோடிகள் (லைர்பேர்ட்கள், ஸ்கிரப்-பேர்ட்கள்) இருந்ததே பங்கு வகித்துள்ளன. இரண்டும் அதிக பழகும் ஆற்றல் மற்றும் மற்ற பறவைகளைவிட பெரிய மூளை கொண்டவை. காலநிலை உலரும் போதெல்லாம், காடுகளை விரும்பும் பறவைகள் ஈரமான பகுதிகளுக்கு நகரும் போது, தனி இனங்களாக மாறின. மீண்டும் ஈரமான காலம் வந்தால், காடுகள் மீண்டும் ஒன்றிணைந்தாலும், இப்போது இரண்டு அல்லது அதிக இனங்கள் உருவானன. அதே மாதிரி grasswren போன்ற உலர்ந்த பகுதிப் பறவைகள் தனிப்பட்ட இடங்களில் வேறு இனங்களாக மாறின. காகாக்காவும், cockatoos-உம் ரொம்ப விதிவித்தமுள்ளன—சிறிய budgerigar முதல் பெரிய black cockatoo வரை. பண்டைய பூமி பாங்கியா சுமார் 200 மில்லியன் ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு கொண்ட்வானாவாகவும், லூராசியாகவும் பிரிந்தது. கொண்ட்வானா பிரிந்த பிறகு, ஆஸ்திரேலியா போன்ற கண்டங்கள் வடக்கு நகர்ந்தன. ஆப்பிரிக்கா, இந்தியா, வட/தென் அமெரிக்கா - இவை பிறகு ஒன்றிணைந்ததும் முழுமையாகப்புள்ள வகைகள் கலந்தன. ஆனால் ஆஸ்திரேலியா, அதன் நிலபூமி மற்றும் காலநிலை தடைகளால் தனியாக இருந்தது. ஆஸ்திரேலியா வடக்கு நகரும்போது, பிளேட் இயக்கம் சில தீவுகளை உருவாக்கியது; அவை ஆஸ்திரேலிய பாடும்பறவைகள் ஆசியாவுக்குப் பறக்க அனுமதித்தன. விஞ்ஞானிகள் உலகளவில் உள்ள 5,000+ பாடும்பறவைகளும் ஆஸ்திரேலியாவிலிருந்தே வந்ததாக நினைக்கின்றனர். ஆசிய அல்லது அமெரிக்க பறவைகள் வற்புறுத்தப்பட்டு வந்தது குறைவே, ஏனெனில் அவர்கள் உலர்ச்சி மற்றும் போட்டிக்கு உடலை சமர்ப்பிக்க முடியவில்லை. மிகக் குறைந்த finches போன்றவை மட்டும் வந்துள்ளன. மிகவும் பிரபலமான கேஜ் பறவைகள் - budgerigar, cockatiel, zebra finch - எல்லாம் ஆஸ்திரேலியாவின் கடுமையான உலர்ந்த பகுதிகளில் உள்ளவை, அதனால் அவை வளர்ச்சியில் எளிதாக முன்னோடிகள். அவை -10°C முதல் 40°C வரை வெப்பநிலையிலும் வாழும் வல்லமை கொண்டவை, வாய்ப்புக் கிடைக்கும் போதே இனப்படுத்திக் கொள்கின்றன. ஆஸ்திரேலியா மற்றும் நியூகினி பல பறவைகள் பொதுவாக பகிர்ந்து வருகின்றன; இவை ஒரே கண்ட தளத்தில் இருப்பதால். பனிக்காலங்களில் கடல் அளவு குறைவதால் நிலப்பெயர்ச்சி ஏற்பட்டு, cassowary போன்ற பெரிய பறவை கூட அதைப் பயன்படுத்தி செல்ல முடிந்தது. பெரும்பாலான ஆஸ்திரேலிய பறவைகள் (கடற்கரை மற்றும் கடற்பறவைகள்) தண்ணீர் தடையால் பாதிக்கப்படுவது இல்லை. ஆனாலும் பெரும்பாலான பறவைகள் எங்கும் கிடையாது. நம்மைச் சார்ந்த treasure, பாதுகாப்பதும் நம் கடமை. இந்தக் கட்டுரை The Conversation-இல் இருந்து Creative Commons உரிமத்துடன் மீண்டும் வெளியிடப்படுகிறது. மூல அட்டிக்கலை காணலாம்.

article_content: A thrill-seeker has become the first individual in Cumbria to be fined for 'tombstoning'—jumping from heights into water—at a bridge known for its dangers and past fatalities. Michael Sharkey, 24, was seen repeatedly leaping from the 30-foot-high Devil’s Bridge in Kirkby Lonsdale. He admitted to violating a local bylaw and was fined £170, marking the first prosecution of its kind in the county. Devil’s Bridge, a 14th-century landmark, has long attracted people keen on tombstoning into the River Lune, despite a very limited area of deep water and numerous injuries over the years. Notably, 22-year-old Darrell Teal from Manchester died at this same location in July of the previous year. The hot summer led to more people attempting this risky activity, ignoring new warning signs posted by the local council. Sharkey, a resident of Gressingham Drive, Lancaster, pleaded guilty at Kendal Magistrates’ Court. Two other men from Rossendale, Lancashire (aged 24 and 33), are also facing prosecution. Inspector Paul Latham called tombstoning at Devil’s Bridge 'crass stupidity,' noting the dangers such as hidden rocks, miscalculating water depth, and cold water shock. He stressed that this was the first prosecution related to Devil’s Bridge and highlighted the increase in incidents during warm weather. Sharkey was caught after a local councillor witnessed his repeated jumps in August and alerted police, who quickly arrived at the scene. Since then, police, together with South Lakeland District Council, have ramped up enforcement and urged the public to report jumpers or to warn them about the risks. Authorities emphasize that keeping people safe is a shared community responsibility and call on everyone to help prevent future tragedies. Jumping from the bridge remains popular during the summer, drawing young people and spectators to the river banks. John Barwise from South Lakeland District Council stated that Sharkey’s fine was the direct result of a joint operation with police, aiming to send a clear message about the dangers and consequences of violating the bylaw. Elsewhere, tombstoning is common at locations like Plymouth, but the local police there prefer to issue safety advice rather than prosecute. The Maritime and Coastguard Agency warns that conditions can change rapidly and hazards beneath the water’s surface are often hidden. According to the Maritime and Coastguard Agency, tombstoning has claimed 20 lives and caused over 60 serious injuries in the past eight years. Deaths and injuries have included Darrell Teal at Devil’s Bridge and 15-year-old Daniel McCullagh, who drowned after jumping from a bridge in Northamptonshire last year. While no deaths from tombstoning have been reported this year, three injuries have occurred so far, and the risk remains high—especially during summer months.

இது சட்ட மீறலின் ஆபத்தும் அதற்கான விளைவுகளும் குறித்து தெளிவான செய்தி அனுப்புவதாகக் கூறினார். மற்ற இடங்களில், குறிப்பாக ப்ளிமதிலும், டோம்‌ஸ்டோனிங் பிரபலமாக இருந்து வருகிறது; ஆனால் அங்கு உள்ள போலீசார் வழக்கு பதிவு செய்யாமல், பாதுகாப்பு அறிவுறுத்தல்களை வழங்கவே விரும்புகின்றனர். மரைட்டைம் மற்றும் கோஸ்ட் கார்டு ஏஜென்சி, தண்ணீரில் உள்ள ஆபத்துகள் மற்றும் நிலைமைகள் எப்போது வேண்டுமானாலும் மாறக்கூடும் என எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். பொதுவாக கடந்த 8 ஆண்டுகளில், டோம்‌ஸ்டோனிங் 20 உயிர் இழப்புகளையும் 60க்கும் அதிகமான கோடீனமான காயங்களையும் ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது என்று மரைட்டைம் & கோஸ்ட் கார்டு ஏஜென்சி கணிப்பிடுகிறது. இதற்கு இடையே, டாரெல் டீலை தவிர 15 வயது டேனியல் மெக்கல்லாக்தும் நார்தாம்ப்டன்ஷையரில் உள்ள பாலத்திலிருந்து குதித்து உயிரிழந்தார். இந்த ஆண்டு உயிரிழப்பு இல்லாதபோதும், மூன்று காயம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாகவும், குறிப்பாக கோடை காலங்களில் ஆபத்து தொடர்கிறது.

President Joe Biden and China’s President, Xi Jinping, are meeting in San Francisco, marking a significant moment in U.S.-China relations. Their last in-person encounter was at the 2022 G-20 summit in Bali, amid rising tensions that have since persisted and were heightened by the alleged Chinese "spy balloon" incident.

A major agenda item is restoring military-to-military dialogue, which China suspended after then–House Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s 2022 visit to Taiwan. Experts warn that without such communication, the risk of miscalculation in sensitive areas like the South China Sea or Taiwan Strait grows. Lyle Goldstein of Defense Priorities notes that direct engagement can help moderate tensions.

Taiwan remains a central issue. While Taiwan is self-governed, Beijing insists on "reunification," warning the U.S. not to intervene. President Biden has signaled support for defending Taiwan, but his administration has sometimes clarified these remarks. With Taiwan’s election upcoming, discussions are expected to be heated.

China’s global posture is another focus. Despite professing neutrality in both the Russia-Ukraine and Israel-Hamas conflicts, the U.S. questions China’s diplomatic moves, particularly its regional influence and relations with Iran. National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan said Biden will stress to Xi the need for stability in the Middle East, especially regarding Iran.

Trade issues—including export controls, tariffs, and sanctions—are also priorities. Xi will address U.S. business leaders at a San Francisco dinner, signaling efforts to attract American businesses back to China. His outreach recalls earlier relationships with Americans, as emphasized by Xinhua, China’s official news agency.

A critical issue for the Biden administration is China’s role as a supplier of chemicals used to produce fentanyl in Mexico. The U.S. seeks greater action from China, hoping for progress during this summit.

Both leaders face domestic headwinds. Xi is dealing with an economic slowdown and recent protests against pandemic policies. A recent study estimates China may have seen approximately 2 million excess deaths after dropping its "zero-COVID" strategy. Biden’s approval ratings are low, and polling indicates Donald Trump is currently leading for the 2024 presidential race.

While neither side expects major breakthroughs, the summit is considered essential for managing tensions between the world’s two largest economies.

அமெரிக்காவின் ஜனாதிபதி ஜோ பைடன் மற்றும் சீனாவின் ஜனாதிபதி சி ஜின்பிங் சான் பிரான்சிஸ்கோவில் சந்திப்பது, அமெரிக்கா-சீனா உறவுகளில் ஒரு முக்கியப் படியாகும். அவர்கள் கடைசியாக நேரில் சந்தித்தது 2022 ஆம் ஆண்டு பாலி G-20 உச்சி மாநாட்டில். அப்போதும் அதன் பிறகும் இருதரப்பிலும் பதற்றங்கள் இதுவரை தொடர்ந்துள்ளன, குறிப்பாக சீனாவின் 'உளவு பலூன்' சம்பவம் இந்த பதற்றங்களை அதிகரித்தது.

இப்போது மீண்டும் இராணுவத்திலிருந்து இராணுவத்திற்கு நேரடி தொடர்புகளை ஏற்படுத்துவது முக்கியமான விவாதப் பொருளாக உள்ளது. முன்னாள் ஹவுஸ் ஸ்பீக்கர் நென்சி பெலோஸி தைவானில் விஜயம் செய்தபின், சீனா இந்த உயர்மட்ட இராணுவ உரையாடலை நிறுத்தியது. நேரடி உரையாடல்கள் இல்லாததால் தெற்கு சீனா கடல் மற்றும் தைவான் நீரிணை பகுதிகளில் தவறான புரிதல்கள் அதிகரிக்க வாய்ப்பு இருப்பதாக நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். நோக்குகள் மோதும் போது நேரில் சந்திப்பது பதற்றங்கள் குறைக்க உதவும் என்று Defence Priorities-ல் லைல் கோல்ட்ஸ்டீன் கூறுகிறார்.

தைவான் விவகாரம் இன்னும் முக்கியமாக உள்ளது. தைவான் தன்னாட்சி கொண்டது என்றாலும், சீனா அதை சீனாவின் ஒரு பகுதியாகவே கருதுகிறது மற்றும் மீண்டும் இணைப்புக்காகக் கோருகிறது; அமெரிக்கா தலையிடக் கூடாது என்று எச்சரிக்கிறது. பைடன் தைவானை பாதுகாக்குமாறு அமெரிக்க ஆதரவு இருப்பதாக சொன்னாலும், அவரது நிர்வாகம் சில நேரம் கருத்துக்களை இந்து செய்துள்ளது. வருகின்ற தைவான் தேர்தல் காரணமாக இந்த விவாதங்கள் மேலும் தீவிரமாகும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

ரஷ்யா-உக்ரைன் மற்றும் இஸ்ரேல்-ஹமாஸ் போரில் சீனா 'சுயநிலை' என்றாலும், அமெரிக்கா அவர்கள் நடவடிக்கையில் சந்தேகம் கொண்டுள்ளது, குறிப்பாக இஸ்ரேல்-ஹமாஸ் மற்றும் இரான் தொடர்பாக. தேசிய பாதுகாப்பு ஆலோசகர் ஜேக் சுல்லிவன், மத்திய கிழக்கில் இரானின் தாக்கத்தைக் குறைக்க பைடன், சி ஜின்பிங்கிடம் கோருவார் என்று கூறினார்.

article_content: Michael Tirrell James, who was taken in as a teenager by Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson, has spoken publicly about their relationship for the first time. In an interview with DailyMail.com, the 40-year-old James said, "If the Johnsons hadn't taken me in as a teenager, my life would look very different today. I would probably be in prison or I might not have made it at all." Johnson and his wife, Kelly, took James into their home in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, when he became homeless at 16. Although he lived with them as a son, he was never formally adopted due to what Johnson described as the lengthy adoption process, according to The New York Times. Over the years, James faced several legal challenges, including convictions for drug possession, retail theft, and violating a restraining order. Despite these difficulties, James expressed his gratitude, saying, "I always felt loved like I was a part of their family. They have been there for me when I have been lost and in the deepest valleys. I know it was hard at times to constantly help someone who didn't always get it right." Johnson, a Louisiana congressman and a Christian, told DailyMail.com, "God intended for Michael to be a part of our lives. Kelly and I have always seen him as one of our own. Despite any mistakes he's made, we love Michael and are blessed to have him in our family." According to Johnson's communications director, Corinne Day, James has stayed out of public political life as he now has his own family and prefers privacy. Johnson previously compared their experience to the movie 'The Blind Side,' which depicts a white couple taking in a Black teenager who becomes a football star.

article_content:
Foxconn, the world’s largest iPhone manufacturer, has expanded into space technology. Two prototype low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites built by Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., also known as Foxconn, launched on a SpaceX rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in southern California on Saturday. This event marks a significant step for the Taiwanese electronics company, which is diversifying as traditional sectors like smartphones and laptops face challenges.

Foxconn aims to showcase its satellite technology to meet the increasing demand for space-based communications. While SpaceX, under Elon Musk, has built and launched over 5,000 LEO satellites for its Starlink network, Foxconn is focusing on manufacturing satellites mainly for corporate and government clients. The satellites, jointly developed with Taiwan’s National Central University, are backpack-sized, weigh about 9 kilograms (20 pounds) each, and are equipped with cameras, communication devices, and other technology. They are designed to orbit Earth every 96 minutes at an altitude of 520 kilometers (323 miles).

Since Young Liu became chairman in 2019, Foxconn has prioritized diversification, focusing on electric vehicles, digital health, robotics, artificial intelligence, semiconductors, and communication satellites. Liu told Bloomberg Businessweek, “I needed to find something so that the company is able to grow for the next 10, 15 years.”

Bloomberg News estimates Foxconn’s revenue will fall about 6% this year to NT$6.2 trillion ($192 billion). The satellite business, analysts say, is less predictable than smartphone production, as clients order LEO satellites less frequently. Foxconn manufactures about two-thirds of the world’s iPhones.

Consultant Tim Farrar from Telecom, Media and Finance Associates notes that unless Foxconn finds steady new contracts, its outsourcing model faces risks. However, stable government orders could help Foxconn as it builds its satellite business. Farrar said, “Foxconn is thinking, if the Taiwanese government gives us a baseline of orders every year, that will be OK.”

Taiwan is developing its own LEO communication satellite to complement its internet infrastructure, aiming for space-based backups to undersea cables. Foxconn’s electric-vehicle business also benefits, as real-time communication is vital for connected cars, said Jason Wang at MasterLink Securities Corp.

Shiang-yu Wang, a research fellow at Academia Sinica’s Institute of Astronomy & Astrophysics in Taipei, said Foxconn’s electronics expertise is valuable for satellite production. He noted, “Taiwan is very good at making all different kinds of commercial electronics. These companies can easily pivot to space.”

உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய ஐபோன் உற்பத்தி நிறுவனமான Foxconn, இப்போது விண்வெளி தொழில்நுட்ப துறையில் கால் பதித்துள்ளது. Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. எனவும் அறியப்படும் Foxconn உருவாக்கிய இரண்டு குறுகிய பூமி காகிதக் குழாய்கள் (LEO) செயற்கைக்கோள்கள், கடந்த சனிக்கிழமை California மாநிலம் Vandenberg Space Force Base-இல் இருந்து SpaceX ராக்கெட் மூலம் வெற்றிகரமாக விண்ணில் அனுப்பப்பட்டது. இது Foxconn நிறுவனத்திற்கு முக்கியமான முன்னேற்றம்செய்தியாகும், ஏனெனில் ஸ்மார்ட்போன்கள் மற்றும் லேப்டாப்கள் போன்ற பழைய துறைகளில் சவால்கள் அதிகரிக்கின்றன.

Foxconn தனது செயற்கைக்கோள் தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் மூலம் விண்வெளி தொடர்பு தேவையை சந்திக்க முடியும் என்பதை நிரூபிக்க விரும்புகிறது. Elon Musk தலைமையிலான SpaceX, Starlink திட்டத்திற்கு 5,000-ஐ கடந்த LEO செயற்கைக்கோள்களை ஏவியுள்ளது. Foxconn நிறுவனங்களுக்கும் அரசாங்கங்களுக்கும் செயற்கைக்கோள்கள் உருவாக்குவது முக்கிய குறிக்கோளாக உள்ளது. Taiwan’s National Central University-யுடன் இணைந்து உருவாக்கப்பட்ட இந்த செயற்கைக்கோள்கள் பேக்க்பேக் அளவிலுள்ளவை, சுமார் 9 கிலோ எடையுள்ளவை மற்றும் கேமரா, தொடர்பு சாதனங்கள் உட்பட பல தொழில்நுட்ப கருவிகளுடன் வருகிறது. இவை பூமியை ஒவ்வொரு 96 நிமிடத்துக்கும், 520 கினீமீற்றர் உயரத்தில் சுற்றும் வகையில் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

2019-ஆம் ஆண்டு Young Liu தலைமையிலாக Foxconn, மின்சார வாகனங்கள், டிஜிட்டல் ஹெல்த், ரோபோட்டிக்ஸ், செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு, அரைமெட்டல்கள் மற்றும் தொடர்பு செயற்கைக்கோள்கள் போன்ற பல துறைகளை நோக்கி விரிவாக்கத்தை முன்னெடுத்து வருகிறது. “அடுத்த 10-15 வருடங்களுக்கு வளர்ச்சி அளிப்பதை உறுதி செய்ய புதிய வாய்ப்பு தேட வேண்டியிருந்தது,” என்று Liu, Bloomberg Businessweek-க்கு தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

Bloomberg News கணிப்பின் படி, Foxconn-இன் வருமானம் இந்த ஆண்டு சுமார் 6% குறைந்து NT$6.2 டிரில்லியன் ($192 பில்லியன்) ஆகும். செயற்கைக்கோள் தொழில் ஸ்மார்ட்போன் உற்பத்தியை விட எதிர்பார்ப்பு குறைவாகவே உள்ளது, ஏனெனில் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் LEO செயற்கைக்கோள்களுக்கு இடையே அதிக கால இடைவெளி விடுகின்றனர். Foxconn உலகளவில் தயாரிக்கப்படும் ஐபோன்களில் இரண்டு முத்திரையில் ஒன்றை உருவாக்குகிறது.

Telecom, Media and Finance Associates-இன் ஆலோசகர் Tim Farrar, Foxconn புதிய ஒப்பந்தங்களை வசதியாக பெறாவிட்டால், அவுட்சோர்சிங் முறையில் சவால்கள் எதிர்கொள்ளும் என்கிறார். இருப்பினும், அரசு ஒப்பந்தங்கள் Foxconn-க்கு செயல்பாட்டில் பாதுகாப்பளிக்கும். “ஒவ்வொரு ஆண்டும் தமிழ் அரசு நமக்கு அடிப்படை ஆர்டரா வழங்கினால் மட்டும் போதும்,” என அவர் தெரிவித்தார்.

Taiwan தற்போது LEO தொடர்பு செயற்கைக்கோளை உருவாக்கும் திட்டத்திலுள்ளது; இது உள்ளூர் இணையம் உபகரண அமைப்பை மேம்படுத்தவும், கடல் கேபிள்களுக்கு மாற்றாக விண்வெளி வழி இணைப்பைத் தரவும் திட்டமிடுகிறது. Foxconnன் மின்சார வாகன துறையுக்கும் இவை பயனளிக்கும், ஏனெனில் நேரடி தொடர்பு செய்தல் நிறைய முக்கியம், என்று MasterLink Securities Corp-இன் Jason Wang கூறுகிறார்.

OpenAI’s board of directors dismissed CEO Sam Altman last Friday, citing a lack of trust in his leadership abilities. Altman, notable for co-founding OpenAI and contributing to several influential tech companies, was unexpectedly replaced by Mira Murati, the organization’s former Chief Technology Officer, who will serve as interim CEO. The board stated Altman’s removal followed a comprehensive review, highlighting concerns over his transparency with the board, which they said limited their oversight. Murati, whose parents immigrated from Albania, was selected for her unique experience, and will manage the company's transition as the search for a permanent CEO gets underway.

Altman appeared surprised by the decision and shared his thoughts on social media, expressing gratitude and reflecting on the experience. Throughout his career, Altman co-founded Loopt, launched Tools For Humanity—a firm working on iris-based biometrics and cryptocurrency—and briefly served as Reddit’s CEO. OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which debuted in November 2022 under Altman’s guidance, rapidly gained worldwide popularity for its wide range of uses, prompting Altman’s global recognition and a world tour that included a meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. During his India visit, Altman faced criticism for comments suggesting India’s chances of creating a tool like ChatGPT were slim—a remark he later clarified was about the scale of investment, not about the country’s talent.

It is unclear whether Microsoft, a principal investor in OpenAI with an $11 billion investment, was consulted before Altman’s swift removal; however, the company endorsed Murati’s appointment. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella reaffirmed their strong partnership with OpenAI and confidence in Murati’s leadership for future development.

article_content: He always told Granville that the corner shop would one day be his. Now, after nearly 30 years, 'Open All Hours' is returning to television with a special Christmas episode, revealing that Albert Arkwright was true to his word. Sir David Jason will once again play Granville, who has now become the owner of the shop after Arkwright, originally played by Ronnie Barker, passed away and left it to him. Lynda Baron, 74, is returning as nurse Gladys Emmanuel in the upcoming episode. A source from the show said that other characters will mention Arkwright, and his picture will be seen on the shop wall. 'Open All Hours' originally aired from 1976 to 1985, with a total of 26 episodes filmed in Doncaster. At its peak, it attracted 17 million viewers and in 2004 was voted the eighth best British sitcom in a nationwide poll. The sitcom was known for Arkwright’s humorous attempts to impress Nurse Gladys and his miserly behavior as a shopkeeper. Every episode ended with Arkwright closing up the shop and reflecting on the day's events. Roy Clarke, who wrote the original series, has also written the new special. Sir David Jason, now 73, said there is still an audience interested in Granville’s story and described the special as a fitting tribute to Arkwright’s legacy. Clarke, known for 'Last of the Summer Wine' and 'Keeping Up Appearances,' expressed his enjoyment working with David Jason again and imagining the updated shop. Mark Freeland, the BBC’s controller of UK comedy production, hopes the new episode will bring joy to audiences this Christmas. In 2006, the shop used in the show—a converted hairdressing salon—was saved from demolition after local campaigns. Two years later, the shop was put up for auction but did not sell. The BBC announced filming of the Christmas special will start next month, but it has not yet been decided if it will take place in the original location.

article_content: For many cost-conscious consumers, keeping a car running for as long as possible is a significant financial concern. Automotive website iSeeCars.com, which aggregates used car listings, conducted a study on vehicle longevity based on the number of cars listed online with 200,000 or more miles on the odometer. According to the study, the Ford F-250 Super Duty topped the list, with 4.2 percent of its listings showing over 200,000 miles, as reported by CBS News. This represents about 4,000 pickups out of approximately 95,000 of that model for sale, according to Phong Ly, co-founder and CEO of iSeeCars. The analysis measured longevity by reviewing which vehicles for sale had the highest percentage of listings with over 200,000 miles. The results revealed that the top 10 rankings were dominated by large pickups and SUVs, with the Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD in second place. Phong Ly explained to CBS MoneyWatch, 'Clearly, some of these vehicles are used for work and are driven more miles, but they may also receive better maintenance.' Pickups are typically driven longer distances, with the average listing for all models showing 90,000 miles, compared to 75,000 miles for the average car. Among passenger cars, the Honda Accord ranked highest, with 1.6 percent of its listings exceeding 200,000 miles—about 6,000 out of 377,000 Accords for sale. However, this percentage is relatively low, partly because so many Accords are on the market. Other top cars for longevity (excluding trucks and SUVs) include, in order: Subaru Legacy, Toyota Avalon, Honda Odyssey (minivan), Nissan Maxima, Toyota Camry, Ford Taurus, Honda Civic, Acura TL, and Subaru Outback. While Ford and Chevrolet led the truck category, the Ford Taurus was the only Detroit-based car model to appear on the list. Recent improvements in manufacturing quality have contributed to more vehicles surpassing the 200,000-mile mark. 'Carmakers are producing better vehicles, which is a factor in increasing longevity,' said Ly. This has led to a market even for well-used vehicles. For example, a 2003 Ford F-150 with 228,000 miles is listed for $4,900, and a 2001 Honda Accord with 250,000 miles is available for $3,000. These prices represent about 10 to 15 percent of the list price for a new, well-equipped 2014 model of the same car. Experts note that the best way to help your car last as long as possible is to follow the recommended maintenance schedule and work with a good mechanic. They also suggest that some highway driving is healthier for the car than frequent short, stop-and-go trips, which can be harder on a vehicle.

Starting in January next year, Spotify will stop paying royalties to creators of songs that are streamed fewer than 1,000 times in a year. This new policy is expected to impact about two-thirds of the tracks on the platform, especially many lesser-known Broadway cast recordings. For example, the cast album of the 1989 Broadway revue 'Black and Blue', a past nominee for the Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album, gets less than 1,000 streams annually.

Mark Mulligan, founder of MIDiA Research, explains that until now, streams and revenue were linked for artists, but with this change, most will not be paid unless their tracks meet the threshold. Only streams beyond 1,000 will count toward revenue calculations.

Van Dean, president of Broadway Records, criticized this move, saying Spotify's model does not adequately support or reward artists, especially those with smaller followings. Dean urged Spotify to reward creators rather than reduce compensation.

Other music platforms like Apple Music and Amazon Music do not require a stream threshold for royalty payments. However, Spotify and social media have often helped lesser-known musicals, such as 'Be More Chill' and 'Hadestown,' gain attention and reach Broadway or mainstream audiences. Despite success stories—like 'Be More Chill,' which grew from a few listeners to over 150 million streams, and 'Hadestown,' whose off-Broadway cast recording sparked its success—many new works may not see royalty payments unless they gain big audiences. Under Spotify's updated rule, creators of smaller musicals may need to find new ways to earn from their work if their tracks do not reach 1,000 streams each year.

பிராட்வே ரெக்கார்ட்ஸ் தலைவர் வான் டீன், இந்த மாற்றத்தைக் கண்டித்து, ஸ்பாட்டிஃபை சிறிய ரசிகர்கள் உள்ள கலைஞர்களை போதுமான முறையில் ஊக்குவிக்கவில்லை எனக் கூறுகிறார். கலைஞர்களை மேலும் ஊக்குவிக்க ஸ்பாட்டிஃபை முயற்சி செய்ய வேண்டும் எனவும் அவர் வலியுறுத்துகிறார்.

ஆப்பிள் மியூசிக், அமேசான் மியூசிக் போன்ற மற்ற தளங்களில் இந்த மாதிரியான குறைந்தபட்ச நிபந்தனைகள் கிடையாது. ஆனால், ஸ்பாட்டிஃபை மற்றும் சமூக ஊடகம் வழியாக 'பி மோர் சிலில்', 'ஹேட்ஸ்டவுன்' போன்ற குறைந்தபட்ச பரிச்சயம் கொண்ட இசைகள் பெரிய ரசிகர்களைப் பெற்றுக் கொண்டுள்ளன. 'பி மோர் சிலில்' ஆரம்பத்தில் சிலரால் மட்டுமே கேட்கப்பட்டாலும், தற்போது 150 மில்லியன் ஸ்ட்ரீம் கடந்து வளர்ந்தது; 'ஹேட்ஸ்டவுன்' நிகழ்வுகளும் பிராட்வே பெரும்பான்மையில் புகழ் பெற்றதற்கு உதவியது. ஆனால் இந்த புதிய விதியின் கீழ், பெரும் ரசிகர் ஆதரவை பெறாத படைப்பாளிகளுக்கு ராயல்டி கிடைக்க வாய்ப்பில்லை.

article_content: Pepper X has officially been recognized as the world's hottest chili pepper by Guinness World Records. Developed by Ed Currie, owner of Puckerbutt Pepper Company, Pepper X surpasses the previous record holder, the Carolina Reaper, which Currie also bred. Pepper X measures 2,693,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU), a system for measuring the level of capsaicinoids, the compounds responsible for a pepper’s spiciness. For comparison, jalapeño peppers rate between 2,000 and 8,000 SHU, while self-defense pepper spray is about 2.2 million SHU. Ed Currie described his experience with Pepper X: 'I was feeling the heat for three and a half hours. Then the cramps came. Those cramps are horrible. I was laid out flat on a marble wall for about an hour in the rain, groaning in pain,' he told the Associated Press. Many believe a pepper’s seeds cause its heat, but in reality, capsaicin is concentrated in the placenta, the tissue holding the seeds. Pepper X has a uniquely bumpy exterior with many curves and ridges, which increases the inner area where the placenta forms. Currie bred Pepper X for over ten years, cross-breeding his hottest peppers to increase its capsaicin content. (Source: Popular Science).
translated_content: பெப்பர் எக்ஸ் உலகின் மிகுந்த காரம் உள்ள மிளகாய் என கின்னஸ் உலக சாதனை புத்தகத்தில் அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பக்கர்பட் பெப்பர் கம்பனியின் உரிமையாளர் எட் க்யூரி உருவாக்கிய இந்த மிளகாய், கடந்த சாதனை படைத்த கரோலைனா ரீப்பரை (அதைப் பிறிதும் அவரே உருவாக்கினார்) பின்னுக்குத்தள்ளியுள்ளது. பெப்பர் எக்ஸ்-இன் ஸ்கொவிள் ஹீட் யூனிட்ஸ் (SHU) மதிப்பு 2,693,000; இது மிளகாய்களில் உள்ள கப்செய்சினைக் அளக்கும் அளவு. ஒப்பிடுகிறோம் என்றால், ஜலப்பீனோ மிளகாய் 2,000-8,000 SHU மட்டும் இருக்கும், ஆனாலும் பெப்பர் ஸ்ப்ரே சுமார் 2.2 மில்லியன் SHU ஆகும். பெப்பர் எக்ஸ் சாப்பிட்ட அனுபவத்தை எட் க்யூரி விவரிக்கும் போது: 'மூன்று மணி நேரத்திற்கு மேலாக அது காரமாக இருந்தது. பிறகு வயிற்று வலி வந்தது. அந்த வலி மோசமானது. நான் ஒரு மணி நேரம் மழையில் ஒரு மார்பிள் சுவற்றில் கிடந்தேன், வலியில் நொந்து விட்டேன்,' என்று அவர் அசோசியேட்டட் பிரஸ்ஸிடம் கூறினார். பலர் மிளகாயின் விதைகள் தான் காரத்தினை கொடுக்குமென நம்புகிறார்கள், ஆனால் உண்மையில் கப்செய்சின் என்பது விதைகளை கொண்டிருக்கும் பிளாசென்டா பகுதியில் அதிகம் உள்ளது. பெப்பர் எக்ஸ் அதிக வளைவுகளும் குழிவுகளும் கொண்டது என்பதால், பிளாசென்டா உருவாக இடம் அதிகம் உள்ளது. எட் க்யூரி தன் மிக காரமான மிளகாய்களுடன் பத்து ஆண்டுகளுக்கும் மேலாக கிராஸ்-ப்ரீடிங் செய்து, அதன் கப்செய்சின் அளவை அதிகப்படுத்திக்கொண்டார். (மூலம்: Popular Science).

article_content: Stoke City secured a 1-1 draw at Newcastle United after Peter Crouch scored a last-minute header in stoppage time during their Premier League match at St James’ Park. The dramatic equalizer prevented an escalation of frustration for Stoke manager Mark Hughes, who was upset by a controversial decision by the referee. Controversy arose when Newcastle’s Jack Colback, already on a yellow card, fouled Victor Moses, but referee Kevin Friend opted not to give him a second booking. Moments later, Colback went on to put Newcastle in front with a goal in the 74th minute. Hughes argued that Colback should have been sent off and that Stoke would have had a better chance to win with Newcastle down to ten men. After the game, Hughes expressed his displeasure, stating that the referee should have made a braver decision. Interestingly, Colback conceded in his post-match comments that he would not have been surprised to receive a second yellow card for his actions. Stoke’s equalizing goal came in added time when substitute Crouch headed in a cross from Geoff Cameron, beating goalkeeper Tim Krul. Hughes praised Crouch for his impact off the bench and highlighted his crucial role at the club. Newcastle boss John Carver, meanwhile, was unhappy with his team's late-game decision-making and felt they lost control after taking the lead. Missed opportunities by Gabriel Obertan and Ayoze Perez prevented Newcastle from sealing the win before Crouch scored. The match saw limited excitement in the early stages but picked up energy in the final 15 minutes following the refereeing controversy and late drama. Victor Moses stood out as Man of the Match, and the draw left Stoke in 10th and Newcastle in 11th place in the league. There was clear disagreement between the managers regarding the referee’s decisions, with Carver defending both Colback and the officiating, while Hughes insisted the outcome was affected by the missed red card. The match, witnessed by almost 48,000 fans, featured several bookings and ended with Stoke rescuing a point at the last moment.
translated_content: பிரீமியர் லீக் போட்டியில் நியூகாஸில் யுணைடெட் மீது ஸ்டோக் சிட்டி 1-1 என்ற சமநிலையை பதிவு செய்தது, இறுதி நேரத்தில் பீட்டர் கிரௌச் தனது தலைப்பாய்ச்சியால் ஒரு புள்ளியை காப்பாற்றினார். இந்த டிராமாவான சமநிலையால் ஸ்டோக் மேலாளர் மார்க் ஹ்யூஸின் கோபம் மேலும் அதிகமாகவில்லை, ஏனெனில் மையப்புள்ளியான ஒரு வாதத்திற்குரிய விவகாரத்தில் அவர் ஏற்கனவே கடுமையாக இருந்தார். நியூகாஸிலின் ஜாக் கோல்பெக் ஏற்கனவே ஒரு மஞ்சள் அட்டை பெற்றிருந்த நிலையில், விக்டர் மோசசை குறுக்கீடு செய்தார். ஆனால் ரெஃபரி கேவின் ஃப்ரண்ட் அவருக்கு இரண்டாவது மஞ்சள் அட்டை வழங்கவில்லை. சில நிமிடங்களிலேயே கோல்பெக் 74வது நிமிடத்தில் நியூகாஸிலுக்கு முன்னிலை பெற்றார். ஹ்யூஸ், கோல்பெக் வெளியேற்றப்பட்டிருக்க வேண்டும் என்றும் நியூகாஸில் பத்துப்பேராக இருந்திருந்தால் ஸ்டோக் வெல்வதற்கான வாய்ப்பு அதிகமாக இருந்திருக்கும் என வாதிட்டார். போட்டி முடிந்தபின், ஹ்யூஸ் தனது அதிருப்தியை வெளிப்படுத்தினார்; Kim Jong-Un, the leader of North Korea, has been photographed for the first time inside his private aircraft—a Soviet-era Ilyushin IL-62, nicknamed "Air Force Un." Unlike its standard design, which can seat up to 200 passengers, this aircraft has been customized to serve only Kim and his trusted aides, drawing comparisons to the U.S. President’s Air Force One.

The state-run Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) released images showing Kim during a tightly controlled flight to inspect new university apartment blocks in Pyongyang. These inspections coincided with preparations for the anniversary of his father Kim Jong-Il's birth.

The IL-62 model first flew in 1963 and was, at its inception, the world's largest jet airliner. Although once common in countries like the Soviet Union and Czechoslovakia, it has become outdated, with second-hand versions now available for prices as low as £65,000. Some customized or well-preserved models are valued higher.

Kim Jong-Un’s use of a private jet marks a shift from his father, Kim Jong-Il, who avoided flying and preferred traveling by armored train due to a fear of flight. The recent images of Kim aboard his jet were released alongside photos of him touring newly constructed science-themed apartment blocks intended for scientists at Kim Chaek University of Technology, located along the Taedong River in Pyongyang. This university is named after a North Korean general who fought alongside Kim Il-Sung, Kim Jong-Un's grandfather, against Japanese occupation.

State media also showed Kim attending a memorial ceremony at Kumsusan Palace, accompanied by senior military officials, to honor the anniversary of Kim Jong-Il’s birth. North Korea commemorated the occasion with fireworks, military promotions, and public pledges of loyalty to Kim Jong-Un.

The Kim dynasty has maintained a strong personality cult since Kim Il-Sung established it in 1948, continuing through successive generations. Although there are claims that Kim Jong-Un might sometimes pilot the jet himself, it is unclear whether he holds an official pilot’s license.

The release of these images drew international attention, both for the rarity of glimpsing North Korea’s leadership in such a setting and due to ongoing concerns regarding luxury and human rights issues under Kim Jong-Un’s rule.

Peaches Geldof, who died at just 25, was recognized for her ongoing fascination with occult practices, particularly her involvement with Ordo Templi Orientis (OTO), a secretive spiritual organization that concerned her family. A few weeks before her passing, Peaches shared a photo on Twitter of her bookshelves stacked with works by Aleister Crowley—the British occultist credited as the OTO’s founder. She also celebrated Crowley as a remarkable thinker and writer.

Peaches’ engagement with OTO followed earlier explorations of alternative spiritual paths, including a brief interest in Scientology after talking to actress Katie Holmes and an openness to Judaism, the faith of her husband Thomas Cohen. She marked her commitment to OTO with a heart-shaped tattoo featuring its initials on her arm.

Aleister Crowley, influential in the early 1900s, attracted notoriety for his unconventional personal life, which included drug use and ritual practices. He developed the religion Thelema, which emphasized individual will, and infused OTO teachings with its philosophies. Crowley’s legacy remains divisive—while some criticize his lifestyle, others view him as a pioneer in modern esoteric and countercultural movements.

Peaches often promoted Crowley’s writings to her social media audience, posting passages such as 'Do what thou wilt,' a core Thelema belief. She denied claims linking Crowley to satanism, explaining his beliefs were unconnected to Christian traditions, and defended him from allegations of racism, suggesting these were false stories spread by the press.

Her public interest in OTO prompted concern from her family. Jeanne Marine, her father’s partner, expressed doubts about whether Peaches’ dedication was fleeting or serious, with her tattoo suggesting stronger commitment.

John Bonner, leader of the OTO in Britain, stated that membership is relatively small and much misunderstood. He dismissed outlandish rumors about Crowley, noting that the group values privacy and requires new members to undergo a thorough initiation and study period. Notable public figures such as Jay-Z and Led Zeppelin’s Jimmy Page have also been associated with OTO.

article_content: Canada's Supreme Court has struck down several key laws governing prostitution. While exchanging sex for money has not been illegal in Canada, three specific laws had previously made it difficult for sex workers to operate safely. One law banned the operation of brothels. Another made it illegal for anyone, such as a driver, bookkeeper, or bodyguard, to earn income by working for a prostitute. A third law prohibited communicating in public about prostitution. On Friday, the Supreme Court, led by Chief Justice Beverley McLachlin, unanimously ruled to suspend these laws, allowing Parliament one year to amend or replace them. McLachlin emphasized that regulating prostitution is complex and requires careful consideration. According to the Toronto Star, if the federal government fails to introduce new legislation within 12 months, sex workers will be allowed to legally work together, hire support workers, and openly screen clients for safety. The court noted that the purpose of these laws was to target pimps and exploitative practices. However, the laws were criticized for being overbroad, penalizing not only exploiters but also individuals who could help protect sex workers, such as legitimate drivers or bodyguards. Regarding solicitation, the law aimed not to eradicate street prostitution but to remove it from public view in order to prevent related nuisances, according to the court. CBC News, citing a criminologist, reported that Parliament could respond by criminalizing the buying or selling of sex, regulating where prostitution occurs, or choosing to do nothing. In the absence of federal action, provinces and municipalities may establish their own rules.
