During World War I, Private James Bell, originally a driver for the Australian Army, became the last survivor among five brothers who all volunteered to serve. The tragedy that struck the Bell family began when Laurie, the youngest, died at Gallipoli in December 1915, followed by John in Flanders later that month. Their eldest brother Joseph was killed in Flanders in June 1917 after being struck by a bomb, while the fate of Herbert remains uncertain, recorded as having perished in a prisoner of war camp under unknown circumstances.

James and his younger brother Laurie had emigrated from Keighly, West Yorkshire, to Australia in 1913, but with the outbreak of the war, all five brothers enlisted—three from their hometown, and James and Laurie from Australia. After months serving as a driver, ferrying wounded soldiers to and from hospitals in France, James was the only Bell brother left alive by the end of 1917.

Deeply distressed by the loss of her siblings, Annie Bell wrote an impassioned letter to the War Office describing her family’s sacrifice and pleaded for James' release. Her request, highlighting that James was the last surviving brother and had a young family at home receiving no separation allowance, ultimately moved army officials to act. In January 1918, James was allowed to return to England, and by March, he had reunited with his wife and two children in Australia.

The Bell family’s story was largely unknown until uncovered by the local history group Men of Worth, led by Andy Wade, and shared publicly by Jayne Pickard, great-granddaughter of Joseph Bell. Jayne, who still lives near the Bell family’s childhood home in Keighly, reflected on the mix of pride and sadness in her family’s history. James Bell went on to live his remaining years in Australia, passing away from natural causes.

முதல் உலகப் போர் காலத்தில், ஆஸ்திரேலிய இராணுவ டிரைவராக இருந்த ஜேம்ஸ் பெல், சேவையில் இருந்த ஐந்து சகோதரர்களில் கடைசியாக உயிர் வாழ்ந்தவர் ஆனார். பெல் குடும்பத்தைோதான துயரம், இளையவன் லாரி 1915 டிசம்பரில் கலிப்போலியில் உயிரிழந்ததுடன் தொடங்கியது; அதனை அடுத்து அதே மாதம் ஜான் ஃப்லாண்டர்ஸில் உயிரிழந்தார். மூத்த சகோதரர் ஜோசப் 1917 ஜூனில் ஃப்லாண்டர்ஸில் குண்டு வீழ்ச்சியால் உயிரிழந்தார்; ஹெர்பர்டின் விதி தெளிவாகத் தெரியவில்லை, அவர் சிறை முகாமில் உயிரிழந்ததாக பதிவு செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

சகோதரர்களை இழந்த துயரால் ஆனி பெல் வார்மண்டபுக்கு உருகி எழுதிய கடிதம், குடும்பத்துக்கு நேர்ந்த தியாகத்தை விவரித்து, ஜேம்ஸை விடுதலை செய்ய வேண்டினார். ஜேம்ஸ் இராணுவ சேவையில் கடைசி வாழும் சகோதரர் என்றும், குடும்பம் எந்தப் பிரிவுத் தொகையும் பெறவில்லையெனவும் அவர் குறிப்பிடினார். இந்தக் கடிதம் அதிகாரிகளை மிகுந்த பாதிப்படைய செய்தது. 1918 ஜனவரியில் ஜேம்ஸ் இங்கிலாந்துக்கு அனுப்பப்பட்டார்; மார்சில் தனது மனைவி மற்றும் இரு பிள்ளைகளுடன் ஆஸ்திரேலியாவுக்குத் திரும்பினார்.

Zach Tahir, a six-year-old boy from Salford, Greater Manchester, is celebrating his birthday with the unveiling of a unique 'inedible' bedroom. Zach has a rare eating disorder known as Pica, which causes him to crave and consume non-food items such as stones, paper, moss, and even plaster from the walls. His mother, Rachel Horn, age 32, has witnessed Zach chew through plasterboard, blinds, and various household objects, describing his urge to eat inedible items as limitless.

To keep Zach safe, his new bedroom was custom-built with squash-court-style walls that are difficult to bite through, rounded furniture edges to prevent injury, and specially designed window sills and blinds that Zach cannot climb or access. The total cost of the room was £36,000, with £26,000 provided by Salford Council as part of a disability allowance and an additional £10,000 raised through charitable donations. The fundraising campaign received notable support from Coronation Street cast members, actor John Henshaw, and comedian John Bishop.

Rachel, who left her banking job to care for Zach, expressed gratitude for the community's help. She explained that managing Zach’s condition is a constant worry, as Pica can be dangerous and lead to health problems like choking, poisoning, or infection. Despite his lifelong struggle with Pica and autism, Zach has never required medical treatment; however, Rachel closely monitors him using CCTV installed in his new room, which she can access via her smartphone to ensure his safety without causing distress.

Pica is an eating disorder affecting up to 30% of children aged one to six. It often appears in individuals with developmental disabilities but can also present during pregnancy, after brain injury, or in those with certain deficiencies. While the disorder sometimes resolves on its own, treatment may involve nutritional supplements, medication, or behavioral interventions.

Rachel hopes Zach’s new room will help him settle at night and improve his quality of life, providing security and peace of mind for the whole family.

Ferrari, the iconic Formula One team based in Maranello, Italy, has unveiled their new F14 T car, aiming for success in the upcoming season. The reveal, held online on Saturday, follows a series of major technical changes in the 2014 F1 season. This year, teams must use smaller 1.6-liter V6 turbo engines, replacing last year’s 2.4-liter V8s, introducing significant changes beneath similar exteriors. Additional updates include reengineered rear wings, the debut of a new Energy Recovery System, and a strict 100-kilogram fuel limit per race. The nose cone has also been lowered and narrowed for 2014.

Ferrari features a fresh driver lineup this season, welcoming back 2007 World Champion Kimi Raikkonen, who takes the seat of Felipe Massa and joins Fernando Alonso. Both Raikkonen and Alonso are optimistic about bringing championship glory back to Ferrari. The F14 T is the 60th car Ferrari has produced for F1 and its name was chosen by fans through an online poll. Team principal Stefano Domenicali credited the high fan engagement as added motivation for a successful year.

McLaren, another leading F1 team, revealed their new MP4-29 car a day earlier, eager to move past a disappointing 2013 campaign. The team finished fifth in the standings last year and aims to adapt to the sweeping regulations with a practical and measured approach. Jonathan Neale, McLaren Racing’s managing director, stressed the challenge of adjusting to the new rules and emphasized consistent performance over immediate speed during the initial tests. Veteran driver Jenson Button, now partnered with rookie Kevin Magnussen, expressed excitement about learning the new formula and making steady progress leading up to the season opener.

Preparations for the season begin with testing in Jerez, Spain, at the end of January. The first race is scheduled for March 16 in Melbourne, Australia.

article_content: FIFA's decision to host the 2030 World Cup across six countries, requiring fans and teams to travel to more than 100 games, is expected to increase the event's carbon footprint, raising concerns among experts about its alignment with FIFA's climate commitments. FIFA recently announced that Spain, Portugal, and Morocco will host the majority of the 2030 World Cup, while Uruguay, Argentina, and Paraguay will each stage one match to commemorate the tournament's 100th anniversary. After three matches are played in South America on June 8-9, 2030, the tournament will shift to Spain, Portugal, and Morocco. This structure will necessitate several trans-Atlantic flights for both teams and fans. This format contrasts with the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, where all 64 matches were held across eight close-proximity stadiums, minimizing long-distance travel. Sport ecologist Dr. Madeleine Orr, assistant professor at the University of Toronto, highlighted that expanding the World Cup increases its environmental impact. 'Every decision that grows the World Cup increases the carbon footprint,' Orr stated, adding that the economic growth comes with a trade-off of greater environmental consequences. She also suggested that FIFA's environmental actions do not match their stated concerns. FIFA has pledged to implement all necessary measures to reduce the environmental impact of the World Cup, noting that 97 percent of the matches will occur in three neighboring countries separated only by short distances. 'For 101 games, the tournament will be played within neighboring countries that have extensive and well-developed transport infrastructure,' FIFA said. FIFA previously pledged to cut carbon emissions by 50 percent by 2030 and to achieve net zero emissions by 2040. However, Swiss regulators recently found that FIFA made inaccurate and misleading claims regarding carbon neutrality and the environmental impact of the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. Quentin Cuendet, representing the Swiss Climate Alliance and Avocates pour le Climat in a case against FIFA, argued that most emissions, mainly from international flights, cannot be mitigated by FIFA. 'In such large tournaments, around 80-85 percent of emissions come from flights, which FIFA cannot effectively reduce,' he explained. Cuendet also noted that FIFA claimed to offset some emissions during Qatar 2022 but could not provide evidence that these offsets were effective or that they had a meaningful impact. Dr. Walker Ross, lecturer in Sport Management at the University of Edinburgh and Sport Ecology Group member, pointed out that trans-Atlantic flights alone may produce 1.5 to 2 tons of carbon dioxide per person per journey. He highlighted that, unlike in Qatar where domestic travel was minimal, teams in 2030 will need to fly between continents, significantly increasing emissions. Ross further questioned the effectiveness of carbon offsetting efforts such as tree planting, explaining that these methods take several decades to have an effect, whereas emissions from flights contribute to the climate problem immediately.
translated_content: ஆறு நாடுகளில் 2030 உலகக் கோப்பை நடத்தும் FIFA-வின் முடிவு, ரசிகர்கள் மற்றும் அணிகள் 100க்கும் மேற்பட்ட போட்டிகளுக்காக பயணம் செய்வதால், टूर्नமெண்டின் கார்பன் பாதிப்பை அதிகரிக்கும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். இது FIFA-வின் சூழலியல் வாக்குறுதிகளுடன் ஒத்துப்போகவில்லை என்றும் கூறப்படுகிறது. FIFA சமீபத்தில், ஸ்பெயின், போர்ச்சுகல் மற்றும் மொரோக்கோ 2030 உலகக் கோப்பையின் பெரும்பான்மையையும் நடத்தும் என்றும், உருகுவை, அர்ஜென்டினா மற்றும் பராகுவே தலா ஒரு போட்டியை நடத்தி, தொடரின் நூற்றாண்டு விழாவை கொண்டாடும் என்றும் அறிவித்தது. 2030 ஜூன் 8-9-ல் தென் அமெரிக்காவில் மூன்று போட்டிகள் முடிந்த பிறகு, உலகக் கோப்பை ஸ்பெயின், போர்ச்சுகல் மற்றும் மொரோக்கோவுக்கு செல்கிறது. இதனால், அணிகளும் ரசிகர்களும் பல தடவைகள் நட்கடல் விமானப் பயணங்கள் மேற்கொள்ள வேண்டியுள்ளது. 2022 கத்தார் உலகக் கோப்பையில் எல்லா 64 போட்டிகளும் எட்டு மிக அருகிலுள்ள ஸ்டேடியங்களில் நடைபெற்றன; இது தொலைதூர பயணத்தை குறைத்தது. விளையாட்டு சூழலியல் ஆய்வாளர் டாக்டர் மாட்லின் ஓர், உலகக் கோப்பை விரிவாக்கம் சூழலியல் பாதிப்பை பெருக்கும் என்று கூறினார். 'ஒவ்வொரு விரிவாக்க முடிவும் கார்பன் பாதிப்பை உயர்த்தும்,' என அவர் கூறினார். பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி வரும் போது சுற்றுச்சூழல் பாதிப்பும் அதிகரிக்கிறது. FIFA-வின் செயல்கள் அவர்கள் கூறும் சூழல் சிந்தனைக்கு பொருந்தவில்லை என்றும் அவர் சொன்னார். FIFA, சுற்றுச்சூழல் பாதிப்பைக் குறைக்கும் அனைத்து தேவையான நாடுகாட்டலையும் எடுக்க முனைந்துள்ளதாகவும், போட்டிகளில் 97% ரீதியில் அருகிலுள்ள மூன்று நாடுகளில் நடைபெறுவதாகவும் விளக்கியது. '101 போட்டிகள் நட்புடன் இணைந்த நாடுகளில், விரிவான போக்குவரத்து வசதிகள் உள்ள இடங்களில் நடைபெறும்' என FIFA கூறியது. 2030-ம் ஆண்டுக்குள் 50% கார்பன் வெளியீட்டைக் குறைக்கும், 2040-ம் ஆண்டுக்குள் நெட் ஜீரோ எட்டுவதற்கும் FIFA முனைகிறது. இந்நிலையில், சமீபத்தில் ஸ்விஸ் அதிகாரிகள் FIFA 2022 கத்தார் உலகக் கோப்பை தொடர்பான கார்பன் நடுநிலை வாக்குறுதி மற்றும் சூழலியல் பாதிப்பு குறித்த தவறான மற்றும் வழுத்தப்பட்ட தகவல்கள் வழங்கியதாக குறிப்பிட்டனர். ஸ்விஸ் கிளைமேட் அலையன்ஸ் மற்றும் Avocates pour le Climat சார்பில் Quentin Cuendet, விமானப் பயணங்கள் மூலம் மீதமுள்ள பெரும்பாலான வெளியீடுகளை FIFA தடுக்க முடியாது என்று கூறினார். 'பெரிய போட்டிகளில் விமானப் பயணங்கள் மூலம் 80-85% வெளியீடுகள் ஏற்படுகிறது; FIFA அதை குறைக்க முடியாது,' என அவர் கூறினார். Qatar 2022ல், FIFA சில வெளியீடுகளை கட்டுப்படுத்த முயற்சித்ததாக கூறினாலும், அவை பயனளித்ததாக நிரூபிக்க முடியவில்லை என்று Cuendet கூறினார். Edinburgh பல்கலைக்கழகத்திலுள்ள விளையாட்டு மேலாண்மை விரிவுரையாளர் மற்றும் Sport Ecology Group உறுப்பினராகிய டாக்டர் வாக்கர் ராஸ், நட்கடல் விமானப் பயணங்கள் ஒரு நபருக்கு 1.5 முதல் 2 டன் கார்பன் டயாக்ஸைடு வெளியிடும் என்று தெரிவித்தார். கத்தாரில் உள்ளபோதெனில் உள்ளூர் பயணம் குறைவாக இருந்தது; ஆனால் 2030-ல் அணிகள் கண்டங்களை கடந்தும் பயணம் செய்ய வேண்டியிருக்கும், இது கார்பன் வெளியீட்டை அதிகரிக்கும். விமானப் பயணங்களால் ஏற்படும் உடனடி கார்பன் தாக்கத்தின் எதிர்மறை விளைவுகள் உடனடியாகத் தெரியும்; ஆனால் மரம் நடுவது மற்றும் காட்டுகளை பாதுகாப்பது போன்ற மாற்றங்கள் பல ஆண்டுகள் எடுத்துக்கொள்ளும் என ராஸ் கூறினார்.

A British manufacturer claims that DuoMax is the only disinfectant worldwide able to eliminate the Ebola virus without causing skin irritation or toxicity. The company asserts DuoMax is suitable for broad application, including skin and large surfaces, because it does not have the harsh effects of bleach or chlorine products. Reportedly, DuoMax functions by breaking down the DNA and RNA of viruses, which prevents their spread. The firm says DuoMax is in use at Heathrow Airport and is being considered for distribution internationally, especially as part of efforts to control Ebola outbreaks. Brian Baker, the founder, mentioned ongoing talks for licenses in the US, and a willingness to provide the product for free to affected African regions as a preventive measure. He clarifies that DuoMax doesn’t cure Ebola but serves as a crucial protective tool. Direct contact with infected bodily fluids can transmit Ebola, so effective disinfection is important to limit the virus’s reach. The company argues that traditional chemicals like bleach are not ideal since they are corrosive and irritating, possibly increasing infection risk; DuoMax claims to avoid these issues, verified by independent testing in the UK.

Scientists, however, urge caution. Professor Paul Hunter of the University of East Anglia agrees that DuoMax can likely eliminate Ebola, but points out that other common disinfectants—including bleach and soap—are also effective. He questions whether DuoMax is more practical than conventional solutions. Another expert notes that all such disinfectants are limited to cleaning surfaces and cannot be used in patients, and that the Ebola virus is easily inactivated by sunlight or standard cleaning agents. Thus, while DuoMax could be beneficial in controlling the virus’s spread, experts stress that existing products are already reliable, and there isn’t direct evidence yet to support DuoMax’s special status.

article_content: The Attorney General of the Federation and Minister of Justice, Lateef Fagbemi, SAN, expressed concern on Monday over the rapidly evolving security threats facing Nigeria and other West African countries. He highlighted that artificial intelligence and generative technologies are now being exploited as new tools for fraud. Speaking at the inauguration of the 27th ministerial committee meeting of the Action Group Against Money Laundering in West Africa, held in Abuja, Fagbemi emphasized the need to assess both current and future threats across the region. He stated, "It is evident that the threats we are facing will continue to grow and evolve unpredictably. In particular, the risks associated with artificial intelligence and generative technologies are already opening up new avenues for fraud." Fagbemi stressed the importance of comprehensive risk assessments and continuous monitoring of these threats. He further noted that decentralized finance systems, adopted in many regional countries, have enabled illicit financial flows, making it harder for law enforcement agencies to trace and identify illegal transactions. He explained, "The expanding use and advancement of technology, along with geopolitical instability, are creating conducive environments for organized crime groups and transnational terrorist organizations to operate globally." Fagbemi called for the development of robust legislative, policy, and institutional frameworks to protect the region's financial systems from threats such as money laundering, terrorism financing, and the proliferation of illicit funds.

article_content: Family reunions can sometimes be awkward, but these long-lost relatives broke the ice with a warm embrace. Kesho the gorilla and his younger brother Alf had been separated for nearly three years, living in different zoos, before reuniting this week at their new home in Longleat Safari Park. The brothers greeted each other enthusiastically with hugs, handshakes, and playful interactions. Kesho, aged 13, and Alf, aged 9, were both born at Dublin Zoo. They were separated when Kesho was sent to London Zoo for a breeding program, while Alf remained elsewhere. Although Kesho was found to be infertile, he became the dominant male in his group and grew into an impressive silverback. Despite the years apart, Alf quickly recognized his brother. Gorillas can identify each other by the shape of their noses, and Kesho’s presence was clearly familiar to Alf. Now, the brothers will live together in a £3 million enclosure at the safari park. Head gorilla keeper Mark Tye said staff were unsure if the brothers would recognize each other, but their reunion was immediate and affectionate, with no aggression. Tye noted their bond was strong and that Kesho had shown tolerance and trust towards Alf, behavior that's unusual to see in mature silverbacks. Had they been strangers, there likely would have been aggression, but instead the brothers showed trust by turning their backs to each other. The staff commented on the positive impact of their relationship, with Alf benefitting from his older brother’s example and Kesho enjoying his role in the group. The park has formed a 'bachelor group' for gorillas, as there are too many males in the European breeding program.

article_content: Kerry Kennedy, daughter of Robert F. Kennedy and former wife of New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, was involved in a hit-and-run accident in Westchester County, New York. After the collision, Kennedy was found unconscious at the wheel and was arrested for driving while impaired. Family sources suggest she may have suffered a seizure or has an undiagnosed medical issue, as she reportedly blacked out during the incident, according to the New York Post. Kennedy was charged with driving while impaired by drugs. The incident occurred only two months after the suicide of her sister-in-law and close friend, Mary Richardson Kennedy, who had experienced addiction problems. Police stated that Kennedy had taken prescription sleeping pills, reportedly including Ambien, and tests later confirmed Ambien was in her system on the day of the crash. Kennedy's spokesperson, Ken Sunshine, asserted that blood, urine, and breathalyzer tests found no drugs or alcohol when initially conducted, though charges were filed before those test results were available. Legal experts note that Ambien has, in rare cases, been associated with 'sleep-driving,' where individuals drive without memory of the event. The so-called 'Ambien defense' has been successful in some cases, especially when incidents occurred during regular sleep hours. Kerry Kennedy, a prominent Kennedy family member, is scheduled to appear in North Castle court. She and Andrew Cuomo have three children together from a thirteen-year marriage. Kennedy gave an emotional eulogy for Mary Richardson Kennedy in May, remembering her as an 'angel' lost to her personal struggles.

article_content:
Rockstar Games, creator of the hugely popular Grand Theft Auto series, announced Wednesday that it will unveil the next game in the franchise next month. In a blog post marking its 25th anniversary, Rockstar revealed that a trailer for the new Grand Theft Auto game will drop in December.

While there's no confirmed release date yet, parent company Take-Two Interactive has indicated the game is expected during fiscal 2025. The upcoming title—widely thought to be GTA VI—will be the first main entry since 2013’s Grand Theft Auto V, which became one of the most successful entertainment products ever, selling more than 170 million copies and earning over $6 billion.

Official details on GTA VI remain limited. Reports suggest the setting is a city inspired by Miami, and for the first time, the game will feature two playable protagonists. It’s also expected to place significant emphasis on online multiplayer, thanks to the ongoing success of Grand Theft Auto Online as a major revenue source for Take-Two.

The announcement comes after years of speculation and appears to confirm that development is at a stage where Rockstar can begin promotion. Still, last year, an 18-year-old hacker compromised Rockstar’s network, leaking over 90 videos showing early GTA VI gameplay and features. Rockstar confirmed the breach but said it remains focused on delivering a polished game and would not rush development.

The Grand Theft Auto series has long been a major event in the gaming industry. GTA V set records, earning over $800 million in its first 24 hours. With Microsoft’s planned acquisition of Activision Blizzard, GTA VI could be one of the last huge AAA games not linked to a major platform owner.

Rockstar has also sought to improve its working culture in recent years, addressing reports of excessive overtime before the release of Red Dead Redemption 2. The studio has committed to better work-life balance and more sustainable development. With anticipation higher than ever, Rockstar is preparing to showcase its most ambitious Grand Theft Auto yet.

Fans who have waited nearly a decade for GTA VI news can expect their first official look at the future of the franchise next month.

article_content: Daniel Day, 34, caused the death of his girlfriend, Alice Hicks, 27, after crashing her Mini Cooper while driving at excessively high speeds on a country road, a court has heard. Day was traveling at up to 80mph when he lost control on a blind bend near Rooksbridge, Somerset, on September 24, 2011. The car skidded and collided with an oncoming Mazda, leaving Alice, a trainee accountant, with fatal injuries. She died a day after the crash. Day was convicted of causing death by dangerous driving following a week-long trial at Taunton Crown Court. The jury reached its guilty verdict in just 40 minutes. Although Day denied the charge, he now faces jail and will be sentenced at a later date. Alice’s family expressed relief at the verdict but acknowledged that it could not bring her back. Her mother, Yvonne Hicks, called Alice 'the center of the family,' while her father, Raymond Hicks, remembered how she was close to graduating from an accountancy course. The family described their ongoing grief and emphasized Alice’s innocence in the tragedy. The trial heard that Day ignored multiple warning signs, including four stating 'slow' and another urging drivers to 'reduce speed now' before approaching the bend. Witnesses testified that Day was driving fast and appeared panicked in the moments before the crash. Alice was not wearing a seatbelt and was thrown from the vehicle, sustaining fatal head injuries. Day also was not wearing a seatbelt. Tests confirmed Day was not under the influence of drugs or alcohol, and the Mini Cooper had no mechanical faults. The driver of the Mazda survived the collision.

article_content: Boris Maksudov, a journalist for Russian state TV channel Rossiya 24, died from shrapnel wounds following a drone strike in Ukraine’s Zaporizhia region. The attack took place on Wednesday. Although Maksudov was initially reported to be in stable condition at the hospital, he later passed away. Rossia Segodnia CEO Dmitry Kiselyov commended Maksudov’s courage, stating that he died as a hero, according to RIA Novosti. Russia has consistently accused Ukraine of targeting journalists in areas of conflict. Last month, three Izvestia correspondents were reportedly hurt by shelling in Donetsk, which is occupied by Russian forces. According to the Committee to Protect Journalists, at least 15 journalists and media workers, aside from Maksudov, have lost their lives in Ukraine since the full-scale war began. In May, Agence France-Presse video journalist Arman Soldin was killed near Bakhmut, and recently, Russian actress Polina Menshikh died in a missile attack in Donbas while performing for soldiers. The Ukrainian military said this strike targeted a ceremony for Russia’s 810th Separate Naval Infantry Brigade. Ukrainian commander Robert Brovdi claimed that 25 people were killed and over 100 injured in the incident.

article_content: Audio technology is moving forward quickly, especially when it comes to wireless earbuds. Most current earbuds deliver great sound and effective noise cancellation using conventional dynamic drivers made from voice coils and magnets. But now, solid-state drivers are introducing fresh possibilities. Creative’s new Aurvana Ace and Ace 2 earbuds, for example, use drivers that feature a piezo layer on a silicon diaphragm. This approach provides a lighter and faster-performing earbud, with more reliable sound quality and less interference from other components. Driver manufacturer xMEMS is innovating further with Cypress, a next-generation driver that leverages ultrasonic amplitude modulation to translate high-frequency air pulses into audible sound. This breakthrough results in bass that is up to 40 times louder than earlier xMEMS drivers and can generate sound pressure levels over 140dB at frequencies as low as 20 Hz, matching the best from traditional coil-based drivers. With this technology, Cypress ensures precise audio reproduction across all frequencies and supports advanced sound formats like high-resolution and spatial audio. xMEMS is preparing to begin large-scale production of Cypress drivers by the end of 2024. In the meantime, the Cowell driver continues to be the recommended option, including for products like the Aurvana Ace 2. As this technology progresses, we can expect many new earbuds to take advantage of these exciting advancements.

article_content: Harry Maxwell, who placed third in last year’s Young Apprentice, is defying critics with his successful business ventures. At just 18, Harry is now selling Demi Moore’s beauty range, ‘More by Demi,’ on his website LegitEssentials.com—a store specializing in luxury well-being brands. The beauty lineup, launched by Oriflame and designed by Demi Moore, aims to empower women and help them feel confident. 'She believes her products should give young women confidence. The name ‘More by Demi’ encourages people to strive for more in their lives,' Harry explained. Although Harry did not win the highly sought-after Young Apprentice title, he reflects positively on his journey, saying, 'I can’t believe that in just a year I’ve gone from being on The Young Apprentice to working on all these amazing projects.' The four-piece beauty collection—perfume, body cream, shower cream, and hair spray—debuts at an introductory price of £28.90 for the first two weeks. Comparing his current achievements to those of winner Zara Brownless, Harry notes that while Zara has chosen to focus on her studies, he has pursued business and innovation. 'For me, it’s not about beating my former competitors, it’s about being the best I can be,' Harry said. He also serves as an ambassador for LinkedIn UK and is developing two new projects, including a collaboration with a star from Made In Chelsea, all while studying at the London School of Economics. Harry faced media attention after being photographed partying at Mahiki nightclub, which he calls 'horrendous and tragic.' He no longer maintains contact with fellow contestants involved in past personal controversies. Despite challenges, Harry remains determined: 'I genuinely want to succeed more than I want to breathe, and I’ll never stop trying to better myself.' For those entering the new season of Young Apprentice, Harry offers this advice: 'Remember, it’s just a competition. Play your own game and never say never. I want to make as much money as possible.'

article_content: Sarah Palin's selection as John McCain's running mate in the 2008 presidential election redefined the impact vice-presidential candidates can have on a campaign. However, many analysts agree that, ultimately, Palin's presence hurt McCain's chances more than it helped. Initially, Palin boosted excitement among Republicans and brought energy to the ticket. She was relatively unknown to most Americans outside of Alaska, where she had gained attention by defeating incumbent Governor Frank Murkowski in 2006. Her introduction on August 29, 2008, the day after Barack Obama accepted the Democratic nomination, surprised many—including McCain's own staff—who had expected him to pick figures like Mitt Romney or Tim Pawlenty, or even Joe Lieberman. Palin's debut rallied the GOP base, who admired her anti-establishment approach, focus on energy issues, and relatability as a self-described 'hockey mom.' Party members also appreciated her family values and conservative stance on social issues. Yet, her limited national exposure meant her background came under immediate scrutiny. Journalists investigated her record as mayor and governor, while campaign advisors shielded her from tough questions. Her high-profile speech at the Republican National Convention earned praise and high television ratings, helping McCain outpace Obama briefly in the polls. Palin's popularity soared, even outshining McCain at rallies. However, Palin encountered several setbacks. The campaign limited her media appearances, allowing interviews only with selected networks. When questioned on foreign policy, Palin struggled, harming McCain's claim of experience and leading to widespread parody. While she did well on economic and energy topics during her debate with Joe Biden, she often relied on talking points when discussing national security. On the campaign trail, Palin began criticizing Obama directly, sometimes accusing him of associating with 'terrorists' and lacking patriotism. While this energized some Republicans, it alienated Democrats and independents. Over time, her public image became more divisive. A longstanding ethics investigation in Alaska concluded Palin had abused her power during the dismissal of the state's public safety commissioner but found she had not broken the law. News that the Republican National Committee spent $150,000 on her wardrobe caused further controversy. As the campaign progressed, internal tensions surfaced, with some aides anonymously describing Palin as 'going rogue' and difficult to manage. She later broke from campaign strategy by addressing the media directly about campaign tactics and personal issues. Despite being given opportunities to make substantive speeches in the campaign's final phase, public opinion had shifted. Polls, such as the October 2008 NBC News/Wall Street Journal and CNN surveys, indicated voters were increasingly concerned about her qualifications, and she was seen as more of a liability than an asset to the ticket. A CNN poll conducted before the election showed Palin had higher unfavorable ratings than at her selection, with 57% doubting her presidential qualifications. Only about 40% of voters said they would support her if she chose to run for president in 2012, though her political future remains uncertain.

அவர் 'ஹாக்கி அம்மா' என்ற அடையாளம், சக்தி மூலங்களைப் பற்றிய அறிவு, எதிர் நிலைப்பாட்டு அணுகுமுறை ஆகியவற்றிற்கு பாராட்டுப் பெற்றார். அவரது குடும்ப வெறுப்பு மற்றும் பாரம்பரிய சமூக கருத்துக்கள் GOP புதுதலைமையில் வரவேற்கப்பட்டது. தேசிய அளவில் அறிமுகம் குறைவாக இருந்ததால் அவரது பின்னணி தவிர்க்க முடியாத விமர்சனத்துக்குள்ளானது. பத்திரிகையாளர்கள் அவருடைய மேயர் மற்றும் ஆளுநர் பதவிகளில் செய்திகளை ஆய்வு செய்தனர், அதேபோது ஊழியர்கள் கடுமையான கேள்விகளைத் தவிர்க்க அவரை பாதுகாத்தனர். காங்கிரஸ் மாநாட்டில் பேசிய பேச்சு பாராட்டுக்குரியதாக இருந்தது, டிவியில் அதிக பார்வை பெற்றது; மெக்கெயின் ஒரு கட்டத்தில் ஒபாமாவை மீறினார். பேலினின் புகழ் அதிகரித்தது; மெக்கெயினைவிட பெரும்பாலான கூட்டத்தில் ஆதரவாளர்கள் வருகை தந்தனர். ஆனால், பேலின் சில தடைகள் முகங்கொடுத்தார். செய்தி ஊடக சந்திப்புகள் சிலவையாக மட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்டதால் வெளிநாட்டு கொள்கை கேள்விகளில் தளர்வு காட்டினார்; இது மெக்கெயினின் அனுபவப் பிரசாரம் பாதிக்கப்பட்டதிலும், பரவலான நகைச்சுவைக்கும் இடமளித்தது. ஜோ பைடனுடன் நடந்த விவாதத்தில் பொருளாதாரம் மற்றும் சக்தி தொடர்பான கேள்விகளில் நன்றாக பதிலளித்தார். ஆனாலும் தேசிய பாதுகாப்பு தொடர்பான கேள்விகளில் இவரது பதில்கள் குறைவாக இருந்தன. பேரணியில் பேலின் நேரடியாக ஒபாமாவை குற்றம்சாட்டினார், 'தீவிரவாதிகளுடன் நட்பு' மற்றும் தேசவிருப்பு குறைவு ஆகிய குற்றச்சாட்டுகளை வைத்தார். இதனால் சில GOP ஆதரவாளர்கள் உற்சாகப்பட்டனர் ஆனால் ஜனநாயகவாதியும் சுயாதீனர்களும் எதிர்ப்பு காட்டினர். காலப்போக்கில், அவர் பகிரங்கமான, வேற்றுமையுணர்ந்த நபராக மாறினார். அலாஸ்காவில் நடந்த நீண்ட நாட்கள் கண்காணிப்பு, பொதுப் பாதுகாப்பு ஆணையரைப் பணி நீக்கம் செய்ததில் பேலின் அதிகாரம் தவறாக பயன்படுத்தியுள்ளார் என உறுதி செய்தது; ஆனால் சட்டம் மீறவில்லை. குடியரசுக் கட்சி தேசிய குழு பேலினின் உடை வினியோகத்திற்காக $150,000 செலவிட்டது என்று செய்தி வெளியானது. அதிகமான தேர்தல் காலத்தில், சில ஊழியர்கள் 'பேலின் தனிச்சிறப்பாக நடந்தார்' என்றும், ஒருங்கிணைக்க கடினம் என்றும் 匿名மாக தெரிவித்தனர். பின்னர், அவர் தேர்தல் திட்டத்திலிருந்து விலகி ஊடகத்திடம் நேரடியாக பேசி, கேள்விகளுக்குப் பதில் வழங்கினார். கடைசி கட்டத்தில், முக்கிய தலைப்புகளில் உரையாற்ற வாய்ப்பு வழங்கப்பட்டது. ஆனால் மக்கள் கருத்து ஏற்கனவே மாறி விட்டது. 2008 அக்டோபரில் NBC News/Wall Street Journal, CNN போன்ற கருத்துக்கணிப்புகள் அவர் தகுதி குறித்த கேள்விகள் அதிகரித்துள்ளன என்று கூறின, அவர் கட்சிக்குத் தீங்காகவே தரப்படுகிறார். CNN தேர்ந்தெடுத்த முந்தைய கருத்துக் கணிப்பு, அவர் குறைவு புகழ் விகிதம் உயர்ந்ததாகவும், 57% பேர் ஜனாதிபதி தகுதி இல்லை என நம்பும் என்றும், 2012-ல் அவர் போட்டியிட்டால் சுமார் 40% மட்டுமே ஆதரிக்க இருப்பதாகவும் தெரிவித்தது. அவரது அரசியல் எதிர்காலம் இன்னும் தெளிவாக இல்லை.

Angel Studios, recognized for the global sensation 'Sound of Freedom,' has acquired worldwide rights to 'Bonhoeffer' (formerly titled 'God’s Spy'), a fact-based thriller written and directed by Todd Komarnicki. Set for theatrical release in 2024, the film tells the story of Dietrich Bonhoeffer (portrayed by Jonas Dassler), a pacifist pastor remembered for his steadfast moral and political courage in Berlin during the Nazi regime. Bonhoeffer actively resisted the Third Reich, conspiring to end the regime and speaking fearlessly against oppression and injustice. His influence continues to be felt worldwide.

The cast includes Jonas Dassler, August Diehl, Moritz Bleibtreu, Nadine Heidenreich, David Jonsson, and Flula Borg. Producers are Emmanuel and Camille Kampouris, Todd Komarnicki, Ralph Winter, Mark O’Sullivan, and Chloe Kassis-Crowe through Ireland-based Crow’s Nest Productions, with Jean Jaques Neira co-producing for Fontana in Belgium.

Writer-director Komarnicki remarked, “Encountering Dietrich Bonhoeffer and being able to share his extraordinary story with audiences is a profound privilege. His message of peace and bravery is as important today as it was in the past.” Angel Studios President Jordan Harmon added, “Bonhoeffer’s example is needed now more than ever. The Angel Guild has continually demonstrated that true stories of heroism inspire us and highlight the power of the human spirit.”

உலகம் முழுவதும் வெற்றி பெற்ற 'Sound of Freedom' படத்தை வழங்கிய Angel Studios, 'Bonhoeffer' (முன்பு 'God’s Spy' என்று அழைக்கப்பட்டது) திரைப்படத்தின் உலக உரிமைகளை பெற்றுள்ளது. இந்த உண்மை சம்பவத்தை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்ட த்ரில்லர் படத்தை Todd Komarnicki எழுதி இயக்குகிறார், 2024ல் திரையரங்கில் வெளிவரவுள்ளது. இந்த படம் நாசி ஆட்சியிலிருந்த பெர்லினில் தைரியமாக எதிருத்த சமய ஆசாரியர் டிட்ரிக் போன்ஹோஃபரின் (Jonas Dassler நடித்துள்ளார்) வாழ்க்கையை பின்னணியாகக் கொண்டது. துன்பமும் தடைபட்டாலும், நாசி ஆட்சியை முடிவுத்தவமைக்க விரும்பி, போன்ஹோஃபர் விரிவாக எதிர்த்தார்; அவரது தாக்கம் இன்று உலகம் முழுவதும் உணரப்படுகிறது.

August Diehl, Moritz Bleibtreu, Nadine Heidenreich, David Jonsson, Flula Borg ஆகியோர் நடிப்பில் இடம்பெறுகின்றனர். Irelands Crow’s Nest Productions மூலம், Emmanuel மற்றும் Camille Kampouris, Todd Komarnicki, Ralph Winter, Mark O’Sullivan, Chloe Kassis-Crowe ஆகியோர் தயாரிப்பாளர்கள்; Belgium-இன் Fontana நிறுவனத்திற்காக Jean Jaques Neira இணை தயாரிப்பாளர்.

இயக்குனர் கொமார்னிக்கி கூறினார்: “டிட்ரிக் போன்ஹோஃபரை சந்தித்து, அவர் தான் கதையை உலகத்திற்கு வழங்கும் வாய்ப்பு கிடைத்தது எனக்கு மிகுந்த பெருமை. அவர் வழங்கிய அமைதி மற்றும் தைரியம் இன்றும் மிக மிக அவசியமான ஒன்று.” Angel Studios தலைவர் ஜோர்டன் ஹார்மன் கூறினார்: “போன்ஹோஃபரின் வாழ்க்கையை நாம் இப்போது அறிய வேண்டும். உண்மையான வீரர்களின் கதைகள் மனித ஆற்றலை நம்பவைக்கும் என்று The Angel Guild நாடோடிகிப்பட்டுள்ளது.”

article_content: During the annual IMF and World Bank meetings in Marrakech, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen stated she intends to meet with Pan Gongsheng, the governor of China's central bank, to seek solutions for countries facing heavy debt burdens. Both Yellen and World Bank President Ajay Banga stressed the importance of accelerating the process of debt restructuring for nations in financial distress. Yellen acknowledged that progress on debt relief remains slow, but pointed to meaningful achievements in particular cases and conveyed hope for further advancements. Her upcoming discussion with Pan will aim to strengthen cooperation on these issues. As a key lender, China is a pivotal player in talks to ease financial hardships for emerging and low-income countries. Banga commended China's partnership with the World Bank, though he also noted a need for greater transparency in debt agreements to help speed up restructuring. He also mentioned that the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable—which unites creditors, debtor nations, the IMF, and the World Bank—played a significant role in Zambia’s recent debt restructuring deal. Yellen added that regular dialogue with Chinese officials has led to constructive outcomes, not only in economic affairs but also in areas such as climate change. She remains optimistic about enhancing this collaboration.

'குளோபல் சொவெரின் டெப்ட் ரவுண்ட் டேபிள்' எனப்படும் மன்றம் - கடன் வழங்குநர்கள், கடன் பெற்ற நாடுகள், ஐஎம்எப் மற்றும் உலக வங்கியை ஒருங்கிணைக்கும் இடமாக, சமீபத்தில் ஜாம்பியா நாட்டுக்கான கடன் மறுசீரமைப்பில் முக்கிய பங்காற்றியதாகவும் பங்கா கூறினார். சீன அதிகாரிகளுடன் தொடர்ந்து நடத்தப்படும் உரையாடல்கள், பொருளாதார விவகாரங்களில் மட்டுமல்லாமல், காலநிலை மாற்றம் போன்ற பொது விஷயங்களிலும் நல்ல முன்னேற்றங்களை கொண்டுவந்துள்ளதாக யெல்லன் தெரிவித்தார். இந்தக் கூட்டாண்மை மேலும் வலுப்பெறும் என அவர் நம்பிக்கை தெரிவித்தார்.

article_content: A family of survivors is being taken from their home by volunteer drivers. At Beit Kama Junction near Sderot, Israel, both the kosher McDonald's and other restaurants at the gas station are closed, but the rest stop has become a coordination point for volunteers. Nearby, after a major attack by Hamas gunmen from Gaza that left many Israeli civilians and soldiers dead or taken hostage, Israelis are providing help. Hamas gunmen remain at large in the area. Volunteer drivers coordinate rescue missions at a makeshift table, traveling into affected towns to evacuate families during a mass evacuation along the Gaza border. The United Kingdom faces a pivotal moment as the Scottish independence referendum approaches, with an exclusive Survation poll for the Daily Mail revealing the outcome remains highly uncertain. Just 24 hours before voting begins, the No campaign leads by four points—52% for No against 48% for Yes. However, with around 350,000 voters still undecided, the final result is far from assured.

The poll indicates that support for independence is rising, particularly among previous Labour supporters: nearly a third of those who voted Labour in the 2011 Scottish elections now intend to back Yes. Meanwhile, the three pro-Union parties are making intensive, last-minute campaign efforts to solidify support for staying in the UK.

Writing in the Scottish Daily Mail, Better Together leader Alistair Darling described the referendum as 'probably the most important day of our democratic lives,' emphasizing the historic significance of the vote. In a joint statement, David Cameron, Ed Miliband, and Nick Clegg have pledged greater powers for the Scottish Parliament and the continuation of public funding guarantees if Scotland remains in the Union.

The No campaign has highlighted leaked documents, suggesting that the Scottish National Party (SNP) might need to cut hundreds of millions of pounds from the National Health Service (NHS) budget in the event of a Yes victory. The Yes camp dismissed these late promises as 'insults' and criticized what they describe as fear-mongering from Westminster.

Alex Salmond, Scotland’s First Minister, has urged voters not to be influenced by what he calls 'increasingly desperate and absurd scare stories' from the UK government, and frames the referendum as a rare opportunity for empowerment.

The latest Survation poll, conducted online between September 12 and the morning before the vote, shows 44.1% of Scots support independence—an increase from 42.4% the previous week. Opposition to independence holds steady at 47.7%, with 8.3% still undecided. This predicts a final outcome of 52% No to 48% Yes.

Notably, the poll identifies a gender divide: 49% of men plan to vote Yes, compared to 46% No; among women, only 39% support Yes, while 49% intend to vote No. For the No campaign, the potential shift among Labour voters is cause for concern—only 60% of previous Labour supporters now back No, compared to 91% of 2011 Conservative voters.

Survation CEO Damian Lyons Lowe underscores just how close the contest remains: 'With 8% of the electorate still undecided, everything is still to play for, and there is no room for complacency in the Better Together campaign.'

சுதந்திரம் தொடர்பான ஆதரவு அதிகரித்து வருகிறது, குறிப்பாக கடந்த 2011-ம் ஆண்டு லேபர் கட்சிக்கு வாக்களித்தவர்களில் இன்று ஒரு மூன்றில் ஒருவர் Yes-க்கு ஆதரவு தரவுள்ளார். மூன்று ஒன்றிய ஆதரவு கட்சிகள் UK-வில் தொடர்வதற்காக கடைசி நேர பிரச்சாரத்தை தீவிரப்படுத்தியுள்ளனர்.

Scottish Daily Mail-இல் பதிவு செய்துள்ள Better Together தலைவர் அலிஸ்டைர் டார்லிங், இந்த வாக்குப்பதிவை 'நம்முடைய ஜனநாயக வாழ்க்கையின் மிக முக்கியமான நாளாக' தெரிவித்தார். டேவிட் காமரூன், எட் மிலிபாண்ட், நிக் க்லெக் ஆகியோர் ஸ்காட்லாந்து ஒன்றியத்தில் தொடர்ந்தால் அவைக்கு அதிக அதிகாரங்கள் வழங்கப்படும் என்றும், பொதுமனித நிதி அரசுத் தொடரும் என்றும் உறுதி அளித்துள்ளனர்.

Yes முகாம் இந்த late-stage உறுதிகள் 'அவமதிப்பாகவும்' விவரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன; மேலும் வெஸ்ட்மின்ஸ்டரின் பயமுறுத்தும் முயற்சியாக பற்றுகின்றனர்.

ஸ்காட்லாந்து முதலமைச்சர் அலெக்ஸ் சால்மண்ட், 'தொங்கிக்கொண்டிருக்கும் மற்றும் பரிதாபகரமான பயமுறுத்தும் கதைகள்' மீது வாக்காளர்கள் கவனித்தலை செலுத்த வேண்டாம் என வலியுறுத்தி, இந்த வாக்குப்பதிவு 'ஒருவரும் அணுக முடியாத அதிகாரம்' என்று கூறுகிறார்.

மறுமுயற்சியில், ஸர்வேஷன் கருத்துக் கணிப்பு செப்டம்பர் 12 முதல் வாக்குப்பதிவுக்கு முன்புள்ள காலையில் ஆன்லைனில் நடத்தப்பட்டது. 44.1% மக்கள் சுதந்திரத்திற்கு ஆதரவு தெரிவிக்கின்றனர் (முந்தைய வாரம் 42.4%), No-க்கு ஆதரவு 47.7% மற்றும் 8.3% மக்கள் இன்னும் முடிவெடுக்கவில்லை. இறுதி முடிவு 52% No மற்றும் 48% Yes என கணிக்கப்படுகிறது.

கருத்துக் கணிப்பின் படி ஆண்-பெண் வித்தியாசம் உள்ளது: ஆண்களில் 49% Yes-க்கு, 46% No-க்கு; பெண்களில் 39% மட்டும் Yes-க்கு, 49% No-க்கு. No முகாமில் லேபர் வாக்காளர்களை இழப்பது கவலைக்கிடம்; 2011 லேபர் வாக்காளர்களில் 60% மட்டுமே இப்போது No-க்கு ஆதரவளிக்க, கான்சர்வேடிவ் வாக்காளர்களில் 91% No-க்கு இறுக இருக்கின்றனர்.

Survation நிறுவனத்தின் தலைமை செயல் அதிகாரி டேமியன் லயன்ஸ் லோவ், '8% மக்கள் இன்னும் முடிவு செய்யவில்லை. எனவே ஒவ்வொரு வாக்கும் முக்கியம், மேலும் Better Together முகாமிற்கு பாழ்ச்சி செய்ய இடமில்லை' எனத் தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

article_content: Families booking summer holidays may face additional charges of up to £244, according to a report by the Daily Mail. Some travel companies, including Thomas Cook and Thomson, have been charging families with two parents and two children more than groups of four adults for identical holiday packages. This under-occupancy charge, similar to the supplement often required of single travelers, has been applied at select hotels and apartments in Spain, Greece, and Turkey. Both Thomas Cook and Thomson have acknowledged the existence of this pricing discrepancy. The Daily Mail compared prices for a family of four (two parents and two children, aged six and ten) versus four adults staying in the same accommodation for a week in August. For example, Thomas Cook's website quoted £2,060 for a family at apartments in Fuerteventura, which is £244 more than the cost for four adults. At a hotel in Gran Canaria, the family price was £1,932, a premium of £196. Thomson quoted £2,025 for a family stay in Menorca, £173 more than the adults’ group, and £1,611 for a holiday village in Bodrum, Turkey, a surplus of £135. Consumer group Which? has criticized the policy, calling it 'completely unfair' that families should pay more due to under-occupancy charges for children. While travel companies typically charge for each child as well as each adult for both flights and accommodation, their booking systems may not count children as adults for occupancy purposes. This can trigger a surcharge, as hotels aim to compensate for lower restaurant and bar sales associated with children. Thomas Cook suggested that parents may pay less if they list children as adults during booking. Thomson apologized for the discrepancy, stating it was a pricing error affecting a small number of their villa and apartment holidays, and said they are working to fix it. The company advised customers booking online to compare the total prices for adult and family bookings and to book as adults if needed. After the issue was highlighted, Thomson established a dedicated telephone line for families seeking refunds. Thomas Cook added that the policy 'very rarely' results in extra charges for families, and affirmed that their agents always seek the best price available. Customers with concerns about their booking prices or refund eligibility can contact Thomson at 0800 0093847.

article_content: The parents of 17-year-old Kevin Wayne Jr., paralyzed in a rare hunting accident, have spoken out about their son's unexpected progress. Although Kevin remains paralyzed from the neck down after a tow rope snapped and struck his neck, severing his spine, he has recently managed to drink liquids on his own—something doctors believed he might never do again. Kevin can only communicate with deep, raspy sounds and has spoken little about the incident, only saying, "I should have stayed home that morning," according to his mother, Aurea Gonzales. The accident happened on October 18 during an elk hunting trip with friends near Greenwater, Oregon. After the incident, Kevin was airlifted to Harborview Medical Center, where he underwent neck surgery. He continues to breathe with the help of a ventilator and has shown early signs of improvement, including being able to slightly move his arm. Doctors are uncertain about Kevin regaining the ability to walk, eat independently, or breathe without assistance. Nevertheless, his mother shared that he successfully sipped a smoothie recently and believes he will overcome the odds. To support Kevin's recovery, his parents have both left their jobs to stay by his side. The family, who do not have health insurance, is facing mounting medical bills and raising money through a GoFundMe account initiated by a family member, Teresa Gonzales. In her appeal, Teresa described the family's financial distress and thanked donors for their generosity during this difficult time. Friends, family, and community members are rallying to offer support, though the road ahead remains challenging for Kevin and his loved ones.

article_content: A man faces charges following a deadly stabbing at the Sandylands caravan park in Saltcoats, North Ayrshire. The violence occurred late Thursday night, resulting in the death of 41-year-old George Boyce from Neilston, East Renfrewshire. According to Police Scotland, the incident stemmed from an altercation. Paramedics attended but could not save Mr Boyce, who was pronounced dead at the scene. Forensic experts have been working at the scene to gather evidence. The commission's spokesperson, Tyrone Jue, confirmed no health risks to the public since the reservoir was not in use and all water undergoes disinfection before distribution. Nonetheless, Sanchez faces possible suspension without pay for his actions, which the utility considers unacceptable.

A comparable case in Portland, Oregon, led to the disposal of 38 million gallons from a city reservoir after a teenager was recorded urinating in the water. Since the water was set to be delivered untreated, officials deemed it necessary to discard it. The teens involved were cited by police.

Jue cautioned that employees working around reservoirs must act appropriately, warning that failing to do so could result in serious consequences.

article_content: Tata Technologies CEO and Managing Director Warren Harris stated that India is set to become the engineering, research, and development (ER&D) hub for global manufacturing companies. In an interview with ETMarkets, Harris discussed Tata Technologies’ plans, recent IPO, and the company’s prospects in India. Harris explained that Tata Technologies will maintain its focus on professional services across industries such as automotive, aerospace, transportation, and construction machinery, but also plans to explore opportunities in high-tech and medical equipment. He emphasized India's growing importance as a market, noting its potential to replicate the rapid growth seen in the IT services sector over the past three decades. Currently, Tata Technologies earns over 30% of its revenue from India, demonstrating the significance of the domestic market. Harris highlighted the company's commitment to investing in talent and customer relationships. India's influence in the global aerospace market is growing, with considerable demand for new aircraft expected over the next 20 years. The company anticipates India will play a key role as both a source of resources and as a critical market. About 80% of Tata Technologies’ solutions are in the professional services sector, while the remaining 20% focus on technology businesses. The company already operates in automotive, aerospace, and heavy machinery, and is working with chip manufacturers to develop software-defined vehicle solutions. Tata Technologies’ IPO, which was launched on November 22, is the Tata Group’s first public offering in 20 years. Harris expressed plans for further growth in the auto-tech business and reaffirmed the company's debt-free position. The article also touches on broader industry trends, such as the rising role of women in Indian corporate leadership, Tesla’s investment interests in India, and upcoming changes in government finance policies. The United States House of Representatives has voted to censure Rashida Tlaib, the only Palestinian American in Congress, for her remarks regarding the Israel-Hamas conflict. In a 234 to 188 vote held on Tuesday night, 22 Democrats joined Republicans in supporting a resolution that accused the Michigan Democrat of 'promoting false narratives' about the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack on Israel and of 'calling for the destruction of the state of Israel.' Censure is a formal reprimand—one step below expulsion—and follows a failed attempt at censure the previous week.

The resolution comes amid an escalating humanitarian crisis in Gaza. Over 10,000 Palestinians have been killed since Israel began its bombardment of the territory following a Hamas attack that left at least 1,400 people dead and more than 200 taken captive. Despite mounting international calls for a ceasefire, the US—historically one of Israel’s strongest allies—has resisted such appeals.

Congresswoman Tlaib, who has openly criticized the Israeli government and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, has also denounced the Hamas assault. Prior to the vote, she declared she would 'not be silenced' or have her words distorted, emphasizing that her criticism targets the government of Israel—not its people. 'The idea that criticizing the government of Israel is antisemitic sets a dangerous precedent,' she said, adding that it has been used to suppress diverse human rights voices in the US.

Debate around the censure, introduced by Republican Rich McCormick of Georgia, was highly emotional. Some representatives focused on Tlaib's use of the slogan 'from the river to the sea,' which they argued signifies an 'aspirational call for freedom, human rights, and peaceful coexistence' while others, such as Brad Schneider, a Jewish Democrat from Illinois, contended that it implies a call for the destruction of Israel.

Schneider stated, 'I will always defend the right to free speech. Tlaib has the right to say whatever she wants, but it cannot go unanswered.'

Other Democrats, like Jamie Raskin, warned that censuring Tlaib could undermine free speech and set a troublesome precedent, stating, 'This resolution not only degrades our constitution, but it cheapens the meaning of discipline in this body for people who actually commit wrongful actions like bribery, fraud, violent assault and so on.'

Lawmakers who are censured must stand on the House floor as the resolution is read aloud. Tlaib will now become the second Muslim-American woman in Congress, after Ilhan Omar, to be formally reproved this year over criticism of Israel. Earlier in 2023, Republicans voted to remove Omar from the House Foreign Affairs Committee.

அமெரிக்க காங்கிரஸில் ஒரே பிலஸ்தீனிய-அமெரிக்க உறுப்பினர் ரஷீதா தலிப், இஸ்ரேல்-ஹமாஸ் சமரசத்தைப் பற்றிய கருத்துகளுக்காக சபையில் கண்டன தீர்மானம் பெற்றுள்ளார். செவ்வாய்க்கிழமை இரவு நடைபெற்ற வாக்குப்பதிவில் 234-188 என, 22 ஜனநாயகர்கள் குடியரசுக்கட்சியுடன் சேர்ந்து, தலிப்பின் கருத்துகள் 'பொய்யான தகவல்களை' பரப்பியதாகவும், 'இஸ்ரேல் மாநிலத்தைக் அழிக்க அழைப்பு விடுத்ததாகவும்' தெரிவிக்கும் தீர்மானத்தை ஆதரித்தனர். கண்டன தீர்மானம் வெளியேற்றத்திற்கு உரிய ஒரு படியே ஆகும்; இது கடந்த வாரம் தோல்வியடைந்த முயற்சியை தொடர்ந்து வருகிறது.

இந்த தீர்மானம் தற்போது காசாவில் ஏற்ப்பட்டுள்ள மனிதாபிமான நெருக்கடியை ஒட்டியது. ஹமாஸ் அக்டோபர் 7-ஆம் தேதி நடத்திய தாக்குதலை தொடர்ந்து, இஸ்ரேல் காசாவை குறிவைத்து நடத்தும் தாக்குதலில் 10,000-க்கு மேற்பட்ட பிலஸ்தீனியர்கள் உயிரிழந்துள்ளனர். இந்த தாக்குதலில் குறைந்தது 1,400 இஸ்ரேலியர்கள் உயிரிழந்துள்ளதுடன், 200-க்கும் மேற்பட்டவர்கள் கடத்தப்பட்டுள்ளனர். சர்வதேச அளவில் இடைநிறுத்த கோரிக்கைகள் அதிகரித்துள்ள போதும், அமெரிக்கா – நீண்டநாள் இஸ்ரேலுக்கு உறுதியான ஆதரவாளராக உள்ளது – அவற்றை ஏற்க மறுக்கிறது.

தலிப், இஸ்ரேல் அரசு மற்றும் பிரதமர் பென்யமின் நேத்தன்யாகுவையும் திறம்பாக விமர்சித்து, ஹமாஸின் தாக்குதலை சீண்டினார். வாக்குப்பதிவுக்கு முன்னர், 'தன் கருத்துகளை மறைக்க முடியாது' என்று, தனது விமர்சனங்கள் இஸ்ரேல் மக்கள் மீது அல்ல, அதன் அரசைக் குறித்தவை எனவும் வலியுறுத்தினார். 'இஸ்ரேல் அரசைக் குறியீட்டு விமர்சிப்பது ஆட்டிசெமிடிசம் என்று கூறுவது ஆபத்தான முன்னுதாரணம்' என்றும், இது அமெரிக்காவிலும் பல்வேறு மனித உரிமை குரல்களை அழுத்தும் முயற்சி என்றும் கூறினார்.

ஜார்ஜியாவை சேர்ந்த குடியரசுக்கட்சியினர் ரிச் மெக்கோர்மிக் அறிமுகப்படுத்திய இந்த தீர்மானம் தீவிரமாக விவாதிக்கப்பட்டது. சில உறுப்பினர்கள் தலிப் அடிக்கடி பயன்படுத்தும் 'நதியிலிருந்து கடலுக்கு' என்ற வாசகத்தை 'சுதந்திரம், மனித உரிமைகள், அமைதி மற்றும் ஒத்துழைப்பு' என மதிப்பீடு செய்தனர்; ஆனால், இலக Illinois மாநிலத்தை சேர்ந்த யூத ஜனநாயக உறுப்பினர் ப்ராட் ஷ்னைடர், இது இஸ்ரேல் நாட்டின் அழிவு குறித்து அழைப்பு விடுப்பதாகக் கூறினார்.

'நான் எப்போதும் பேச்சு சுதந்திரத்தை பாதுகாப்பேன். தலிப்புக்கு தன் கருத்துகளை கூற உரிமை உண்டு. ஆனால் அது பதிலின்றி விட முடியாது' எனவும், 'பேச்சு சுதந்திரத்தை இதனால் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்' என்று கூறினார்.

மற்ற ஜனநாயகர்கள், உட்பட ஜேமி ராஸ்கின், தலிப் மீது கண்டன தீர்மானம் நடைமுறைப்படுத்தல் பேச்சு சுதந்திரத்தை பாதிக்கும் என்றும், இது தவறான முன்னுதாரணத்தை அமைக்கும் என்றும் எச்சரித்தனர். 'இந்த தீர்மானம் அரசியலமைப்பை மதிப்பை குறைக்கும்; மேலும், உண்மையான குற்றங்களுக்கு விதிக்கப்படும் தண்டனையின் அர்த்தத்தையும் சீர்குலைக்கும்' என்று அவர் தெரிவித்தார்.

கண்டனமாக்கப்பட்ட உறுப்பினர்கள் சபைநிலையில் நின்று தீர்மானம் வாசிக்கப்படுகிறபோது இருக்க வேண்டும். இந்த ஆண்டில் இஸ்ரேலை விமர்சித்ததாக உத்தியோகபூர்வ குற்றச்சாட்டு எதிர்கொள்ளும் இரண்டாவது முஸ்லிம்-அமெரிக்க பெண் உறுப்பினராக தலிப் இருக்கிறார். போட்டியில் இன் 2023ஆம் ஆண்டு இல்ஹான் ஒமார் வெளிநாடுகள் பற்றிய குழுவில் இருந்து நீக்கப்பட்டார்.

article_content: Widespread flooding has caused severe devastation in Downpatrick and other towns across counties Down, Armagh, and Antrim. Paul McCartan, a local business owner with two shops in Downpatrick, said the devastation was overwhelming and pleaded for government assistance. He noted that despite being insured, his policy does not cover floods, leaving him in a difficult position. After over four decades in the town, he described the destruction as 'heartbreaking.' Brian Rodgers, who owns a clothing store in Downpatrick, reported that floodwaters reached chest height and estimated £150,000 worth of Christmas stock was inaccessible. Critical streets like Market Street in Downpatrick remained submerged, and the Department for Infrastructure said high-volume pumps could only be used once river levels decreased. SDLP assembly member Colin McGrath described Downpatrick as experiencing 'apocalyptic scenes,' with around 25 businesses severely damaged. Concerns remained about further risks due to upcoming high tides. The Department for Infrastructure termed the rain an 'exceptional natural event.' Public transportation was heavily disrupted, with bus services suspended and parts of Portadown in Armagh still deeply affected. Translink’s depot in Downpatrick was cut off and ten bus routes were paused. Many local businesses were not protected by flood insurance, leading to calls for financial support from the UK government, though the Northern Ireland Office described this as largely a devolved matter. The Department for Communities began offering emergency payments of £1,000 for residents whose homes were flooded. Engineering teams assessed that floodwaters in Market Street might not recede for another 24 hours. In Kilkeel, County Down, Newcastle Road was closed due to major structural damage. Despite police warnings, some drivers ignored road closure signs. Local politicians highlighted the damaging impact on towns and the sense of isolation felt by many residents. In Portadown, water levels remained dangerously high, making rescue and relief challenging. Volunteers were delivering sandbags and essentials by boat. Homes and businesses were inundated, forcing people to rely on outside help for necessities. Sports facilities like Annagh United football club suffered severe damage, affecting the wider community. Recovery teams such as Watson Autos reported over 20 vehicles retrieved from floodwaters within a day. The Department for Infrastructure received more than 13,000 calls and distributed an equal number of sandbags since the flooding began. The Scheme of Emergency Financial Assistance was made available to homeowners, and authorities continued to urge the public to heed safety warnings as many roads remained impassable.

article_content:
A recent statement by Infosys co-founder Narayana Murthy about young Indians working 70 hours a week has sparked widespread discussion across the country. His suggestion, aimed at boosting national productivity, has divided public opinion. Supporters view longer hours as a step toward faster progress, while critics caution that it may be detrimental to workers’ health and effectiveness.

Murthy emphasized that greater dedication from youth could help India grow. In contrast, Somdutta Singh, CEO of Assiduus Global and advisor to Niti Aayog, stressed that while hard work is important, a 70-hour workweek risks employee burnout and may not sustainably increase productivity. She noted that balancing professional commitment with personal well-being should not be overlooked.

Dhirendra Vashisht, Director of India Operations at Bastian Solutions, echoed the call for better productivity but warned that excessive hours often lead to mental health problems and reduced workplace performance. He advocates focusing on smarter, not just longer, work methods.

Ambika Sharma, founder of Pulp Strategy, argued that for many outside the corporate sector—like entrepreneurs, health professionals, and informal workers—extended hours have long been common practice. She pointed out that debates on hours primarily concern a small portion of urban, corporate employees.

Experts generally agree that in today’s world, efficiency, innovation, and the quality of outcomes outweigh the mere number of hours worked. Singh urged companies to measure success by results and creativity, with technology reducing the need for lengthy workweeks—an idea also anticipated by economist John Maynard Keynes, who predicted that technological progress would eventually shorten the average workweek significantly.

Meanwhile, rural demand for consumer goods in India has risen, Snapchat’s Indian user base has rapidly increased, and the government is considering slower growth in capital spending to manage the fiscal deficit. As industries evolve, perspectives on the ideal work-life balance continue to adapt, reflecting India’s diverse economic and social realities.

article_content: Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot has alleged that BJP members were involved in the murder of Kanhaiya Lal, a tailor from Udaipur. He claims the BJP is amplifying the case to incite communal tension before the upcoming state elections. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has accused the Congress-led government of focusing on vote-bank politics instead of justice for Lal. Kanhaiya Lal was killed on June 28 last year by Mohammad Riyaz and Ghouse Mohammad, who attacked him over alleged comments against Islam. Gehlot says the accused were previously arrested on unrelated charges and bailed out with BJP support, suggesting aspects of the case remain unresolved. Gehlot, responding to criticisms from Modi, implied that the Prime Minister lacked full information about the case. He stated that when the suspects were apprehended days before the murder, BJP affiliates helped secure their bail, questioning why this was overlooked by Modi. In response, BJP spokesperson Laxmikant Bhardwaj denied the allegations, calling them baseless and politically driven. Bhardwaj claimed Gehlot is attempting to cover up his government’s failure to maintain law and order and added that Lal had sought police protection but was denied it. Gehlot also questioned the NIA’s investigation, noting that Rajasthan Police had made quick arrests, yet the case has stalled under federal oversight. He insinuated this might be for political gain ahead of elections. Furthermore, Gehlot criticized BJP leaders for not showing sufficient support to Lal's family, positioning his actions as more responsive. He urged Prime Minister Modi to use language that fosters unity rather than division.

article_content:
While many view climbing the Himalayas as the ultimate test for adventurers, descending can be just as challenging—especially for those daring enough to try the world's most extreme zipline. The ZipFlyer Nepal, located in Sarangkot near Pokhara, gives thrill-seekers a breathtaking descent from a platform overlooking the Himalayas. Riders experience a dramatic vertical drop of nearly 2,000 feet (610 meters), racing 1.8 kilometers (1.12 miles) over dense forests with an extraordinary 56% incline.

The ride, operated by High Ground Adventures, propels participants at speeds up to 100 miles per hour (160 km/h). Gravity takes over as soon as the countdown ends, delivering a rush of weightlessness and wind as you soar above the landscape. At the end of the ride, an advanced magnetic braking system brings you safely to a complete stop.

Along the way, riders are treated to panoramic vistas of the 23,000-foot Machapuchare peak, the Annapurna range, and the Seti River. The ZipFlyer Nepal has captured attention worldwide, with its promotional video surpassing 186,000 views on YouTube since June 2012. For adventure lovers seeking thrills and stunning views, this zipline offers an unforgettable experience.

article_content: British climber Daniel Hughes has sparked criticism from Nepalese authorities by making the first-ever live video call from the summit of Mount Everest without obtaining official permission. Using his smartphone, Hughes contacted the BBC, marking a historic moment for Everest communications. However, regulations in Nepal require prior government approval for media activity on the mountain, which Hughes did not have. Upon returning to Kathmandu, Hughes is likely to face an official warning from Nepalese officials. His call, notable for his red clown nose in support of Comic Relief, has drawn significant attention. Purnachandra Bhattarai, a representative from Nepal's tourism ministry, stated that Hughes violated regulations by conducting and broadcasting media activities without authorization. The trekking agency that assisted Hughes is also under investigation. Specific consequences for Hughes and the agency have yet to be determined. The event took place during a stretch of favorable weather, enabling 146 climbers—including the first women from Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, and the first Indian twins—to reach the summit. Everest continues to see climbs for charity and personal goals, but recent seasons have also been clouded by controversies, such as a reported confrontation between climbers and Sherpas. This season also marks the 60th anniversary of the first successful summit by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay. Hughes’s climb aimed to raise £1 million for Comic Relief, garnering global attention for both his ascent and fundraising effort.

article_content: Anyone interested in owning a piece of Rob Ford’s history now has the opportunity. Rob Ford, the former Toronto mayor and current city councilor, is auctioning off a collection of memorabilia he has gathered over the years. Notably among the items is the football tie he wore when he admitted to smoking crack cocaine, which features logos from NFL teams, both past and present. According to the eBay listing, Ford notes that this tie is unique—'the only one of these in existence.' Other items up for auction include a Saskatchewan Roughriders jersey inscribed with 'MAYOR FORD' (current bid: $795.39), patterned pajama pants he was seen wearing on a shopping trip to Wal-Mart (current bid: $160.91, up from $80.25), and a framed 'Keep Calm and Carry On' poster (current bid: $158.92, up from $121.18). Each item comes with a certificate of authenticity signed by Ford. Ten percent of the auction proceeds will benefit research and care facilities for liposarcoma, the rare cancer Ford is currently being treated for. By Wednesday evening, the tie had attracted bids as high as $1,410.41. article_content: Hertz is scaling back its ambitious plans to increase electric vehicles in its rental fleet, after encountering more difficulties than expected. The company has been challenged by high repair expenses and steep depreciation of EVs, prompting a more cautious strategy. While EVs remain in the picture, CEO Stephen Scherr confirmed during Hertz’s third-quarter earnings call that the adoption will be slower than first anticipated. "We recognize the obstacles and are working to address them as best as we can," Scherr stated. Hertz initially aimed for electric cars to comprise 25% of its fleet by the end of 2024, but that target has been dropped. Currently, around 11% of Hertz’s vehicles are electric, most of them Teslas. The company has invested in electrification since 2021, with agreements to buy 100,000 Teslas, 175,000 GM vehicles, and 65,000 Polestar EVs, as well as a partnership with Uber to provide EVs for drivers. Still, integrating these cars has been challenging, because ride-share drivers have caused more damage to EVs than anticipated. Hertz responded by reallocating many EVs from ride-share to the standard rental fleet, causing an oversupply and lowering rental income per day. Scherr added that repairing an electric vehicle usually costs about double what it costs for a similar gasoline vehicle, though maintenance on EVs tends to be less expensive, since they don’t need oil changes and are simpler machines. Tesla’s frequent price drops over the last year have further eroded the market value of Hertz's EVs, worsening losses when EVs are salvaged. Tesla CEO Elon Musk had stated the company would not give Hertz a bulk discount. According to Scherr, Hertz’s profits for the quarter would have been significantly higher if their fleet did not include as many EVs. However, Hertz remains committed to advancing electrification in the long term. This adjustment by Hertz echoes a wider slowdown in the electric car industry. After years of explosive growth, EVs have started sitting unsold at dealerships, pushing automakers to lower prices and boost incentives. High interest rates are also making EVs harder to afford. Automakers such as Ford and GM, who were previously very optimistic about electric cars, are now halting major investments and expanding EV production more slowly.

During the trial of Casey Anthony, her mother, Cindy Anthony, testified that she—not Casey—conducted Internet searches for 'chloroform' on the family computer in March 2008. Cindy claimed her searches were prompted by concerns over her smallest Yorkshire terrier’s unusual tiredness, possibly linked to the dog's habit of eating bamboo leaves. This concern led her to search for 'chlorophyll' and, subsequently, 'chloroform,' after she learned that certain plants produce it naturally.

Prosecutors questioned Cindy’s credibility by pointing to her work records, which suggested she was not home when the searches occurred. In response, Cindy explained she sometimes returned home early, which may not have been recorded. She maintained she had told law enforcement about these searches before, but admitted not recalling typing specific phrases like 'How to make chloroform' or 'neck breaking.' She also stated that other search terms, such as those related to bodily injuries, were related to a friend's accident, and that she searched for 'hydrogen peroxide' and 'alcohol' following a co-worker’s warning about hand sanitizers.

Cindy further testified that a stain in Casey’s Pontiac Sunfire trunk—alleged by prosecutors to have resulted from Caylee's body—could have been there when the car was bought. Prosecutors pressed Cindy on the timing of her revelations, questioning why they surfaced years after the investigation.

Outside the courtroom, the Anthonys' lawyer Mark Lippman declared that George and Cindy do not know whether Casey is guilty or innocent and emphasized their desire for the truth. Lippman explained that Cindy's memory had improved following a change in her medication. Casey Anthony is on trial for the 2008 death of her two-year-old daughter, Caylee, and faces the death penalty if convicted. She asserts that Caylee drowned by accident.

article_content: Jimi Odimayo, an APC governorship aspirant in Ondo State and a member of the House of Representatives, has applauded the organizers and key players in the recent off-cycle governorship elections in Kogi, Bayelsa, and Imo states. He regards the smooth execution of these elections as a sign that Nigeria’s democracy is advancing. In his Akure-issued statement, signed by Director of Media and Publicity Kayode Fasua, Odimayo acknowledged that although some minor challenges occurred, the largely peaceful conduct of the elections demonstrates Nigeria's growing democratic reputation. He emphasized the teamwork displayed by governorship candidates, supporters, electoral officials, security agencies, and the media, which was crucial to the seamless, incident-free nature of the polls. Odimayo believes these collective efforts are boosting Nigeria’s international image. As Odimayo seeks the APC ticket for Ondo’s November 2024 governorship election, he expressed optimism for a transparent and calm electoral process in the state. He stressed that Ondo residents value democracy and are keen on developmental progress. In addition, Odimayo praised President Bola Tinubu for his impartial leadership and inclusive policy-making, emphasizing the president’s efforts to involve people from all political backgrounds in efforts toward national development. While acknowledging the current economic difficulties, he encouraged Nigerians to stay resilient, pointing to Tinubu’s aspirations for economic revival and empowerment. Odimayo, who chairs the House Committee on National Population Commission, mentioned recent oversight interactions with the National Identity Management Commission, focusing on cooperation to improve national population data and aid in development planning.

MUMBAI: For only the second time in 20 years, India’s currency in circulation (CIC) declined during Diwali week, as more citizens turned to digital payment methods for their festive shopping. According to data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Wednesday, CIC dropped by Rs 5,934 crore in the week ending November 17, bringing the total to Rs 33.6 lakh crore. This year, Diwali was celebrated between November 10 and November 14.

Overall, the current financial year has seen a decrease in currency in circulation by Rs 22,721 crore. Part of this decline can be attributed to the withdrawal of Rs 2,000 banknotes; however, bankers note that this process was largely completed in October, with 97% of the notes having been returned.

Soumya Kanti Ghosh, group chief economic adviser at SBI, commented that the continued decline in cash circulation highlights the growing influence of digital transactions. “With the increased acceptance of digital payments across the country, dependence on cash is gradually diminishing. In October 2023 alone, UPI transactions increased month-on-month by 85.3 crore transactions, amounting to Rs 1,36,600 crore,” he said.

An SBI Ecowrap research report analyzed Diwali week currency trends over the last two decades. It found that, with the exception of 2009—after the global financial crisis—currency in circulation has typically risen during Diwali week. For example, in 2021, CIC increased by Rs 44,000 crore, and in 2020, by Rs 43,800 crore during the festival week.

மும்பை: கடந்த 20 ஆண்டுகளில் இரண்டாவது முறையாக இந்த வருடம் தீபாவளி வாரத்தில் இந்தியாவின் சுற்றிலிருக்கும் நடையில் (CIC) குறைவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது, ஏனெனில் அதிகமான மக்கள் தங்களின் பண்டிகை வாங்குதலுக்கு டிஜிட்டல் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை நாடி வருகின்றனர். இந்திய ரிசர்வ் வங்கி (RBI) புதன்கிழமை வெளியிட்ட தகவலின்படி, நவம்பர் 17 முடிவடையும் வாரத்தில் CIC ரூ.5,934 கோடிகள் குறைந்து, மொத்தமாக ரூ.33.6 லட்சம் கோடிகள் உள்ளன. இந்த வருடம் தீபாவளி நவம்பர் 10 முதல் 14 வரை கொண்டாடப்பட்டது.

In an unexpected cinematic showdown, Martin Scorsese’s Killers Of The Flower Moon faced off against Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour at the box office this past weekend. For the second straight weekend, Taylor Swift’s concert film led the North American box office, while Scorsese’s Killers Of The Flower Moon had a strong start, marking Apple Studios’ first major theatrical release.

Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour, uniquely distributed by AMC Theatres and shown only Thursday through Sunday, grossed an estimated US$31 million from 3,855 locations over the weekend. Although sales dropped 67% from its record-breaking US$92.8 million opening, the film quickly became the highest-grossing concert film ever in North America (not adjusted for inflation), totaling US$129.8 million domestically.

Killers Of The Flower Moon, a historical crime drama centering on the Osage Nation murders in the 1920s, cost over US$200 million to make—Apple’s largest production to date. Based on David Grann’s nonfiction bestseller and starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Lily Gladstone, and Robert De Niro, it is distributed in partnership with Paramount Pictures, with plans to stream on Apple TV+ in the future. It debuted with US$23 million domestically and brought in US$21 million internationally, making it Scorsese’s third-best opening after Shutter Island and The Departed. Despite its 206-minute runtime and adult focus—a type that hasn’t fared well at the box office recently—the film received rave reviews and an 'A-' CinemaScore.

Killers Of The Flower Moon achieved the best wide-release debut yet for a film from a streaming studio, highlighting industry shifts toward hybrid release strategies. Apple plans to invest about US$1 billion per year in films that premiere in theaters before reaching its streaming service, as seen with upcoming releases like Ridley Scott’s Napoleon and Matthew Vaughn’s Argylle.

Rounding out the box office top five were Exorcist: The Believer (US$6.7 million), PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie (US$4.3 million), and the 30th-anniversary rerelease of Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas (US$4.1 million). Interestingly, 44% of Killers Of The Flower Moon’s audience was under 30, exceeding expectations. As noted by David A. Gross of Franchise Entertainment Research, the performance of these films demonstrates new flexibility and opportunity in today’s theatrical movie business.
