Nearly nine out of ten parents believe their child is performing at grade level, even though standardized tests show that far fewer students are meeting expectations, according to a poll released by Gallup and the nonprofit Learning Heroes. Researchers note that report cards—relied upon by many parents to gauge their children’s progress—may not tell the full story. Without accurate information, parents might miss opportunities to seek additional support for their children.

“Grades are the holy grail,” said Bibb Hubbard, founder and president of Learning Heroes. “They are the number one indicator that parents use to assess if their child is on grade level, but getting a good grade does not necessarily mean a student has achieved grade-level mastery. No one is telling parents this.”

The Gallup survey found that 88% of parents believe their child is on grade level in reading, and 89% believe the same for math. In contrast, a federal survey revealed that half of U.S. students began the last school year behind grade level in at least one subject.

A separate report examining grade point averages and standardized test scores in Washington state over the past decade found grades rose during the COVID-19 pandemic, as many districts eased grading policies to accommodate students' challenges. Some of these lenient policies may still exist, masking learning gaps that become apparent in standardized tests but not in report card grades, according to Dan Goldhaber, co-author of the study and director of the Center for Analysis of Longitudinal Data in Education Research.

School districts nationwide have used federal pandemic relief funds to launch programs aiming to help students catch up academically, including intensive tutoring and summer academic programs. However, Dan Goldhaber noted that participation in these programs is often lower than expected. For voluntary programs like summer school or online tutoring, only a fraction of the eligible or invited students actually participate.

The Gallup poll highlights this trend, pointing to families who may not realize they need to take action regarding their child's academic progress. Among over 2,000 parents of K-12 students surveyed, only half had discussed their child's academic progress with a teacher. However, among parents who knew their child was behind in math, 74% had spoken with a teacher.

Sarah Carpenter, director of The Memphis Lift, a parent advocacy group, said report cards usually lack sufficient detail. "A report card is really tricky, in our opinion, because you're just looking at A's, B's, and C's," she explained. "It doesn’t tell you what reading level your child is at, which confuses parents."

Trenace Dorsey-Hollins, parent and founder of Parent Shield Fort Worth in Texas, emphasized the need for informed advocacy: “Knowledge is power. Parents don’t know what they don’t know, and nobody should blame themselves. But once they have the information, they can demand better and ensure their children get what they need.”

பத்திலொன்றில் ஒன்பது பெற்றோர் தங்கள் குழந்தை வகுப்பு மட்டத்தில் இருக்கிறார்கள் என்று நம்புகிறார்கள், ஆனால் தரநிலைத் தேர்வுகள் குறைவான மாணவர்களே அந்த நிலை வீரர்கள் என்பதை காட்டுகின்றன. இந்த தகவல் Gallup மற்றும் Learning Heroes ஐ சேர்ந்த மக்கள் நல அமைப்புகள் வெளியிட்ட ஆய்வில் வெளிப்பட்டது.

ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுவதாவது, பெற்றோர் பலர் குழந்தைகளின் முன்னேற்றத்தை மதிப்ப்கொள்ளும் போது பயன்படுத்தும் மதிப்பெண் அட்டைகள் (report cards) முழுமையான தகவலை வழங்கவில்லை. இந்த உண்மையான நிலையை அறியவில்லை என்றால், பெற்றோர் கூடுதல் உதவி பெறும் வாய்ப்புகளை தவற முடியும்.

"மதிப்பெண்கள் என்பது பெரிய விசயம்," என்று Learning Heroes நிறுவனர்-தலைவர் பிப் ஹப்பர்ட் கூறுகிறார். "ஆனால் ஒரு நல்ல மதிப்பெண் கிடைப்பது, குழந்தை வகுப்பு மட்டத்தில் இருக்கிறான் என்று அர்த்தமில்லை; பெற்றோருக்கு இதை அப்படிச் சொல்லவில்லை."

Gallup ஆய்வில், 88% பெற்றோர் தங்கள் குழந்தை வாசிப்பில் வகுப்பு மட்டத்தில்தான் இருக்கிறார் என நம்புகிறார்கள், கணிதம் சம்பந்தப்பட்டு 89% பெற்றோர் இதே நம்பிக்கையில் உள்ளனர். ஆனால், ஒரு கூட்டரசு சோதனை கணக்கெடுப்பில், கடந்த ஆண்டு பாதி மாணவர்கள் குறைந்தது ஒரு பாடத்தில் வகுப்பு முடிவுக்கு உட்பட்டதாகக் கண்டு பிடிக்கப்பட்டது.

வாஷிங்டன் மாநிலத்தில் சமீப ஆண்டு கால மதிப்பெண்கள் மற்றும் டெஸ்ட் மதிப்பீடுகள் தொடர்பான ஆய்வில், COVID-19 காலத்தில் பல மாவட்டங்கள் மதிப்பெண் கொள்கையில் தளர்வு செய்ததால் மதிப்பெண்கள் உயர்ந்துள்ளன. இம்மாதிரியான தளர்வுகள் இன்னும் சில இடங்களில் தொடரக்கூடும்; தரவுகள் காட்டுவது, வகுப்பு விதிகளை விட தரநிலை தேர்வுகளில் மட்டும் கற்றல் குறைபாடுகள் வெளிப்படும், என்று பேராசிரியர் டான் கோல்ட்ஹேபர் (Dan Goldhaber, Center for Analysis of Longitudinal Data in Education Research) கூறுகிறார்.

மாநிலம் முழுவதும், பள்ளிகள் பாண்டமிக் நிவாரண நிதியுடன் கல்வி பயிற்சி, கோடை வகுப்புகள் போன்ற முன்னேற்ற திட்டங்கள் அன்பளிப்பினை செய்தும், Goldhaber விவரிப்பது: பங்கேற்பு எதிர்பார்த்த அளவு இல்லை. கோடை பள்ளி அல்லது இணைய வழிக் கல்வி போன்ற திட்டங்களில் அழைக்கப்பட்டவர்களில் ஒருசில பங்கேற்கின்றனர்.

Gallup ஆய்வு இதையெல்லாம் வெளிக்காட்டுகிறது; பெற்றோர்களுக்கு குழந்தையின் கல்வி நிலையை உணர்ந்து நடவடிக்கை எடுக்க வேண்டியதுண்டு. ஆய்வில் 2,000-க்கும் மேற்பட்ட பெற்றோர்களில் பாதி மட்டுமே ஆசிரியரை சந்தித்து குழந்தையின் கல்வி முன்னேற்றம் குறித்து விவாதித்துள்ளனர். ஆனால், மத்தியில் பெற்றோர் குழந்தை கணிதத்தில் பின்தங்கியிருப்பதாக அறிந்தவர்களில் 74% ஆசிரியரைச் சந்தித்துள்ளனர்.

Memphis Lift அமைப்பின் இயக்குநர் சரா கார்பென்டர், "report card ஒரே A, B, C பார்ப்பது தான்; ஆனால் உங்கள் குழந்தை வாசிப்பு தரநிலையைச் சொல்ல மறுக்கும் என்பதால் பெற்றோர் குழப்பத்தில் விழுகிறார்கள்" என்று அறிவுறுத்துகிறார்.

Texas மாநிலம், Parent Shield Fort Worth நிறுவனத்தினை நிறுவிய Trenace Dorsey-Hollins, "அறிவு சக்தி. பெற்றோர் தெரியாததை தெரிந்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டியது உறுதி. யாரும் தங்களை குற்றம் சொல்ல வேண்டியதில்லை. தகவல் வந்ததும், நல்லவை கேட்டுக்கொள்ளுங்கள் - உங்கள் குழந்தை மற்றும் மற்றவர்களுக்கும் தேவையானதை பெற்றுக் கொள்ளவும்" என்று உறுதியளிக்கிறார்.

NEW DELHI: Seizures of unaccounted cash, illicit liquor, drugs, and other potential inducements during elections in five poll-bound states showed a seven-fold increase in value, reaching Rs 1,760 crore by November 20, compared to Rs 239 crore in 2018, according to Election Commission data. Nearly three-fourths of these seizures came from Rajasthan and Telangana. Telangana led with Rs 659 crore in confiscations since the election announcement, closely followed by Rajasthan with Rs 651 crore. As both states had not yet conducted polling at the time of reporting, these figures are expected to rise further.

Among states where voting has concluded, Madhya Pradesh recorded over Rs 323 crore in seizures, Chhattisgarh Rs 77 crore, and Mizoram Rs 49.6 crore. Telangana topped categories including cash, liquor, drugs, and precious metals, while Rajasthan reported the largest value and percentage of seized 'freebies' at Rs 341 crore, accounting for 61% of the total in that category.

Chhattisgarh saw the lowest liquor seizures at Rs 2.16 crore—less than half the value of liquor confiscated in Mizoram. Drug seizures in Mizoram (Rs 29.8 crore) also exceeded those in Chhattisgarh (Rs 4.55 crore).

The Election Commission attributes this significant rise in seizures to its rigorous monitoring efforts and the introduction of the Election Expenditure Monitoring System (ESMS)—a platform enabling real-time information sharing on the movement of illegal cash and inducements among enforcement agencies. Officials report that the internal application is functioning effectively to monitor election expenditures.

Previously, Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar had highlighted a surge in seizures during elections in six other states, totaling Rs 1,400 crore—11 times higher than the amount confiscated in prior polls in those states—underscoring the Commission's commitment to maintaining inducement-free elections.

Strategically planning your career conversation with your manager is essential, especially if you're aiming for a promotion, salary increase, or a lateral move within your organization. Such progress requires deliberate planning and effort, not luck.

Here are five crucial steps to maximize your next career conversation’s effectiveness:

1. Do What You Love
Reflect on your passions and strengths, both at work and outside. What tasks do you enjoy and excel at? Observe others in roles you’re interested in and ask them about their experiences and challenges. Investing time and effort in a career move makes sense only if it's the right fit for you.

2. Align with Company Objectives
As companies review their strategic priorities, this is a prime opportunity to discuss how your goals align with the organization’s vision. Research new initiatives, industry trends, or technologies like AI and hybrid work that impact your company. Highlight how your skills can help achieve these goals, supported by examples of your past impact.

3. Think Long-Term and Short-Term
Define your career roadmap: Where do you see yourself in a decade? Break this down into attainable goals for five years, three years, one year, and even 30 days from now. Micro-steps help turn your vision into reality and show your manager you’re serious about your growth.

4. Ask for Support on Areas of Improvement
Use self-reflection to identify skill gaps. Then, seek your manager’s feedback and inquire about support options like mentorship, training, or workshops. Your manager can help you identify opportunities and is a key ally in your development.

5. Prepare Adequately
Come to the meeting with an agenda and thoughtful questions. Schedule the conversation when both of you can focus, perhaps during a performance review. Preparation demonstrates accountability and commitment to your career.

By following these steps, you’ll approach your next career discussion with confidence, clearly presenting your value and aspirations, and opening up opportunities for advancement in line with your long-term goals.

article_content: Arthur Alleyne, 63, an experienced sailor and former captain of a ship featured in the Pirates of the Caribbean films, and his wife Sharon Went-Alleyne, 59, were found safe after disappearing in the Caribbean Sea. The couple had last been seen on Sunday, sailing from St Lucia to Barbados—a journey they've completed many times over their 25 years living in St Lucia. Their yacht, Serenity, went adrift for almost five days after encountering a storm. A large-scale search effort was launched by their children, who live in the UK. Rescue teams from Martinique, Barbados, and St Lucia joined the effort. Their daughter, Tao Alleyne, reported that while her parents were hungry and dehydrated, they were ultimately unharmed. Arthur, known as Captain Sam, previously captained The Brig Unicorn, a 148ft ship that appeared in all three Pirates of the Caribbean films and the television series Roots. The Brig Unicorn was built in Finland in 1948 and portrayed The Henrietta in The Curse of the Black Pearl and The Terrasaw in Dead Man's Chest and At World's End. The ship sank off St Vincent and the Grenadines in May of this year. The couple’s ordeal began as they were delivering Serenity back to its owner in Barbados, with Sharon accompanying Arthur for company. Tao last spoke to her mother on Friday, describing her as 'calm' and excited about the trip. Communication was lost on Saturday afternoon, and the last contact with the boat was at 2pm that day. An unclear voicemail featuring the sound of wind and waves was received the following day. Tao believed a severe storm might have damaged their yacht's communication equipment. Upon being found, Arthur immediately reassured his family by phone, joking about the anxiety he had caused. Tao praised her father’s calmness and expertise, noting his 40 years as a sailor and navigator on this familiar route. Arthur was born and raised in Barbados while Sharon is originally from Donnington in the UK. Their daughter, Tao, mentioned that her father seldom discussed his film work, possibly due to privacy agreements regarding the celebrities involved. The family expressed deep gratitude to the rescue teams involved. Arthur and Sharon are recovering from their ordeal but are otherwise in good health.

article_content: Communities Secretary Eric Pickles has expressed doubts over official estimates of how many Romanian and Bulgarian migrants will arrive in the UK when border restrictions are lifted next January. Government figures originally predicted that only 12,700 migrants would come to Britain each year—an estimate produced under the previous Labour government. These numbers were based on comparisons to migration from Poland, which far exceeded expectations after 2004. Senior members of the Coalition government, including Mr. Pickles, have criticized these estimates as 'unreliable' and significantly underestimated. Mr. Pickles, speaking to journalists, said he had 'no confidence' in the figures and revealed the research had been quietly published by ministers online in 2011. In 2004, when similar restrictions were lifted for Poland and nine other nations, Labour ministers predicted 13,000 arrivals per year, but the actual numbers reached over a million from Poland alone over the following nine years. Migration Watch UK, an independent campaign group, estimates that as many as 75,000 Romanians and Bulgarians could arrive in the UK each year once restrictions are removed. Its chairman, Sir Andrew Green, and Mr. Pickles agree the original estimate is too low and should not be the basis for policy—with many Romanians in Spain and Italy now unemployed and possibly seeking to move to the UK. To address potential pressures, the government is preparing measures to require new immigrants to register to use public services or claim benefits and is considering sending home those who fail to find work. The aim is to avoid making the UK more attractive through benefits or services. Minister for Local Government Brandon Lewis rejected accusations of a cover-up, stating the research had been published openly and should be treated with caution due to the historical unreliability of previous statistics.

article_content:
The Vermont Yankee nuclear reactor will shut down in late 2014 and be decommissioned, its owner announced Tuesday, citing low natural gas prices and high operating costs as the main reasons. "This shutdown decision was made because this asset is not financially viable," said Entergy Nuclear Vermont Yankee LLC. The 40-year-old plant, located in Windham County on the Connecticut River near the Massachusetts border, employs 630 workers. Decommissioning, a process expected to take decades, will include transferring spent fuel to storage. Entergy estimates decommissioning will cost $566 million, with $582 million currently set aside in its trust fund.

The plant uses a boiling water reactor built by General Electric and draws on river water for cooling. Its license was valid through 2032. Vermont Yankee was at the center of a dispute between state authorities and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) concerning its GE-designed Mark 1 containment housing, a design shared by 23 US reactors. The same design was used at Japan's Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant, where three reactors melted down after a 2011 earthquake and tsunami, resulting in widespread radioactive contamination and forcing over 100,000 people to evacuate. Despite concerns, the NRC denied petitions from anti-nuclear groups to shut US reactors with the GE Mark 1 design.

Japan faces decades of cleanup at Fukushima, one of the worst nuclear disasters since Chernobyl in 1986. The US nuclear industry has not built a new reactor since the 1970s, but in February 2012, the NRC approved two new reactors at Georgia's Vogtle plant, which differ from the Fukushima reactors. National Energy Institute President and CEO Marvin Fertel called the Vermont Yankee closure "a great loss to the state of Vermont, the regional economy, consumers, and the environment." However, the plant's finances suffered as the rise of shale gas led to cheaper natural gas.

A 2008 statement on Entergy's website projected Vermont Yankee would generate more than $2 billion in additional income for Windham County and Vermont, with state tax revenues exceeding $300 million. At that time, the plant supplied nearly a third of Vermont's electricity. Tuesday, Entergy reported over $400 million in operating costs since 2002.

Mark Cooper, a senior fellow at Vermont Law School, called the shutdown "the latest—but not the last—domino to fall for the struggling US nuclear power industry." He noted Duke Energy's decision to abandon a reactor project in Levy County, Florida, and EDF's withdrawal from the US market, citing nuclear power's inability to compete with alternatives and reduced demand growth due to energy efficiency. Recent shutdowns include two reactors at San Onofre (CA), and one each at Kewaunee (WI) and Crystal River (FL). "We are witnessing the rapid downsizing of US nuclear power," Cooper wrote. "The challenges facing the US nuclear industry are only expected to increase."

CNN's Matt Smith contributed to this report.

article_content: Alison Lundergan Grimes is running for the U.S. Senate in Kentucky, facing off against Republican leader Mitch McConnell. Throughout her campaign, Grimes has been vocal about her goal to raise the minimum wage and has criticized Republicans for alleged sexism. However, her family’s eatery, Hugh Jass Burgers, has come under the spotlight. Despite Grimes' public support for higher wages, documents indicate the restaurant pays some tipped staff only the minimum wage—a point her Republican opponents have seized upon to challenge her credibility. Recently, Grimes reaffirmed her commitment to improving working conditions, stating, 'I’m advocating for all Kentuckians. No family can thrive on $7.25 an hour.' When asked about the restaurant's wage policies, Grimes responded, 'My family isn’t running for office—I am. Mitch McConnell can attack them, but my campaign is focused on ensuring a fair future for hardworking Kentuckians, which includes not just a minimum wage, but a living wage.' She explained that, like in many restaurants, servers can supplement wages with tips. While she performed legal work for the business in the past, she is not its owner. Controversy also surrounds the restaurant's use of risqué humor, with menu items and merchandise featuring double entendres—like 'Charlotte’s Rack' and 'Abby’s Hugh Jass,' referencing her mother and sister, and an apron stating 'Check Out My Buns.' These branding choices have drawn criticism, especially since Grimes herself has accused her political opponents of sexism. She once remarked, 'Some Kentucky Republicans refer to me as an empty dress.' Grimes declined to answer questions about the suggestive names and branding, choosing instead to leave the conversation when asked by reporters.

article_content: The General Officer Commanding (GOC) of the 8 Division, Nigerian Army, Major General Godwin Mutkut, has called on all parties involved in the newly inaugurated Special Court Martial in Sokoto State to cooperate and ensure that justice is served. Major General Mutkut, who also commands the Joint Task Force, Operation Hadarin Daji, explained that the court-martial was established to address various alleged offences committed by Nigerian Army personnel in multiple operational areas across the nation. In his address at the inauguration, he stressed the importance of maintaining justice and fair hearings to strengthen service discipline—the foundation of military professionalism. Thus, he highlighted the necessity of inaugurating the Special Court Martial. "The court-martial, like all courts, is designed to provide justice not only to the victims of alleged crimes but also to the state and the accused persons," he stated. He urged the court to evaluate all evidence impartially and base their decisions on the merits of each case, emphasizing the principle that it is better for many guilty people to go free than for one innocent person to be wrongly convicted. Major General Mutkut further assured Army personnel facing trial that proceedings would be guided by the principles of natural justice and fair hearing, as enshrined in the 1999 Nigerian Constitution (as amended) and other relevant laws. "I assure you, the court will be free from external influence and will provide all accused adequate time and resources to defend themselves," he affirmed. The inauguration was attended by senior officers, including the President of the Court, Colonel Kabir Imam, formation commanders, and legal representatives for both prosecution and defense.

article_content: Strong demand for infrastructure investment, attractive returns, and favorable government policies have driven fund mobilization through listed REITs and InvITs to Rs 18,658 crore during April-September of the current fiscal year. This follows a fund collection of Rs 2,596 crore through listed Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) in the entire 2022-23 fiscal, while the amount raised through listed Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) was nil, according to data from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi). Experts believe that the trends seen in REITs and InvITs are likely to continue in the second half of the year. Himanshu Kohli, Co-founder of Client Associates, mentioned that fresh savings and investments toward InvITs will persist as both central and state governments maintain their focus on infrastructure development. According to Sebi data, Rs 18,658 crore was collected through these investment vehicles between April and September 2023, comprising Rs 12,753 crore through InvITs and Rs 5,905 crore via REITs. Karan Shetty, Co-Founder of Claravest, attributed the surge in fundraising to favorable government policies, high demand for real estate investment, and the government's emphasis on urbanization and infrastructure. Feroze Azeez, Deputy CEO of Anand Rathi Wealth, added that regular income distributions, diversification benefits, liquidity provided by listing on stock exchanges, and increased investor awareness have contributed to the growth of REITs and InvITs. By regulation, these trusts are required to distribute 90% of their income to investors. Furthermore, the government and Sebi have played an active role in popularizing and promoting REITs and InvITs in India. InvITs have become more popular than REITs for fundraising, as InvITs can invest in a broader range of assets such as roads, highways, bridges, railways, power transmission lines, renewable energy projects, and gas pipelines. InvITs are also exempt from paying income tax at the trust level, which increases their attractiveness to investors, Azeez explained. The infrastructure sector in India is expected to grow significantly, likely bolstering the growth of InvITs. Both REITs and InvITs are relatively new to Indian investors but are established global instruments popular for yielding passive income and capital appreciation. While a REIT consists of a portfolio of leased commercial real estate assets, InvITs hold infrastructure assets such as highways and power transmission assets. InvITs and REITs enable infrastructure developers to monetize their assets and reinvest capital in upcoming projects. However, these instruments are still new in India, with only four registered REITs and 22 registered InvITs as of August 8, 2023, according to Sebi data. Mutual funds' exposure to REITs and InvITs stood at Rs 8,416 crore as of September 30, 2023.

Netflix’s latest release, 'Rustin', stars Colman Domingo as Bayard Rustin, a lesser-known but crucial leader who organized the 1963 March on Washington for civil rights. At a Deadline Contenders event in Los Angeles, Domingo shared how bringing Rustin’s story to light felt like a meaningful responsibility, especially since Rustin’s experiences and identity as a gay man contributed to his historical obscurity.

Domingo recounted first learning about Rustin at his university’s African American Student Union, an experience that inspired him to re-examine historical narratives. He highlighted the value of acknowledging inspiring figures like Ella Baker and A. Philip Randolph, noting that their stories energize and educate new generations.

The film’s score, by Branford Marsalis, showcases an eclectic mix of big band, small ensembles, orchestral pieces, and even a collaboration with Sting. Marsalis emphasized that while 'Rustin' is rooted in Black history, its significance reaches everyone, describing it as an uplifting tale with universal appeal.

Produced by Barack and Michelle Obama, the film benefitted from the Obamas’ encouragement, with Domingo recalling President Obama’s motivating words during a Zoom call. 

Domingo hopes that the film serves as a beacon of hope amidst today’s challenges, reminding audiences that ordinary—often young—people have the power to create extraordinary change when they work together, just like Rustin did.

Managing shared expenses with friends or roommates can quickly become confusing or cause disagreements. Thankfully, user-friendly apps for Android and iOS make it much easier to track and split costs, whether for rent, restaurant bills, or group trips.

Splitwise is a popular choice for splitting household bills, vacation expenses, or meal tabs. You set up a group for each situation, log costs, and the app calculates who owes what. Splitwise supports various currencies, works offline, and saves expense data online so every group member can check updates.

Splitser allows everyone in a group to add, change, or remove transactions, ideal for clear and transparent expense management. With features such as the ability to create different lists, join friends' lists, track individual balances, send payment reminders, upload receipt photos, and invite people through messages—plus support for over 150 currencies—it covers nearly every expense-splitting need.

For travel, Tricount is designed for splitting group expenses on trips. Anyone can add personal expenses, and the app tallies totals, even if costs are split unevenly. This flexibility makes it perfect for families or groups with different budgets.

Settle Up offers a simple solution for dividing bills, supporting multiple currencies and languages, offline access, sharing with groups, and uneven splits—handy for both travelers and roommates.

If downloading a new app isn’t your thing, you can use UPI-based payment apps like Google Pay, Paytm, or PhonePe. They make it easy to create groups, enter transactions, notify members about what they owe, and handle repayments, though they don’t provide the advanced tracking features found in dedicated expense apps. For quick and simple bill splitting on the go, though, they work well.

Settle Up பல பணமதிப்பீடுகளுடன், இணையம் இல்லாமலுமே செயல்பட்டு, குழுக்களுக்கு பகிரும் வசதி, சமமாக இல்லா பில்கள் பகிரும் வசதிகள் வழங்குகிறது. பயணங்கள் மற்றும் வீட்டை பகிர்வோருக்கு இது பயனளிக்கிறது.

புதிய செயலி பதிவிறக்கம் செய்ய விரும்பவில்லை என்றால், Google Pay, Paytm, PhonePe போன்ற UPI செயலிகளை பயன்படுத்திக்கொள்ளலாம். அவை குழுவினரை அமைத்து, செலவுகளைப் பகிரவும், நினைவூட்டல் அனுப்பவும் வசதிகள் வழங்குகின்றன. இதில் விரிவான கண்காணிப்பு இல்லையென்றாலும், சுலபமான, விரைவான பில் பகிர்வுக்கு சிறந்தது.

Wages in the UK have outpaced inflation over the past year for the first time in two years, but signs suggest the job market is weakening. Between July and September, regular annual pay increased by 7.7%, exceeding inflation for the same period, according to data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS). However, wage growth is beginning to slow in some industries, and job vacancies are continuing to decline.

The UK's unemployment rate remained steady at 4.2%, but the number of job vacancies fell by 58,000 to 957,000 between August and October, marking the 16th consecutive monthly decline. Even so, vacancies remain above pre-pandemic levels.

For nearly two years, prices for food and energy rose much faster than wages, straining household budgets. While inflation is now easing, higher interest rates are putting additional pressure on consumers by raising mortgage and loan costs.

ONS figures show that regular pay (excluding bonuses) adjusted for inflation increased by 1% in the three months to September — the largest real increase since the same period in 2021. In September, average weekly earnings were £621 for regular pay and £673 including bonuses.

Despite the gap between pay increases and inflation widening, this is mainly attributed to slower price growth rather than significant pay hikes. Wage growth is slowing in sectors like construction and manufacturing as expectations for future price increases ease and the job market softens. In September, the average pay rise was the smallest in six months, and private sector increases were at their lowest since January.

The Bank of England has cautioned that higher interest rates could dampen hiring plans next year, potentially raising unemployment to 5%, which could mean over 150,000 job losses and further slowing wage growth. Jake Finney, an economist at PwC UK, observed that the labour market is "gradually cooling, not collapsing." He expects the Bank to keep interest rates steady at its December meeting, monitoring higher rates’ impact on jobs and the wider economy. Currently, financial markets do not anticipate rates rising above 5.25%, and some analysts suggest rates could be cut next year.

Chancellor Jeremy Hunt is set to announce the increase to the National Living Wage in next week’s Autumn Statement. He has promised it will rise to at least £11 per hour for the main rate — an increase of over 5% or roughly £1,000 more per year for full-time workers. While this news is positive for the two million workers who earn this wage, some employers are concerned about the impact on their costs.

Marc Bridgen, owner of The Dog at Wingham in Kent, supports the wage rise but says he may be forced to raise prices to accommodate the increase. "We've been absorbing cost rises for a long time and recently raised our prices. If wages rise by 10% in April, that’s over £1,000 a week in additional costs, which requires selling a lot more food and drink," he said.

Responding to the latest figures, Chancellor Hunt said, "It’s heartening to see inflation falling and real wages growing, keeping more money in people’s pockets. The Autumn Statement will expand on our plans to get people back to work and support UK growth."

However, Labour’s shadow work and pensions secretary, Liz Kendall, argued that the figures reflect "the Tories' failure on the economy," noting the employment rate has not returned to pre-pandemic levels, unlike other G7 countries, and record numbers are out of work due to long-term illness.

பிரிட்டனில் சம்பளங்கள் கடந்த இரண்டாண்டுகளில் முதன்முறையாக பணவீக்கத்தை விட வேகமாக உயர்ந்துள்ளன, ஆனால் வேலை சந்தை பலவீனமாக இருப்பது குறித்த அறிகுறிகள் உள்ளன. ஜூலை முதல் செப்டம்பர் வரை, வழக்கமான ஆண்டுக்கான சம்பளம் 7.7% உயர்ந்துள்ளது என Office for National Statistics (ONS) தெரிவித்துள்ளது, இது அதே காலப்பகுதியில் பணவீக்கத்தை விட அதிகமாக உள்ளது. இருப்பினும், சில துறைகளில் சம்பள உயர்கள்கள் மெதுவடையத் தொடங்கியுள்ளன, மேலும் வேலைவாய்ப்பு அப்ளிக்கேஷன்கள் தொடர்ந்து குறைந்து வருகின்றன.

பிரிட்டனின் வேலைஇழப்பு விகிதம் 4.2% ஆக நிலைத்திருக்கிறது, ஆனால் கடந்த ஆகஸ்ட் முதல் அக்டோபர் வரை வேலை வாய்ப்பு எண்ணிக்கை 58,000 என குறைந்து, 9,57,000 ஆக உள்ளதாக 16வது மாதமாக தொடர்ச்சி குறைவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், வேலைவாய்ப்புகள் தொற்று நோய் காலத்திற்கு முந்தைய நிலைகளைக் காட்டிலும் அதிகமாகவே உள்ளன.

கடந்த இரண்டு ஆண்டுகளாக உணவு மற்றும் எரிபொருள் விலைகள் சம்பளங்களை விட வேகமாக உயர்ந்ததால் குடும்பச் செலவுகள் சிரமப்பட்டன. தற்போது பணவீக்கம் மெதுவாகி இருப்பினும், உயர் வட்டியாளர்களால் வீட்டு கடனும், கடனும் செலவுகள் அதிகரித்து நுகர்வோருக்கு கூடுதல் அழுத்தம் ஏற்படுகிறது.

பணவீக்கத்திற்குப் பிறகு (போனஸ்கள் இல்லாமல்) வழக்கமான சம்பள உயர்வு செப்டம்பர் மாதம் முடிவடைந்த மூன்று மாதங்களில் 1% ஆக உயர்ந்துள்ளது — இது 2021-ஆம் ஆண்டின் அதே காலத்துக்குப் பிறகு மிகப்பெரிய உயர்வாகும். செப்டம்பரில் வழக்கமான வார சம்பளம் £621, முழுமையான சம்பளத்துக்கு (போனஸ்கள் உட்பட) £673 ஆக இருந்தது.

சம்பள உயர்வும் பணவீக்கத்திற்கும் இடையே வித்தியாசம் அதிகரிப்பது பெரும்பாலும் விலை உயர்வுகள் மெதுவடைதலால் நிகழ்ந்தது, முக்கியமான சம்பள உயர்வுகளால் அல்ல. கட்டுமானம் மற்றும் உற்பத்தி போன்ற துறைகளில் சம்பள வளர்ச்சி குறைந்து வருகிறது, வருங்கால விலை உயர்ச்சி எதிர்பார்ப்புகள் குறையவே வேலை சந்தை மெதுவாய் சுருக்கமடைகிறது. செப்டம்பரில் சராசரி சம்பள உயர்வு கடந்த ஆறு மாதங்களில் மிகக் குறைவாக இருந்தது, தனியார் துறையில் இந்த உயர்வு ஜனவரிக்குப் பிறகு முதன்முறையாக குறைந்துள்ளது.

Bank of England, உயர் வட்டி விகிதங்கள் அடுத்த ஆண்டில் பணியமர்த்தல் திட்டங்களை பாதிக்கக்கூடும்; வேலைஇழப்பு விகிதம் 5% ஆக அதிகரிக்க வாய்ப்பு உள்ளது எனக் குறித்து, இது 1,50,000க்கும் அதிகமான வேலை இழப்பையும், சம்பள வளர்ச்சி மேலும் குறைவதையும் உண்டாக்கும். PwC UK இல் பொருளியலாளர் ஜேக் ஃபினி “வேலை சந்தை மெதுவாக குளிர்ச்சியடைகிறது, முற்றிலும் சரியில்லை” எனக் கூறுகிறார். அடுத்த டிசம்பர் கூட்டத்தில் வட்டி விகிதங்களை மாறாமல் வைத்திருக்க வங்கி தயாராகும் என்றும், வேலை சந்தை மற்றும் பொருளாதாரத்தில் அதிக வட்டியின் தாக்கத்தைப் பார்க்கும் என்றும் பெரும்பான்மையான நிதிச் சந்தைகள் 5.25%ஐ விட அதிகம் வட்டி விகிதம் உயரும் என்ற எதிர்பார்ப்பு இல்லை என்றும், சில மதிப்பீட்டாளர்கள் அடுத்த ஆண்டு வட்டி விகிதம் குறைக்கப்படலாம் என நம்புகின்றனர்.

அடுத்த வாரம் நடைபெறவுள்ள இறுதிக்கால அறிக்கையில் தேசிய வாழ்வாதார ஊதியம் அதிகரிவது குறித்த அறிவிப்பை நிதியமைச்சர் ஜெரிமி ஹன்ட் வெளியிடவுள்ளார். பிரதான விகிதத்துக்கான சம்பளம் குறைந்தபட்சம் ஒரு மணி நேரத்திற்கு £11 ஆக உயரும் என்றும், இது ஆண்டு முழுவதும் முழுபண நேர ஊழியருக்கு சுமார் £1,000 கூடுதல் வருமானமாகும் என்றும் அவர் வாக்களித்துள்ளார். இந்த சம்பளம் பெறும் 20 இலட்சம் ஊழியர்களுக்குப் பெரும் நன்மை என்றாலும், சில தொழில்முனைவோர்கள் செலவில் அதிகப்படியான அழுத்தம் ஏற்படும் எனக் கவலைப்படுகிறார்கள்.

கெண்டில் உள்ள The Dog at Wingham என்ற உணவகம் மற்றும் ஹோட்டல் உரிமையாளர் மார்க் பிரிட்ஜன் சம்பள உயர்வுக்கு ஆதரவாக இருப்பதாகவும், ஆனால் அதை ஏற்க என விலை உயர்த்த வேண்டியிருக்கும் என்று கூறுகிறார். “நாங்கள் கடந்த கால காலங்களில் அதிக செலவை ஏற்றுக்கொண்டிருக்கிறோம் மற்றும் சமீபத்தில் விலையைக் கூட்டிவிட்டோம். ஏப்ரலில் சம்பளங்கள் 10% அதிகரித்தால், வாரத்திற்கு £1,000 கூடுதல் செலவு, அது அதிகமான உணவு மற்றும் பானங்களை விற்றுத்தான் ஈடுசெய்யலாம்” என்றார்.

சமீபத்திய பணியிடம் நிலவரங்களுக்கு பதிலளித்தும், நிதியமைச்சர் ஹன்ட், "பணவீக்கம் குறைந்து, உண்மையான சம்பள உயர்வு அதிகரிப்பது மக்களது மனையில் அதிகப் பணம் இருக்கச் செய்கிறது என்பது உற்சாகமானது. இறுதிக்கால அறிக்கையின் மூலம் வேலை வாய்ப்புகளுக்கு ஆட்சேர்வு மற்றும் UK வளர்ச்சி பற்றிய திட்டங்களை விரிவாக விளக்குவேன்" என்று கூறினார்.

இதே நேரத்தில், லேபர் கட்சியின் நிழல் வேலை மற்றும் பென்சன் செயலாளர் லிஸ் கேன்டல், "இந்த நாடுகளின் வேலைவாய்ப்பு விகிதம் தொற்று முன் நிலைக்கு முடியவில்லை என்பது முரண்பாடாகும்; மற்ற G7 நாடுகள் இந்த நிலையை மீட்டுள்ளன, நீண்டகால உடல் சிக்கலால் அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலானோர் வேலை வாய்ப்புக்கு வெளியே உள்ளனர்” என விமர்சித்தார்.

article_content: The Indian government has initiated steps to establish the 16th Finance Commission, which will evaluate the financial status of both states and the Centre to determine how tax revenue should be shared. Although the Finance Commission is constituted every five years and is anticipated to be announced after the upcoming assembly elections, the government on Monday appointed Ritvik Ranjanam Pandey, an IAS officer from the Karnataka cadre, as Officer on Special Duty for the 'advance cell' of the 16th Finance Commission. Pandey, an experienced official in the finance ministry currently serving as joint secretary in the revenue department, has been elevated to the rank of additional secretary for his new role. The Union Cabinet must approve the creation of the Finance Commission and will define its terms of reference. Afterward, the President will appoint the commission's chairman and members, who will work with a dedicated secretariat until the report is submitted. The recommendations of the 16th Finance Commission will come into effect starting April 2026. For reference, the government constituted the 15th Finance Commission on November 27, 2017, and tasked it to submit its report by October 2019.

article_content:
Disneyland has unveiled its new reimagined Adventure Treehouse, drawing inspiration from Walt Disney’s classic Swiss Family Robinson. The new attraction will open on November 10 at Disneyland Park and pays homage to the original treehouse that Walt Disney and his team constructed in 1962. Previously, the treehouse was themed after the 1999 animated film Tarzan.

In this latest version, visitors can experience a variety of themed rooms designed for the Robinson family of five: a water wheel powered by 'magical waters', a cozy dining area, a wood-carving station, an astronomy loft, a nature room, and the father’s art studio. According to Disney officials, the video preview highlights the mother’s music den, the sons’ nature room, and the daughter’s astronomy loft among the tree’s vast branches. It also introduces guests to the ground-level kitchen and dining room, as well as the father’s art studio.

There are no height restrictions for this attraction. The original Swiss Family Robinson movie, released in 1960, depicted a family shipwrecked on a deserted island and starred John Mills, James MacArthur, and Dorothy McGuire.

article_content: A year ago, Kate Upton was simply a young woman—attractive, though perhaps not in the conventional 'model-pretty' sense, as the New York Times observed. In the past, achieving fame would have required not just good looks but extraordinary luck, since fame was dictated by unpredictable media eager to promote their films or magazines. Today, the Internet has changed the game. All it took was a YouTube video of Upton dancing 'the Dougie' at a Los Angeles Clippers game to catapult her to fame. That video went viral, leading to Upton's appearance on the cover of the Sports Illustrated swimsuit issue. Fame isn’t what it used to be. It was once controlled by media owners, not by the celebrities themselves or the public. Fame made people seem special, as if normal rules didn't apply to them. Now, the Internet has turned that notion upside down—you no longer need the blessing of mass media to become famous. Paraphrasing Andy Warhol, 'on the Internet, everyone will be famous to 15 people.' The biggest change is that the public now decides who becomes famous. In the past, media outlets could manufacture fame for virtually anyone, regardless of talent. Today, through sharing links and content online, we—the audience—create fame ourselves. If you discover a video of a fan-made Harry Potter parody musical and are impressed by Joe Moses playing Snape, you may share it on social media. If your friends enjoy it, they spread it further. Soon, videos like this can garner millions of views, and people like Moses (a bartender from Brooklyn) can find themselves Internet-famous with tens of thousands of followers. This shift is possible because the basic idea of 'media' has transformed. Where media once acted as a one-way channel from publisher to audience, the Web makes the audience both the messenger and the medium. When someone becomes famous online, it's because the audience collectively chose to amplify their message. This has resulted in two curious trends. First, people sometimes achieve fame online for inexplicable reasons. For example, in 1999, Turkish photographer Mahir Cagri’s quirky personal homepage became an early viral sensation, partly due to its enthusiastic tone and idiosyncratic English. Some people shared the link to mock him, but others reveled in the idea that anyone could become famous overnight, beyond the reach of traditional media. Second, this democratization has deglamorized fame. Internet celebrities often seem ordinary—they make mistakes and interact directly with their audience. Take comedian Louis CK, who sold his standup show directly online, bypassing traditional marketing, and quickly earned $1 million. He is embraced by fans not despite his flaws, but because those flaws make him relatable. Conversely, celebrities who expect unearned reverence online can face backlash, as was the case with Woody Harrelson. Now, our culture is a hybrid—traditional media and Internet fame coexist. Online celebrities sometimes move to the mainstream, and mainstream stars leverage online platforms, as with Justin Bieber and Rebecca Black. In summary, fame is now shaped by the audience. It's more accessible, less glamorous—and more reflective of us all. The opinions expressed are solely those of David Weinberger.

article_content: Sue Ann Arnall, the ex-wife of Oklahoma oil magnate Harold Hamm, has appealed a court ruling that awarded her nearly $1 billion in their divorce settlement—one of the largest in U.S. history. Arnall argues the amount is 'inappropriate' and 'unfair,' citing 78 alleged errors made by the judge, which she believes led to a significant undervaluation of her stake in Continental Resources, the energy company founded by Hamm in 1967. At the time, Hamm’s net worth was estimated at $9 billion. The couple, who married in 1988 without a prenuptial agreement, are disputing how much of Continental’s growth during their marriage should be considered marital property. Arnall, who held executive roles at Continental Resources, contends that the judge underestimated both her personal contributions to the company and her share of the marital wealth. The court’s ruling awarded her several properties, including homes in Enid, Oklahoma; Nichols Hill, Oklahoma; and the Oak Ridge Ranch in Carmel, California, while Hamm retained other assets such as a Branson, Missouri home and land in Major County, Oklahoma. Central to the dispute is how much of the company’s $14 billion increase in value during the marriage should be split. Under Oklahoma law, only the 'active' portion of wealth accrued during marriage in pre-existing assets is subject to division, but Arnall’s attorneys argue that the judge wrongly attributed only 6 percent of that growth to marital efforts. Arnall believes this percentage is far too low, and hopes for a more equitable resolution through her appeal. This divorce follows only Jocelyn Wildenstein’s $2.5 billion settlement in being the largest in U.S. history. Hamm’s wealth, previously reaching $20 billion, fell to $9 billion amid declining oil prices. Beyond the legal battle, the article notes Hamm’s background rising from humble beginnings to billionaire oilman and his involvement in national politics, including advising Mitt Romney’s 2012 presidential campaign. Arnall, who filed for divorce in 2013 citing infidelity, maintains that the division of assets was unfairly calculated and is seeking a more just outcome.

Bose is celebrated for its premium headphones, especially those featuring cutting-edge noise cancellation, like the QuietComfort series. If you recently acquired Bose headphones or earbuds and want to connect them to your iPhone, here’s a straightforward guide covering both wireless and wired setups.

To pair Bose wireless headphones or earbuds using Bluetooth on your iPhone:
1. Turn on your Bose headphones and enter pairing mode. For most over-ear models, toggle the right earcup switch from red to green or hold down the power button until you hear 'ready to pair.'
2. For earbuds such as QuietComfort, Sports, Sports Open, or Soundsport, pairing mode typically starts when you open the case. Some may require pressing and holding a button until an indicator blinks or an audio cue plays.
3. On your iPhone, go to Settings > Bluetooth. Locate your Bose device under 'Other Devices' and tap it to connect. When it displays as 'Connected,' you’re set.

Bose also offers two apps for enhanced control: Bose Music for newer models and Bose Connect for some older models. These apps help with pairing, customization, and firmware updates.

Using the Bose Music app:
1. Put your headphones in pairing mode.
2. Open the Bose Music app, select 'Set Up New Product,' then pick your device.
3. The app will detect your headphones; follow on-screen steps to finish setup.

Using the Bose Connect app:
1. Enable pairing mode on your headphones and Bluetooth on your iPhone.
2. Open the Bose Connect app; it will find supported devices. Drag down the arrows that appear on the app to connect, then tap 'Ready to Play.'

For wired Bose headphones, Apple dropped the 3.5mm jack starting with iPhone 7. Use a Lightning-to-3.5mm adapter for those models, or, for iPhone 15 and newer with USB-C, a USB-C-to-3.5mm adapter. This ensures your wired headphones stay compatible with any iPhone.

Six years ago, producer Ivana Mikovic noticed a significant shortage of studio space in Serbia's rapidly expanding film and television industry. This realization came a year after the Serbian government introduced a 25-30% cash rebate to attract productions. Recognizing an opportunity, Mikovic—formerly with the BBC—pursued the idea to fill this gap. At that time, the Belgrade area had only a few stages, such as PFI Studios and Take 1, both frequently booked to capacity.

Initially, Mikovic and her production designer friend joked about opening a new studio. But Mikovic took the idea seriously, securing bank support to turn Firefly Studios from a dream into reality. Firefly Productions, led by Mikovic, is behind notable Serbian series like 'The Fall' and 'Black Wedding,' both of which were included in Berlin’s Berlinale Series Market Selects.

In October, Firefly Studios officially launched in Pancevo, just 11 miles east of Belgrade and a 25-minute drive from the capital's airport. The modern complex features three advanced sound stages (two at 21,500 square feet and one at 8,600 square feet), a 1,614-square-foot indoor water tank 11 feet deep, 10 acres of backlot for production offices and workshops, as well as a restaurant and horse stables.

Mikovic stresses that this facility fills a growing need in the Balkan region, making Serbia more attractive for both domestic and foreign productions. She points out the country’s competitive rebate, reliable crews, and cost advantages over other European locations like Hungary and the Czech Republic. Firefly Studios also offers comprehensive production services, such as production management, accounting, location scouting, permitting, and world-class construction support, leveraging Serbia’s tradition of skilled craftsmen across several trades.

Thanks to word-of-mouth, Firefly Studios has enjoyed steady bookings and has received international interest for projects across 2024. As of now, it is nearly fully reserved until May next year. Mikovic is especially proud of the indoor water tank, a rare feature in the European studio market, and notes plans for a larger outdoor tank as the facility expands.

For now, Firefly Studios is focused on attracting the right mix of single and long-term projects, aiming to help make Serbia a premier destination for film and television production.

article_content: Charles Rowan, a cage fighter from Michigan, faked his own death to evade an $80,000 debt owed to his drug dealer. While everyone believed he had perished in a car accident, Rowan was actually alive—he was recently sentenced to 17 and a half to 40 years in prison after pleading guilty to robbing a local gun store with a hammer. His girlfriend, Rosa Martinez, contributed to the deception by informing his mother and a fight promoter that he’d died, prompting friends, family, and fans to organize memorials and raise money online. Behind the scenes, Rowan was hiding during these memorial events, listening as his loved ones mourned him. The truth emerged weeks later when police identified him in a mugshot after the armed robbery at 'Guns and Stuff', a Michigan gun shop, where he injured 75-year-old owner Richard Robinette. Martinez and Micheal Bowman, a friend, helped in the crime—Bowman is also awaiting sentencing. After the robbery, Martinez called 911 while Rowan fled; this call helped alert authorities. Rowan’s drastic actions were prompted by pressure from his drug dealer, Micheal Gomez. After losing a cocaine shipment and being unable to pay his debt, Rowan claimed he was mugged and injured. Gomez, unconvinced, allegedly had Rowan beaten and threatened harm to Martinez and her children. Out of fear and desperation, Rowan committed the gun store robbery. Rowan’s criminal record started in his youth, including convictions for theft, drug offenses, failing to pay child support, and sexual misconduct. He experienced a violent upbringing, reportedly suffering abuse at the hands of his father. Within the cage fighting community, Rowan was seen as determined but not especially skilled—he was known for fighting without pay and was considered easy to defeat. Expressing regret for his choices, Rowan has said from jail that he and his accomplices deserve punishment and hopes that, in the future, he can prove he has changed, especially to Mr. Robinette and his family.

தனது உறவினர்கள் துயரத்தில் வாடுவதை கேட்டு இருந்தார். சில வாரங்கள் கழித்து, அவர் ‘கன்ஸ் ஆண்ட் ஸ்டஃப்’ என்ற மிசிகன் துப்பாக்கி கடையில் 75 வயது உரிமையாளர் ரிச்சர்ட் ரொபினெட்டைப் புண்படுத்தி கொள்ளையடித்த சம்பவத்தில் அவரது முகபடம் வெளிவந்தது; இதனூடாக உண்மை தெரியவந்தது. மார்டினஸும், நண்பர் மைக்கேல் போமனும் இந்தக் குற்றத்துக்கு துணையாக இருந்தனர்; போமனுக்கு விரைவில் தண்டனை வர இருக்கிறது. கொள்ளைக்கு பிறகு, மார்டின்ஸ் 911-க்கு அழைத்ததால் போலீசாருக்கு தகவல் சென்றது. ரோவனுக்கு இவ்வளவு கடுமையான முடிவுகள் கொள்ள காரணம், அவரிடம் கடன் இருந்த போதைப்பொருள் வியாபாரி மைக்கேல் கோமேசின் அழுத்தம் தான். ரோவன் தயாரிப்பை இழந்ததால் கடனை செலுத்த முடியவில்லை; கொள்ளை அடித்து காயமடைந்ததாக அவரிடம் கூறினார். ஆனால் கோமேஸ் நம்பவில்லை; அவர் ரோவனை தாக்கவழுவித்தார் மற்றும் மார்டின்ஸும் குழந்தைகளும் பாதிக்கப்படுவார்கள் என மிரட்டிக்கொண்டார் என கூறப்படுகிறது. பயம் மற்றும் நெருக்கடி காரணமாக, ரோவன் அந்த துப்பாக்கிக் கடையை கொள்ளை அடித்தார். ரோவன் குறும்பு பொழுதுகள் முதல் குற்றங்களில் ஈடுபட்டார்—திருட்டு, போதைப்பொருள் கடத்தல், குழந்தை பாதுகாப்புக்கான தொகை செலுத்தாதது, பாலியல் தவறுகள் ஆகிய குற்றங்களும் உள்ளன. அவரது தந்தையால் அதிக வன்முறை அனுபவித்ததாகவும் குறிப்பிடப்படுகிறது. சண்டை உலகில், ரோவன் உறுதியுடனும் மற்றும் சம்பளமில்லாமல் சண்டையிட்டாலும் அதிக திறமை உடையவர் அல்ல என்று அறியப்பட்டார். தனது தவறுகளுக்கு வருத்தப்படுவதாக ரோவன் சிறையிலிருந்து தெரிவித்தார்; தன்னை மற்றும் தனது துணைவர்களை தண்டிக்க வேண்டும் என்று, மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தில் திருடன் ரொபினெட் மற்றும் அவரது குடும்பத்துக்கு தன்னை மாற்றிக் காட்ட வேண்டும் என்று நம்புகிறார்.

article_content: When Jeffrey Lais, operations director at a San Francisco law firm, needed a break, he booked a first-class ticket to Munich on Lufthansa. On board the airline's A346, he was welcomed into his spacious first-class suite, featuring a leather seat and ottoman stretching across four windows. The suite was filled with amenities such as noise-canceling headphones, menus, pajamas, and slippers. After enjoying a meal of caviar, prawn confit, duck breast, and French cheeses, a flight attendant converted Lais's seat into a flatbed with a mattress, duvet, and large pillows. He was shown how to close a privacy screen, allowing him seclusion for the 12-hour flight. First class clearly improves the travel experience. While airlines often reduce economy-class services, first class remains protected, as the International Air Transport Association notes that premium passengers—although a minority—generate about a third of airline revenue. Cabin upgrades for premium travelers represent the fastest-growing segment in the airline maintenance, repair, and overhaul sector. Nigel Page, Emirates' vice president of commercial operations, says: 'To stay competitive, airlines must keep up with corporate travelers' changing demands. That's why we continually invest in refining our first-class product.' Emirates is the only airline to offer in-flight showers for first-class travelers on its A380s. Similarly, other airlines provide unique perks: Swiss introduced first-class suites with executive desks that convert into dining tables for two; Lufthansa added cabin humidifiers and updated their 747 suites to include both a flatbed and an armchair. Top-level amenities aren't just onboard. For example, Lais appreciated Lufthansa's personalized airport escort service. According to him, 'It's the level of attention on the ground that truly sets first-class apart.' Singapore Airlines offers suites on its A380s designed by Jean-Jacques Coste—these feature beds, large entertainment screens, and deluxe materials. Center suites can combine to form a double bed, perfect for couples. Swiss's first-class cabin has adjustable partitions, wood paneling, and seating for dining with a guest, while Lufthansa's A380 suites include humidifiers for increased comfort. Emirates' A380s provide Shower Spas, private suites with sliding doors, personal mini-bars, ambient lighting, vanity tables, and leather seats that turn into beds with massage features. Etihad Airways' Diamond first-class suites offer private screens, large entertainment systems, and leather seats that convert into 80-inch flatbeds. Amenities include luxury toiletries by brands like Swarovski and La Prairie. Japan Airlines features JAL Suites with ergonomic leather seats, adjustable trays, and Tempur-designed mattresses for comfort. Passengers also receive signature Symphony pillows. Cathay Pacific provides private pods with enhanced privacy, luxe beds, premium amenity kits, and expansive layouts for restful journeys. ANA's Suite Squares, found on routes like New York to Tokyo, are high-tech cubicles that include bamboo fiber lap rugs, touch-screen TVs, and in-flight electronic bidet toilets. Jet Airways' first-class suites include sliding doors, personal wardrobes, massage-enabled chairs, and 83-inch beds. Entertainment ranges from books and movies to foreign language courses. Korean Air has invested heavily in its Kosmo Suites, now offering private compartments with leather interiors, individualized storage, and upgraded entertainment systems. Across top airlines, first class is defined by privacy, advanced comforts, and attentive service—creating a superior journey from start to finish.

இது 12 மணி நேர பறப்புக்குள் அதிக தனிமை ஏற்படுத்தியது. முதல் வகுப்பு பயண அனுபவத்தை மேலாளிக்கிறது என்பது தெளிவாக உள்ளது. ஏர்லைன்கள் பொதுவாக பொருளாதார வகுப்பில் சேவைகளை குறைக்கும் போதும், முதல்தர பயணிகள்—எண்ணிக்கையில் குறைவாக இருந்தாலும்—ஏர்லைன் வருவாயில் ஒரு பெரிய பங்கு வகிக்கிறார்கள் என்று சர்வதேச விமான போக்குவரத்து சங்கம் கூறுகிறது. பிரீமியம் பயணிகளுக்கான கேபின் மேம்பாடுகள் விமான பராமரிப்பு, பழுது மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்பு துறையில் மிக வேகமாக வளர்கிறது. எமிரேட்ஸின் வர்த்தக இயக்கத் தலைவர் நைஜல் பேஜ்: 'போட்டியில் நீடிக்க, நிறுவன பயணிகளின் விரைவான தேவைகளை பூர்த்தி செய்ய வேண்டும். அதனால்தான் முதல் வகுப்பு தயாரிப்பை தொடர்ந்தும் மேம்படுத்துகிறோம்.' என்கிறார். ஏதாவது விமானங்களில், எமிரேட்ஸ் தற்போதைய A380 விமானங்களில் முதல்தர பயணிகளுக்கு விமானத்தில் ஷவர் வசதி வழங்கும் ஒரே நிறுவனம். ஸ்விஸ் முதல்தர ஸ்வீட்டுகள் நிர்வாக மேசையை இரவு உணவு மேசையாக மாற்றும் வசதியும் கொண்டுள்ளது; லுஃப்தான்சா 747 விமானங்கள் பிளாட்பெட் மற்றும் அரம் நாற்காலி சேர்த்து மேம்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது. சிறப்பு வசதிகள் விமானத்திற்கு வெளியும் நன்கு வழங்கப்படுகின்றன. எடுத்துக்காட்டாக, லைஸ் லுஃப்தான்சாவின் தனிப்பட்ட விமான நிலைய எஸ்கார்டை பாராட்டுகிறார். அவர் சொல்வது: 'முதல்தரம் தரும் அதிகமான கவனம், நிலத்தில் அதிக வித்தியாசம் ஏற்படுத்துகிறது.' சிங்கப்பூர் ஏர்லைன்ஸ் A380-களில், பிரபல யாக்ட் வடிவமைப்பாளர் ஜீன்ஜாக் கோஸ்தே வடிவமைத்த ஸ்வீட்கள் உள்ளன. இவை விசாலமான படுக்கைகளை, பெரிய உல்லாச திரைகள் மற்றும் உயர் தரப் பொருட்களுக்கு அடையாளம். மைய ஸ்வீட்டுகள் இரட்டையராக இணைக்கலாம். ஸ்விஸ் முதல்தர கேபினில் அட்ஜஸ்டபிள் பார்டிஷன்கள், மரப்பலகையாகும் அலங்காரம் மற்றும் இருவருக்காக இரவு உணவு அமர்ச்சி இடம் தருகின்றன. லுஃப்தான்சா A380 ஸ்வீட்டுகளில் அதிக வசதிக்காக ஹியூமிடிஃபையர்கள் உள்ளன. எமிரேட்ஸ் A380-களில் ஷவர் ஸ்பாக்கள், உருட்டும் கதவுள்ள தனிப்பட்ட ஸ்வீட்டுகள், தனிநபர் மினிபார், அரங்க ஒளிவைத்தல், டிரெசிங் மேசை மற்றும் மசாஜ் வசதி கொண்ட தோராய்ந்த நாற்காலிகள் உள்ளன. எதிஹாத் ஏர்வேஸ் டைமண்ட் ஸ்வீட்டுகளில் சொந்த திரைகள், பெரிய பொழுதுபோக்கு திரைகள் மற்றும் தோராய்ந்த நாற்காலிகள், 80 அங்குல பிளாட்பெட்களாக மாறும் வசதியும், உயர் தர துணைகள் கொடுத்து வழங்கப்படுகிறது. ஜப்பான் ஏர்லைன்ஸ் JAL ஸ்வீட்டுகள், எர்கோனாமிக் தோராய்ந்த நாற்காலிகள், அட்ஜஸ்டபிள் டிரே மற்றும் Tempur மெத்தைகள் கொண்டவை. பயணிகள் சிம்ஃபனி தலையணைகளையும் பெறுகிறார்கள். கதாய் பசிபிக் பிரைவேட் பாக்கள், பெரும் படுக்கைகள், பிரீமியம் சாமான்கள் மற்றும் நேரத்தைக்கடும் அமைப்புடன் வசதியான பயணத்தை வழங்குகின்றன. article_content: A hacker reportedly accessed a 2-year-old girl's baby monitor in suburban Houston, Texas, using it to insult and harass her parents. The incident happened when Marc and Lauren Gilbert heard an unfamiliar voice through the monitor in their children's bedroom. Marc Gilbert explained that the voice came from the web camera used to monitor their children, and it included profanities while addressing their daughter Allyson by name. The hacker, described as having a European accent, might have read Allyson's name from decorations on the wall. When the parents entered the room, the camera turned to face them and the intruder continued to insult them until the camera was unplugged. Fortunately, Allyson, who is deaf and uses cochlear implants, did not hear the incident as she was not wearing her implants while asleep. Marc Gilbert likened the experience to someone breaking into their home and emphasized his responsibility as a parent to protect his children. Security specialists highlight that baby monitors with video and Wi-Fi capabilities are vulnerable to hacking. Previous incidents, like a 2009 case in Illinois, have shown that unsecured monitors can allow others to access private feeds. Experts advise always changing default passwords, enabling firewalls, and securing home Wi-Fi with strong passwords. Technology analysts note that the Foscam FI9821P camera used in this case comes with default login credentials ('admin' for both username and password) which should be changed immediately. Using complex passwords and changing the default port can enhance device security. Earlier this year, security researchers from Qualys showed how similar cameras could be exploited if not correctly secured. Marc Gilbert mentioned that their router and camera were password protected and the firewall was enabled. However, experts stress that default passwords provide little protection and should be replaced. Foscam did not provide a response to requests for comment on the situation.

article_content: Baroness Margaret Thatcher, the 87-year-old former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, passed away peacefully while sitting up in bed and reading at the Ritz Hotel in London. On Monday at 11:28am, she suffered a stroke in her suite at the five-star hotel, where she had been residing since Christmas following minor surgery on her bladder. Her twins, Mark and Carol, were both overseas at the time of her passing. Nearly 13 hours after her death, at 12:20am the following day, Thatcher's body was removed from the hotel by private ambulance. The removal was accompanied by significant security measures, including police officers, diplomatic protection officers on motorbikes, and a police helicopter monitoring the scene. After her surgery, Baroness Thatcher opted not to return home due to her unsteady health, choosing instead to stay at the Ritz, one of her favorite establishments, at the invitation of the Barclay brothers. She was cared for by two rotating carers and visited by a close circle of friends. A ceremonial funeral with full military honors is planned for next Wednesday at St Paul’s Cathedral in central London. Queen Elizabeth II and the Duke of Edinburgh are set to attend, marking the first time the monarch will personally attend a political leader’s funeral since Winston Churchill’s in 1965. Preparations for the event are underway, with MPs and members of the House of Lords recalled early from recess to pay tribute. Prime Minister David Cameron and Labour leader Ed Miliband are expected to speak, and backbench MPs will also have an opportunity to share their tributes. Despite ongoing debates about whether she should receive a state funeral, it has emerged that Baroness Thatcher specifically declined this honor, requesting instead that her body not lie in state and forgoing ceremonial elements like a fly-past. Instead, a procession will travel from Westminster to St Paul’s, with dignitaries from across the globe expected to attend the televised service. While tributes poured in to recognize Thatcher as Britain’s first and only woman Prime Minister, her legacy remained divisive. Some individuals in Glasgow and London held gatherings to mark her death, highlighting controversy over the social impacts of her policies. Meanwhile, the government is anticipated to introduce a formal motion in Parliament to honor her memory.

போலீசார், டிப்ளோமாடிக் பாதுகாப்பு அதிகாரிகள், மோட்டார் சைக்கிள் பாதுகாப்பு அதிகாரிகள், மற்றும் ஒரு போலீஸ் ஹெலிகாப்டர் ஆகியவை நேரில் இருந்தன. அறுவைச்சிகிச்சைக்கு பிறகு உடல் நிலை பாதிப்பால் வீட்டிற்கு செல்ல முடியாமல், பரோனஸ் தாசர் தனது விருப்பப்பட்ட இடமான ரிட்ஸ் ஹோட்டலில் Barclay சகோதரர்களின் அழைப்பில் தொடர்ந்தார். இரண்டு பராமரிப்பாளர்கள் பரஸ்பரம் மரியாதையுடன் கவனித்தனர்; article_content: Bob Wareham, a 54-year-old businessman from Weston-super-Mare, Somerset, underwent partial amputation of his right leg after a severe diabetic foot infection was misdiagnosed as athlete's foot. This initial error caused delays in receiving specialist care for over a week, ultimately leading to the loss of approximately six inches of his leg below the knee. Wareham’s ordeal began in August 2008, when he sought treatment for a foot infection. An out-of-hours GP at Weston General Hospital prescribed antibiotics for athlete's foot. Two days later, after his symptoms worsened, Wareham went to A&E, where it was discovered he had a serious diabetic foot infection. However, he was still not admitted or urgently referred to a specialist team, despite guidance from the National Institute for Clinical Excellence (NICE) stressing prompt action for diabetic foot infections. Three days later, he was admitted to the hospital but had to wait another three days before being seen by a multi-disciplinary specialist team. By then, it was too late to save his lower leg, and the amputation was carried out at Bristol Royal Infirmary. Wareham lost his businesses as a result of his hospitalization and now requires ongoing care. Following a three-and-a-half-year legal battle, he received a £750,000 settlement after reaching an out-of-court agreement in June 2012. Wareham said, 'I am faced with an amputation for the rest of my life through no fault of my own. The payout covers both my lost businesses and my future care.' He added, 'With diabetic infections, time is crucial. Although it’s too late for me, I hope changes are made so others won’t go through what I did.' Solicitor Justin Goodman, who represented Wareham, stated, 'Mr. Wareham was awarded significant compensation due to clinical negligence by the out-of-hours GP and the A&E department at Weston General Hospital. Each time Mr. Wareham visited, he should have been referred to a surgeon experienced in diabetic foot infections. If this had happened, he would not have lost his leg.' Weston General Hospital and the NHS Litigation Authority declined to comment on the settlement.

article_content: Australian model Miranda Kerr has often spoken about her close relationship with her family, especially her 77-year-old grandmother, Ann. Last year, the 30-year-old revealed that her glamorous grandmother had given her advice on relationships, like wearing makeup every day and choosing attractive underwear. In a recent interview with the new fashion magazine Clique, Miranda named her grandmother as one of her greatest style inspirations. As Clique's first cover star, she shared some of her wardrobe secrets and explained that her love of dressing up began in childhood. She said, 'My grandma has great style and really influenced me. The one thing that stayed with me was that fashion doesn’t need to be expensive or complicated – just worn with grace and confidence.' Last year, Miranda posed with her grandmother and mother for Australia’s Women's Weekly magazine, saying, 'Mum and Nan are two of the strongest women I know and are a great source of strength in my life.' Now also a mother, Miranda admits her two-year-old son Flynn is the love of her life. She told Clique, 'My son is the best thing that ever happened to me. My favourite times are when we sit and laugh together. Flynn has the most infectious laugh.' She added, 'Since becoming a mother, I’ve re-evaluated my priorities and managed my work more efficiently so my son is now my priority. When I get home after work, or have a day off, I make a concerted effort to switch off and be present with him.' Although she remains a regular on best-dressed lists, Miranda says that having a child has impacted her fashion choices. 'My style has definitely become a bit more relaxed,' she said. 'Two-year-olds keep you very busy, so my collection of flat shoes is definitely growing.' Miranda’s good looks seem to run in the family, as she posed with her mother Therese and grandmother Ann for the Australian Women's Weekly feature. Clique is described as the world’s first shoppable fashion and beauty magazine, mixing a traditional glossy appearance with technology that lets readers buy, share, and bookmark items via a smartphone app. Led by industry expert Jill Wanless, Clique will be free to a select group of women, giving access to behind-the-scenes videos, bonus content, and the editorial team as part of the first fully interactive magazine. Recently, Miranda was photographed holding hands with her son Flynn as they traveled through LAX and arrived in New York at JFK Airport.
translated_content: ஆஸ்திரேலிய மாடல் மிரண்டா கேர் தனது குடும்பத்துடன், குறிப்பாக தனது 77 வயது பாட்டி ஆனுடன் நெருக்கமாக இருப்பதாகக் கூறியுள்ளார். கடந்த ஆண்டு, 30 வயது மிரண்டா, தன் அழகான பாட்டி தினமும் மெக்கப் போடு, அழகான உடைகளை அணிதல் போன்ற ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கியதாக தெரிவித்தார். புதிய ஃபேஷன் இதழான கிளிக்-இல் சமீபத்திய நேர்காணலில், மிரண்டா தனது பாட்டியை மிகப்பெரிய ஸ்டைல் ஆதரவாளராக குறிப்பிடினார். கிளிக்கின் முதல் முகப்பு நட்சத்திரமாக அவர் தன் அலமாரி ரகசியங்களை பகிர்ந்தார். 'என் பாட்டிக்கு நல்ல ஸ்டைல் உள்ளது, அது எனக்கு பெரிய செல்வாக்கு விட்டது. ஃபேஷன் விலையிருப்பதோ, சிக்கலாக இருப்பதோ தேவையில்லை – நம்பிக்கையுடன் கம்பீரமாக அணிவதுதான் முக்கியம்,' என அவர் கூறினார். கடந்த ஆண்டு, ஆஸ்திரேலியா வீமன்ஸ் வீக்லி இதழுக்காக, மிரண்டா தன் பாட்டி, அம்மாவுடன் புகைப்படம் எடுத்தார். அப்போது அவர், 'அம்மா மற்றும் நான், நான் அறிந்த இரண்டு வலுவான பெண்கள்; அவர்கள் என் வாழ்வில் ஒரு பெரிய சக்தி,' என்று கூறினார். இப்போது தாய்மையாக இருக்கிற மிரண்டா, தன் இரண்டு வயது மகன் ஃப்ளின் தான் தனது வாழ்க்கையில் மிகச் சிறந்த விஷயம் என்று கூறுகிறார். 'என் மகன் எனக்கு நடந்த சிறந்த விஷயம். நாங்கள் சிரிக்கும்போது எனக்கு அதிக மகிழ்ச்சி. ஃப்ளினின் சிரிப்பு மிகவும் தொற்றுவிக்கிறது' என்றார். 'தாயாகிய பின்பு, முன்னுரிமைகளை மாற்றி, என் வேலை நேரத்தை சிறப்புற அமைத்தேன். என் மகன் என் மிக முக்கியம். வேலை முடித்துப் வீட்டிற்கு வந்ததும் அல்லது விடுமுறையில் இருந்தாலும், முழுமையாக அவனுடன் இருப்பதை முன்னிலை போடுகிறேன்,' என்று அவர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். சிறந்த உடை அணிந்தவர்களுக்கான பட்டியலில் தொடர்ந்து இருப்பாலும், பெற்றோராக இருப்பது தன் ஃபேஷனில் மாற்றங்களை கொண்டு வந்துவிட்டது என மிரண்டா சொல்லுகிறார். 'என் ஸ்டைல் இன்னும் சீராகி விட்டது. இரண்டு வயது குழந்தையுடன் மிகவும் பிஸியாக இருப்பீர்கள்; எனவே, ஃபிளாட் ஷூக்கள் அதிகரிக்கின்றன' என அவர் சொன்னார். மிரண்டாவின் அழகு குடும்பத்திலும் தெரிகிறது; அவரது தாய் தெரீஸ், பாட்டி ஆனுடன் ஆஸ்திரேலியா வீமன்ஸ் வீக்லி இதழில் புகைப்படம் எடுத்துள்ளனர். க்ளிக் உலகின் முதல் ஷாப்பபிள் ஃபேஷன் மற்றும் அழகு இதழாகும்; பாரம்பரிய ஃபேஷன் இதழுடன் தொழில்நுட்பம் சேர்த்து, வாசகர்கள் ஸ்மார்ட்போன் செயலியில் உடை, பொருட்களை வாங்க, பகிர, சேமிக்க முடியும். தொழில்துறை நிபுணர் ஜில் வாந்லெஸ் தலைமையில், கிளிக் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட பெண்களுக்கு இலவசமாக வழங்கப்படுகிறது. பின்தொகுப்பு வீடியோக்கள், கூடுதல் உள்ளடக்கம், எடிட்டோரியல் குழு ஆகியவற்றை அணுகலாம். சமீபத்தில், மிரண்டா தன் மகன் ஃப்ளினுடன் கைப்பிடித்தபடி, LAX இல் இருந்து நியூயார்க் JFK விமான நிலையம் வரை பயணித்தார் என புகைப்படம் வெளியாகியுள்ளது.

Laresce Browne, a 16-year-old from Eccles, Manchester, has become the UK's strongest schoolgirl in powerlifting—and she attributes her impressive success in part to a joint condition that once caused her severe pain. Laresce holds six British and World Champion powerlifting records. Just two years ago, she struggled with hypermobility syndrome, which left her in such pain that she could not take part in sports. Rather than allowing her diagnosis to limit her, Laresce was inspired by her father, Adam, a weightlifter, to start lifting weights herself.

Her training ended her pain and propelled her to the top of her sport. She set a UK record by deadlifting 105kg—more than twice her own bodyweight—and can also bench press her bodyweight of 50kg (7st 12lbs).

At birth, Laresce had metatarsus varus (pigeon toe), meaning her toes and knees turned inward. This condition typically corrects itself by the age of eight or nine, generally without treatment. She was also diagnosed with hypermobility, where joints have a wider range of motion and may be prone to pain or dislocations.

Remarkably, Laresce believes her hypermobility has assisted her powerlifting, as her extra flexibility gives her better leverage. Through lifting, she built strength around her joints and now reports being pain-free.

Laresce’s trainer, Tania George, credits Laresce’s flexibility and her ability to form a strong, safe arch in her back as key to her lifting success—a technique envied by other athletes.

Despite these achievements, Laresce faced significant challenges growing up. She loved Morris dancing, but from ages 11 to 14, her hypermobility caused severe daily pain, interrupted sleep, and forced absences from school. A near dislocated hip led doctors to advise her to stop sports for eight months and give up dance.

Eighteen months after starting powerlifting, Laresce feels effectively cured. She now trains eight hours a week, enjoys support from her gym community, and was amazed to win six titles so quickly.

Her friends were surprised she took up a sport usually associated with adult men, and some were a little envious of her rapid success. Both her trainer and father praise her spirit. Adam, her father, says he is very proud of her work ethic and perseverance.

Joint hypermobility means some or all joints have a wider range of motion than average. Some people with hypermobility experience no problems, while others may suffer joint pain, dislocations, and fatigue. The condition is hereditary, linked to the protein collagen, and affects about 30% of people, with women more commonly affected than men. Treatment usually includes physiotherapy and exercise to strengthen muscles. (Source: NHS Choices.)

எக்லஸ், மாஞ்செஸ்டரில் உள்ள 16 வயதே ஆன லாரெஸ் ப்ரவுன், இங்கிலாந்தின் மிகவும் சக்திவாய்ந்த பள்ளி மாணவியாக தோன்றியுள்ளார். ஒரு காலத்தில் கடும் வலியை ஏற்படுத்திய 'ஹைபர் மோபிலிட்டி' மூட்டு நிலைமை, இப்போது அவருக்கு வெற்றியின் முக்கியக் காரணமாக இருப்பதாக அவர் கூறுகிறார். லாரெஸ், ஆறு பிரிட்டிஷ் மற்றும் உலக சாம்பியன் பவர்லிப்டிங் பட்டங்களை வைத்துள்ளார். இரண்டு வருடங்களுக்கு முன்னர் வரை, இந்த ஹைபர் மோபிலிட்டி காரணமாக மிகுந்த வலியில் இருந்ததால், விளையாட்டுகளில் கலந்து கொள்ள முடியவில்லை. தந்தை ஆடம் ப்ரவுன் என்பவரிடம் இருந்து ஊக்கமடைந்து, அவர் உடற்பயிற்சி செய்து பவர்லிப்டிங் பயிற்சி மேற்கொண்டார்.

இப்போது வலி இல்லாமல், சாதனைகளில் முன்னிலையில் உள்ளார். 105 கிலோ எடையை (தனது உடல் எடைக்கு இரட்டிப்பாக) டெட்லிப்டில் உயர்த்தி UK சாதனை படைத்துள்ளார். மேலும், தனது உடல் எடையான 50 கிலோவையும் (7 ஸ்டோன் 12 பவுண்டு) பெஞ்ச் ப்ரஸ் செய்கிறார்.

பிறந்ததிலிருந்து 'மேட்டடார்சஸ் வரஸ்' (பிஜன் டோ) என்ற பாதிப்பு இருந்தது. இது பொதுவாக 8 அல்லது 9 வயதில் தானாகவே சரியாகிவிடும். இவருக்கு ஹைபர் மோபிலிட்டி எனும் நிலையில், மூட்டுக்கள் அதிகமாக நகரும் நிலையில் இருந்தது, இதனால் வலி மற்றும் சிலசமயம் இடிபாடுகள் ஏற்படும்.

லாரெஸ் இந்த ஹைபர் மோபிலிட்டி தான் அவரின் பவர்லிப்டிங் வெற்றிக்கு உதவியதாக நம்புகிறார், ஏனெனில் அதிக நெகிழ்வுடன் எடைகள் உயர்த்தும் போது பளு தாங்கும் திறன் அதிகரிக்கிறது. உடற்பயிற்சியின் மூலம் மூட்டுகளுக்கு சுற்றி உள்ள தசைகளை பலப்படுத்தி, வலி இல்லாமல் இருக்க முடிந்தது.

பயிற்சியாளர் டேனியா ஜார்ஜ், லாரெஸின் நெகிழ்வும், முதுகில் வளைவு அமைக்கும் திறனும் சிலர் கொள்ள ஆசையாய் நினைக்கும் நுணுக்கமான தொழில்நுட்பம் என பாராட்டுகிறார்.

வளர்ந்தபோது பல சிரமங்களை எதிர்கொண்டார். 11 முதல் 14 வயதுக்கு இடையில் பெரும் வலி, தூக்கம் குறைவு மற்றும் பள்ளி விடுப்பு ஆகியவற்றை அனுபவித்தார். ஹிப் அருகில் இடிபாடு ஏற்படும் நிலை வந்ததால் மருத்துவர்கள் விளையாட்டை எட்டு மாதங்கள் தவிர்க்க அறிவுறுத்தினர்; நடனத்தையும் நிறுத்தினார்.

பவர்லிப்டிங் ஆரம்பித்த 18 மாதத்திற்குப் பிறகு, லாரெஸ் வலியின்றி இருப்பதாகக் கூறுகிறார். வாரத்திற்கு 8 மணிநேரம் பயிற்சி செய்கிறார்; ஜிம் நண்பர்களின் ஆதரவு மற்றும் உற்சாகத்தை அனுபவிக்கிறார். ஒருவேளை பொழுதுபோக்காக தொடங்கியாலும் சில மாதங்களில் ஆறு பட்டங்களை வெல்வது அவருக்கே ஆச்சரியமானதாக இருந்தது.

முதலில், பொதுவாக ரகசிய ஆண்களுக்கு தொடர்புடைய விளையாட்டு என்பதால் நண்பர்கள் ஆச்சரியப்பட்டனர்; சிலர் அவளின் வெற்றிக்கு சிறிது பொறாமை கொண்டனர். பயிற்சியாளர் மற்றும் தந்தை இருவரும் அவரது உற்சாகத்தையும் கடின உழைப்பையும் பாராட்டினர். தந்தை ஆடம், மகளின் உழைப்பும் வளர்ச்சியும் பெரு பெருமை எனக் கூறினார்.

ஹைபர் மோபிலிட்டி என்பது சில அல்லது அனைத்து மூட்டுகளும் சாதாரணத்தை விட அதிக அளவில் நெகிழ்வுடையது. சிலருக்கு பிரச்சினையில்லை; மற்றவர்கள் வலி, இடிபாடுகள், சோர்வு போன்றவை அனுபவிக்கலாம். இது மரபணுக்குறிய நிலை; 'கொல்லஜன்' எனும் புரதத்துடன் தொடர்புடையது; இது பெண்களில் அதிகம் காணப்படுகிறது. சுமார் 30% மக்களுக்கு இது ஏற்படக்கூடும். சிகிச்சைகளில் உடற்பயிற்சி மற்றும் பிசியோதெரபி அடங்கும். A tragic event unfolded in Elmendorf, Texas, as Police Chief Michael Pimentel was fatally shot during a traffic stop on a Saturday morning. The suspect, 24-year-old Joshua Manuel Lopez, was pulled over by Chief Pimentel due to an outstanding graffiti warrant. During the encounter, Lopez allegedly shot Pimentel twice—once in the shoulder and once in the abdomen. The incident occurred near the intersection of East 9th Street and South 1st Avenue, shortly before noon.

Despite being airlifted to University Hospital, Chief Pimentel was pronounced dead upon arrival. Serving as the town’s police chief for just over a year, Pimentel was described by Elmendorf Mayor Evelyn Lykins as someone deeply invested in the community’s wellbeing. She mourned his loss, noting his dual role as both a law enforcement leader and resident.

Texas Department of Public Safety Director Steve McCraw remarked that Chief Pimentel is the fifth law enforcement officer in Texas to lose his life this year, with three of those deaths involving gunfire. Last year, thirteen officers died while on duty across the state. 

Lopez, the suspect, remains jailed in Bexar County with bail set at $1 million. Officials continue to investigate his background. As of this report, it is unclear if Lopez has legal representation.

article_content: Ohio voters have approved recreational marijuana use for adults, with the law set to take effect in 30 days. Despite resistance from the GOP-led state legislature, Issue 2 passed after its introduction in 2022 and subsequent legal efforts that secured its place on the ballot. By passing this measure, Ohio joins 23 other US states in legalizing non-medical cannabis. Tom Haren, of the Coalition to Regulate Marijuana Like Alcohol, commented that the wide approval shows Ohioans no longer see marijuana reform as divisive. The new policy allows residents over 21 to possess up to 2.5 ounces (about 70 grams) of cannabis and grow up to six plants at home. Purchases will be taxed at 10%, supporting addiction services, community projects, social equity, and job programs. Although cannabis remains illegal federally, many states—including Washington, DC—now permit recreational or medical use. Ohio's legalization is a statutory change, making it easier for state legislators to adjust or repeal provisions. Republican opponents plan to propose modifications, especially regarding commercial sales, advertising, and THC concentration. Kevin Sabet, leader of Smart Approaches to Marijuana Action, called on lawmakers to address these concerns and emphasized that the discussion isn't over. On the same day, Ohioans also backed a constitutional amendment establishing abortion rights protections.

article_content: A U.S. military Osprey aircraft crashed into the ocean near Yakushima Island, Japan, on Wednesday afternoon. The coast guard confirmed that eight people were aboard at the time of the incident, which occurred around 2:47 p.m. local time. Authorities have yet to provide information on the fate of those onboard, and the U.S. military in Japan has not commented so far.

article_content: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has inaugurated its largest global design center in Bengaluru, India. The state-of-the-art Technostar campus will employ around 3,000 engineers over the coming years, focusing on the design and development of AMD’s semiconductor technologies, including 3D stacking and artificial intelligence (AI). This initiative is part of AMD’s significant $400 million investment in India over the next five years, according to The Times of India. AMD’s move to India’s 'Silicon Valley' comes during a phase of rapid expansion in the country’s technology sector. The campus was inaugurated by Ashwini Vaishnaw, India’s Minister for Railways, Telecommunications, Electronics, and Information Technology. Senior AMD executives, including Chief Technology Officer Mark Papermaster, also attended the event. “We are focused on delivering high-performance designs that increase computing efficiency, helping our customers save money and reduce power usage,” Papermaster told local media. India, the world’s most populous country, is poised for strong growth owing to its large pool of young talent, the successful rollout of 5G, and supportive government policies. The abundance of skilled, English-speaking workers has propelled India to become the world’s third largest start-up ecosystem, with over 99,000 start-ups as of 31 May 2023, a number that has grown significantly since the pandemic. This dynamic environment has attracted international companies like Apple and AMD to India’s tech hubs. Internet users in India are projected to reach 900 million by 2025, up from 759 million in 2022, with rural adoption playing a major role in this growth and further supporting the expansion of the technology sector.
