article_content: Bitcoin's price has recently climbed to $35,000, marking its highest point in over a year. This latest surge is believed to be driven largely by institutional investors, particularly those like BlackRock, who are preparing their Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) in anticipation of regulatory approval for a spot Bitcoin ETF. BlackRock's application for a spot Bitcoin ETF, submitted in June, has heightened expectations on Wall Street that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) may soon approve this financial product. According to Charles Yu, a market analyst at Galaxy Digital, a spot Bitcoin ETF could enable access to Bitcoin for the U.S. wealth management industry, valued at $48.3 trillion. Yu estimates a spot Bitcoin ETF could increase Bitcoin's price by nearly 75% in a year, with potential inflows exceeding $14 billion. Looking ahead to April 2024, Bitcoin will undergo its pre-scheduled 'halving,' a 50% reduction in mining rewards that limits new supply. Historically, these halvings have triggered bullish cycles lasting 12 to 18 months. This timing also lines up with broad liquidity cycles and the U.S. presidential elections, both recurring every four years. The convergence of these factors could contribute to a significant bull run for Bitcoin. Despite ongoing regulatory scrutiny, sentiment in the market remains optimistic. Earlier in the month, a former BlackRock managing director predicted that SEC approval for a spot Bitcoin ETF could happen within months. Such a decision could open the market to trillions of dollars in managed assets. Given Bitcoin's fixed supply and limited availability on exchanges, increasing demand could lead to a supply crunch, as institutionally managed funds may not find enough available Bitcoin for even a 1% allocation. Positive regulatory developments, such as a recent federal appeals court ruling in favor of Grayscale Investments, have added to growing optimism about spot Bitcoin ETFs. Investors now question whether this is the beginning of a new bull market for Bitcoin. The combination of institutional interest, the upcoming halving, and potential regulatory approvals points in that direction. Denny Galindo, who wrote a report for Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, noted that a 50% price increase typically signals the market hitting bottom. With Bitcoin’s price nearly doubling in 2023, another upward move appears possible. In conclusion, the potential flood of institutional capital that a spot Bitcoin ETF could introduce underscores Bitcoin’s growing adoption within mainstream finance. If these factors align, a significant supply crunch could push Bitcoin prices to new all-time highs in 2024. However, investors should remember that these gains are unlikely to be smooth, and price volatility is to be expected.
translated_content: பிட்காய்னின் விலை சமீபத்தில் 35,000 அமெரிக்க டாலரைக் கடந்துள்ளது, இது கடந்த ஒரு வருடத்தில் மிக உயர்ந்த நிலையாகும். இந்த வளர்ச்சி பெரும்பாலும் நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களால், குறிப்பாக BlackRock போன்றவர்கள், ETF-களுக்கு எதிர்பார்க்கும் அனுமதி பெற தயாராகி இருப்பதால் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாக கருதப்படுகிறது. BlackRock கடந்த ஜூனில் ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETF-க்கு விண்ணப்பித்துள்ளது வால்ஸ்ட்ரீட்டில் எதிர்பார்ப்பை அதிகரித்துள்ளது; அமெரிக்க சேமிப்பு மற்றும் பரிவர்த்தனை ஆணையம் (SEC) விரைவில் இந்த நிதி சாதனத்தை ஒப்புதல் அளிக்கலாம் என்பதே பெரும்பாலும் எதிர்பார்ப்பு. Galaxy Digital நிறுவனத்தின் சந்தை நிபுணர் சார்ல்ஸ் யு, ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETF அமெரிக்க வள மேலாண்மை துறைக்குத் ($48.3 டிரில்லியன் மதிப்பில்) பிட்காய்னை திறக்க சாத்தியமுள்ளதாகக் கூறுகிறார். ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETF ஒரு வருடத்தில் பிட்காய்னின் விலையை சுமார் 75% அதிகரிக்கவும், $14 பில்லியன் முதலீட்டை ஈர்க்கவும் சாத்தியம் உள்ளது என யு மதிப்பிடுகிறார். வரும் 2024 ஏப்ரலில் பிட்காய்ன் திட்டமிட்டுள்ள ‘ஹால்விங்’ நிகழ்வை எதிர்கொள்கிறது; இது மைனிங் வெகுமதிகளை 50% குறைத்து, புதுவிதமான சொத்துக்களின் ஆதாயத்தை கட்டுப்படுத்தும். வரலாற்று ரீதியில், ஹால்விங் நிகழ்வுகள் 12-18 மாதங்கள் நீடிக்கும் எழுச்சி சூழலை உருவாக்கியுள்ளன. இந்த நிகழ்வு, திரவசமாக்கல் சுழற்சி மற்றும் நான்கு வருடங்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நடக்கும் அமெரிக்க அதிபர் தேர்தலுடன் இணைகிறது. அனைத்து காரணிகளும் சேரும்போது, பிட்காய்னுக்கு ஒரு பெரிய எழுச்சி வாய்ப்பு உருவாகலாம். சட்டப்பூர்வ கண்காணிப்பு தொடர்ந்தாலும், சந்தையின் மனநிலை ஆரோக்கியமாக உள்ளது. சமீபத்தில், முன்னாள் BlackRock மேலாளர் ஒருவர், ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETFக்கு SEC விரைவில் ஒப்புதல் அளிக்கலாம் என்று கணித்துள்ளார். இந்த முடிவு, டிரில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான மேலாண்மையில் உள்ள நிதிகளுக்கு பிட்காய்னை திறக்க ஈடுபடும். பிட்காய்னின் மொத்த வழங்கல் நிலையானது மற்றும் பரிமாற்றங்களில் கிடைக்கும் அளவு குறைவாக இருப்பதால், நிறுவன மேலாண்மை நிதிகள் 1% கூட பிட்காய்னுக்கு ஒதுக்க முடியாத சூழல் உருவாகலாம். Grayscale Investments இற்கு சமீபத்தில் கூட்டாட்சிநிலை மேன்முறையீட்டு நீதிமன்றத்தில் கிடைத்த நேர்மறை தீர்ப்பு போன்ற விதிகள், ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETFகளுக்கான நம்பிக்கையை மேலோங்க வைத்துள்ளது. முதலீட்டாளர்கள் இப்போது, பிட்காய்ன் புதிய பூல் மார்க்கெட்டின் தொடக்கத்திலா என்று கேள்விக்கொள்கிறார்கள். நிறுவன ஆர்வம், ஹால்விங், ஒப்புதல் வாய்ப்பு எல்லாம் ஒன்று சேர்வதால் அது சாத்தியம் எனத் தெரிகிறது. மோர்கன் ஸ்டான்லி தொகுப்பாளர் டென்னி கலிண்டோ, 50% விலை உயர்வு பங்கு விலையில்லாமல் போன நேரத்தில் சந்தை காணும் வளர்ச்சி என்று குறிப்பிட்டார். 2023-ல் பிட்காய்ன் விலை இரட்டிப்பாகியது, மேலும் ஒரு எழுச்சி சாத்தியம் உள்ளது. முடிவாக, ஸ்பாட் பிட்காய்ன் ETF மூலம் பெரும் நிறுவன முதலீட்டுகளை ஈர்த்து, பிட்காய்னை நவீன நிதித்துறையில் உயரத்தக்க வகையில் மாற்றும் வாய்ப்பு உள்ளது. இவை ஒருங்கிணைந்தால், 2024-இல் பிட்காய்ன் புதிய உச்சங்களை எட்டும் முடியலாம். எனினும், விலை வளர்ச்சி எப்போதும் நேரடியும் செம்மையுமாக இருக்காது; அதில் வேகம் மற்றும் மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்படலாம்.

article_content: Forbes’ 2023 billionaire list brings attention to Clemente Del Vecchio, who, at 19, has become the world’s youngest billionaire. He inherits a $3.9 billion fortune through a 12.5% share in Delfin, the holding company founded by his late father, Leonardo Del Vecchio, previously the chairman of eyewear giant EssilorLuxottica. Despite this wealth, Clemente maintains a private lifestyle, focusing on his education and showing a keen interest in science and technology. The family owns luxury homes in Italy, but Clemente keeps away from directly managing the business. Clemente's siblings actively participate in the family's ventures. His brother Claudio expanded Luxottica’s presence in the US, while another brother, Leonardo Maria, works in the eyewear segment. The Del Vecchio family’s journey began humbly, with Clemente’s grandfather working as a vegetable seller in Milan. While some billionaires are self-made and others inherit their fortune, today’s youngest billionaires are often driven innovators and entrepreneurs. Forbes’ roundup of youthful billionaires includes both heirs and self-starters. Clemente, Kim Jung-youn, and Kevin David Lehmann received significant stakes from family businesses, while Ryan Breslow and Gustav Magnar Witzoe pursued their own business ventures in areas like e-commerce and aquaculture. Kim Jung-youn and her sister Jung-min hold shares in Nexon, following their father’s legacy, and Kevin David Lehmann inherited an interest in dm, a top German drugstore chain. These billionaires hail from diverse countries, such as Italy, South Korea, Germany, and Norway, and their success stems from both family legacy and individual drive, inspiring future generations. Here are the top young billionaires on Forbes’ real-time list as of November 21, 2023:  1. Clemente Del Vecchio, 19 ($3.9B) 2. Kim Jung-youn, 19 ($1.3B) 3. Kevin David Lehmann, 21 ($2.5B) 4. article_content: A major hacking scandal has compromised the privacy of several female celebrities, with personal photos of figures like Jennifer Lawrence, Rihanna, Kim Kardashian, and Amber Heard leaked online. Legal teams representing many of these women are threatening Google with a $100 million lawsuit. They claim Google did not act decisively to remove explicit images and gained financially as the images continued to circulate. Marty Singer, a leading Hollywood lawyer, sent a letter to Google’s founders, accusing the company of profiting from the scandal instead of stopping it. Google responded by stating it removed tens of thousands of images quickly and closed hundreds of accounts after privacy complaints, reaffirming its dedication to privacy and condemning the breach. Some celebrities have approached the FBI, seeking stronger action from tech firms and law enforcement in response to the leaks. The incident has sparked renewed conversations about internet privacy and repeated attacks on the privacy of women—especially women of color—highlighting persistent problems with online safeguards. Several victims have experienced similar privacy violations in the past, such as Kim Kardashian’s sex tape leak and Vanessa Hudgens’ photo exposure. Companies like Google and Apple deny their systems were broadly compromised but urge users to maintain stricter security protocols. The event has led to widespread outrage, with victims and the public calling for accountability from both hackers and tech platforms to better protect individual privacy.

article_content: Shared Parenting: Two lionesses carefully groom one of their pride’s five cubs in Kenya’s Maasai Mara. Wildlife fans around the world are invited to vote for their favorite image to win the Wildlife Photographer of the Year People’s Choice Award. The selection features a mudskipper defending its territory, a monkey family posing for a Christmas card, and a young London fox rummaging through bins. A curated list of 25 images highlights the beauty of nature and the effects of human actions. These photographs were chosen by London’s Natural History Museum, organizers of the Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition. An international panel judged 49,957 entries from 95 countries. "Our judges can award only 100 winners each year, so the Natural History Museum selects 25 photos for the public to choose the People’s Choice Award winner," organizers stated. This year’s choices include an Adélie penguin meeting an emperor penguin and chick, and a striking photo of garments made from skins of endangered big cats. Douglas Gurr, the museum’s Director, said, "Wildlife Photographer of the Year’s People’s Choice Award always showcases amazing images. We invite everyone to vote. Whether you prefer beauty or impactful stories, the decision won’t be easy." Public voting is open online and at the exhibition in London, closing January 31, 2024. Winners will be announced in February 2024, joining the other 59th competition winners. The selected images will be exhibited until June 30, 2024. The annual event and touring exhibition use photography to share powerful stories from nature and encourage care for the planet. The 60th competition is open for entries until December 7 to photographers of all backgrounds. This year, entry fees are waived in over 100 countries and a new prize encourages uplifting stories of the natural world. Selected notable images include: - A mudskipper confronting a crab in Roebuck Bay, Australia. - A gelada mother caring for her young in Ethiopia’s Simien Mountains. - A red fox scavenging before collection day in London. - A grizzly bear fishing in British Columbia. - Mountain hares touching noses in Scotland. - Starling murmurations forming shapes over Rome. - A polar bear making a bed on ice in Svalbard, Norway. - An Adélie penguin with emperor penguins in Antarctica. - The rare Ethiopian wolf resting in Bale Mountains National Park. - Celebes crested macaques with plastic on Sulawesi beaches. - Pygmy bats at a termite nest in Costa Rica. - Cuckoo wasp entering a bee burrow in France. - Ducklings caught in a spring snow in New South Wales. - A fox cub with a shrew in Judean Foothills, Israel. - A snowshoe hare in Rocky Mountain National Park. - A lion cub approaching a camera in Kruger National Park. - Barn swallows over cornflowers in Germany. - Whale milk swirling in French Polynesia. - Balkan pond turtle and dragonfly in Jezreel Valley, Israel. - Moon jellyfish under aurora in Norway. - Autumn scenery on Cabriel River, Spain. - Rescued chimpanzee at a center in Guinea. - Bull elephant foraging in Sri Lanka garbage dump. - Confiscated coats made from skins of endangered big cats.
translated_content: பகிரப்பட்ட பெற்றோர்: இரு சிங்கிப்பற்கள், தங்கள் கூட்டத்தின் ஐந்தில் ஒருவரான குட்டியை கவனமாக பட்டம் போடுகின்றன - கென்யாவின் மாசாய் மாறா. உலகம் முழுவதும் உள்ள வனவிலங்குக் காதலர்கள் தங்களுக்குத் தொடர்புள்ள படத்திற்காக வாக்களித்து, Wildlife Photographer of the Year People’s Choice Award-ஐ வெல்ல அழைக்கப்படுகிறார்கள். தேர்வாக செய்யப்பட்ட புகைப்படங்களில், தன் பகுதியில் நண்டை எதிர்த்து நின்ற மட் ஸ்கிப்பர், கிரிஸ்துமஸ் கார்டுக்காக போஸ் கொடுக்கும் குரங்கு குடும்பம், லண்டனில் குப்பை மீது ஏறி உணவுக்காக தேடும் இளம் நரி ஆகியவை உள்ளன. இந்த 25 ஒளிப்படங்கள் இயற்கையின் அழகையும் மனிதர்களின் செயல்களின் விளைவையும் வெளிப்படுத்துகின்றன. இந்த புகைப்படங்கள் லண்டனின் இயற்கை வரலாறு அருங்காட்சியகத்தால் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்டன, அவர்கள் Wildlife Photographer of the Year போட்டியையும் நடத்துகின்றனர். சர்வதேச முடிவாயிற்றுப்பட்டி குழு 95 நாடுகளிலிருந்து வந்த 49,957 புகைப்படங்களை மதிப்பாய்வு செய்தது. "பல ஆண்டுகளாக எங்கள் நடுவர் குழு 100 வெற்றியாளர்களை மட்டுமே தேர்ந்தெடுப்பதால், மேலும் 25 படங்களை பொது மக்கள் தேர்வு செய்ய People’s Choice Award-க்கு வைத்துள்ளோம்," என்று அமைப்பாளர்கள் தெரிவித்தனர். இந்த வருட தேர்வுகளில் emperor penguin மற்றும் அதன் குட்டிக்கு அருகில் adélie penguin சென்றது, அபாயகரமான பெரிய பூனைகளின் தோலால் செய்யப்பட்ட ஆடை புகைப்படம் போன்றவை உள்ளன. இயற்கை வரலாறு அருங்காட்சியக இயக்குநர் டக்ளஸ் கர் கூறுகிறார்: "Wildlife Photographer of the Year People’s Choice Award எப்போதும் அற்புதமான ஓளிப்படங்களையே கொண்டுள்ளது. இப்போதும் அது மாறவில்லை. அனைவரும் வாக்களியுங்கள் - அது அழகு அல்லது கதையா, தேர்வு கடினமாக இருக்கும்." பொது வாக்கு எடுத்தல் ஆன்லைனிலும், லண்டன் அருங்காட்சியக நிகழ்ச்சியிலும் நடைபெறுகிறது; ஜனவரி 31, 2024-இல் முடிகிறது. வெற்றியாளர்கள் பிப்ரவரி 2024-இல் அறிவிக்கப்படுவார்கள், 59வது போட்டி வெற்றியாளர்களுடன் சேர்க்கப்படுவார்கள். People’s Choice Award படங்கள் ஜூன் 30, 2024 வரை கண்காட்சியில் இருக்கும். வருடந்தோறும் நடக்கும் போட்டியும், சுற்றும் ஒளித்தளம் கண்காட்சியும் இயற்கையின் வலிமையான கதைகளை வழங்கி, உலகத்துக்காக அக்கறையை ஊக்குவிக்கின்றது. 60வது போட்டிக்கும் போட்டியாளர்கள் டிசம்பர் 7 வரை படங்களை அனுப்பலாம். இந்த ஆண்டு 100க்கும் மேற்படும் நாடுகளுக்கு பதிவு கட்டணம் விலக்கு அளிக்கப்பட்டு, நம்பிக்கை தரும் கதைகளுக்காக புதிய பரிசு அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. தேரான முக்கியமான படங்கள்: - ரோய்பக் பே, ஆஸ்திரேலியாவில் நண்டுக்கு எதிராக மட் ஸ்கிப்பர். - எத்தியோப்பியா ஸிமியன் மலைகளில் சிறுவனை பராமரிக்கும் ஜெலடா தாயார். - லண்டனில் குப்பையை பார்க்கும் சிவப்பு நரி. - ப்ரிட்டிஷ் கொலம்பியாவில் சாம்பல் பிடிக்கும் கரடி. - ஸ்காட்லாந்தில் மூடியில் தொடும் மேட்டுமுயல்கள். - ரோமில் பறக்கும் ஸ்டார்லிங்களின் மெருகிப்பார்வை. - ஸ்வால்பார்ட், நார்வேயில் பனியில் படுக்கை செய்த பனிப்புலி. - அண்டார்டிகாவில் emperor penguin மற்றும் தன் குட்டியுடன் முன்னேறும் adélie penguin. - Bale தேசிய பூங்காவில் ஓய்வு எடுத்த எத்தியோப்பிய இயற்கை நாய். - சுலாவேசியில் பிளாஸ்டிக் பாட்டில்களை ஆராயும் Celebes crested macaques. - கோஸ்டா ரிகாவில் டெர்மைட் கூடு அருகே போன பீக்மி பேட். - பிரான்சில் வீட்டு தேனீ உடைகளில் புகுந்த கூகூ wasp. - நியூ சவுத் வேல்ஸ் பனிக்காலத்தில் சிக்கிய வாத்துக்குட்டிகள். - ஜூடியா மேட்டுக்களில் ஷுருவை பார்த்த நரி குட்டி. - அரக்கு மவுன்டன் தேசிய பூங்காவில் சறுக்கழுகு முயல். - கிரூகர் தேசிய பூங்காவில் கேமரா நோக்கும் சிங்கக் குட்டி. - ஜெர்மனியிலுள்ள கார்ன்ப்ளவர் பசுமை மேடையில் பறக்கும் barn swallow. - பிரெஞ்சு போலினேசியா கடலில் கலந்த தாய்ப்பாலுடன் சுழலும் வால்பூன். - இச்ரேல் ஜெஸ்ரியல் பள்ளத்தாக்கில் pond ஆமை மற்றும் டிராகன் பிழை. - அரோரா வெளிச்சத்தில் நார்வேயின் moon jellyfish. - ஸ்பெயின் Cabriel நதி அருகில் படைப்பாற்றல் அமைப்பில் புல்வகைகள். - கினியா சிம்பான்சி பாதுகாப்பு மையத்தில் மீட்கப்பட்ட சிம்பான்சி. - இலங்கையில் குப்பைத் தொட்டியில் உணவு தேடும் மாடு யானை. - ஐரோப்பிய அதிகாரிகள் பறிமுதல் செய்த அபாயகரமான பெரிய பூனைகளின் தோலாடைகள்.

article_content: Hollywood actors Robert Pattinson and Suki Waterhouse are preparing to welcome their first child together. Waterhouse, who is also a singer-songwriter, delighted fans at the Corona Capital Festival in Mexico by publicly revealing her pregnancy on stage. Wearing a shimmering pink minidress and a feathery jacket, she surprised the crowd by opening her coat to show her baby bump. Videos shared online captured Waterhouse joking, 'I'm extra sparkly today because I thought it might distract you from something else that's happening.' She playfully added, 'I'm not sure if it's working,' before starting her set. Reports from People magazine state that Pattinson, 37, and Waterhouse, 31, have been in a relationship since 2018. Elsewhere, the Indian government is considering moving unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds to the Consolidated Fund of India; Apple plans to produce ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India this financial year; and Nawaz Modi, separated from industrialist Gautam Singhania, is seeking a significant share of his assets for herself and their two daughters.

article_content: Cryptocurrency exchange founders are facing considerable regulatory and financial challenges in 2023. According to a Bloomberg report on Friday, Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao has lost $12 billion this year due to a decline in Binance’s trading volumes. Meanwhile, the Winklevoss twins’ exchange, Gemini, is suing their former partner, Genesis, seeking $1.6 billion in Grayscale Bitcoin Trust shares, as reported by CoinDesk. The overall environment for running a cryptocurrency exchange remains turbulent, with customer trading activity significantly reduced. Data from The Block indicates that Binance’s trading volume has dropped by over 30% this year, and industry-wide trading volumes have fallen 90% since their peak in May 2021. Binance did not immediately respond to Gizmodo’s request for comment. Amid these difficulties, Gemini’s lawsuit against Genesis follows an earlier lawsuit by Attorney General Letitia James accusing both companies of defrauding New Yorkers. Genesis, which filed for bankruptcy in January, is working to repay creditors. In a press statement, Gemini accused Genesis of attempting to divert Grayscale Bitcoin Trust value away from Gemini Earn users to other creditors, claiming every Earn user can be made whole with this value. Legal disputes, diminished trading activity, and substantial personal losses have become commonplace for cryptocurrency exchanges. Binance, in particular, is confronting a series of regulatory actions, including a lawsuit from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which it has called 'incendiary.' Additionally, Forbes estimates the Winklevoss twins have lost more than $4 billion combined during the industry’s downturn. Fresh off his record-equaling 49th ODI century against South Africa in Kolkata, Virat Kohli was seen traveling to Bengaluru on an IndiGo flight. A video circulating online showed the cricket icon in economy class, sitting away from the window and wearing a face mask. Fans took to social media, expressing surprise and admiration for Kohli’s down-to-earth choice, while some envied the fellow passenger next to him.

Kohli's latest century came on his 35th birthday, putting him alongside Sachin Tendulkar at the top of the ODI century list. In a video message from BCCI, Kohli expressed his disbelief at reaching this milestone and reiterated his respect for Tendulkar, saying the 'Master Blaster' would always be number one in his mind. Throughout this World Cup, Kohli has scored 543 runs at an average of 108.60, making this his second century in the tournament and his fourth in 50-over World Cups overall.

Reacting to Kohli's achievement, Sachin Tendulkar congratulated him on social media, wishing he would soon move from 49 to 50 centuries. Interestingly, earlier this year, actress Deepika Padukone was also spotted by fans flying economy on IndiGo.

Having already secured their place in the semi-finals, India is set to face the Netherlands in Bengaluru on November 12.

article_content: The number of UK households with four or more cars has risen by 51% to nearly half a million over the last decade. This increase is partly driven by more women entering the workforce and grown-up children staying at home. According to an RAC Foundation analysis of the 2011 census for the Daily Mail, families with four or more cars now account for almost 1 in 50 households. The RAC Foundation states this rise highlights the growing reliance on cars, especially as families face higher train fares and cuts to local and rural bus services. The number of households with three cars has increased by almost a third (31.5%), while two-car families have risen by 13%. Overall, households with two or more cars are up nearly a fifth (18%), whereas those with none or just one car have increased by less than 4%. A further breakdown shows that the proportion of households with no car has actually fallen by 4.5%, and those with just one car have dropped by 3.6%. Although multi-car households are most common in wealthier areas of southern England, the fastest increase has occurred in less affluent or more rural areas in the North and Wales. These regions have also seen significant growth in women drivers in recent years. The RAC Foundation compared 2001 and 2011 census figures and found about 7.5 million households in England and Wales now own two or more cars or vans—almost one in three (32%), up 18% from 6.37 million a decade before. Households with two cars have increased 13.3% to nearly 5.78 million, three-car families by 31.5% to 1.28 million, and four or more by 51.3% to 453,190. Across England and Wales, 74% of all households now have at least one car or van, though there are large regional differences. Most London boroughs have experienced significant drops in car and van ownership—Hackney, for example, saw a 24% decline to 170 cars per 1,000 people—while Shropshire has seen a 55% rise to 604 vehicles per 1,000 people. In the past 15 years, nearly 2.6 million more women have obtained driving licenses, almost double the number for men, who rose by 1.4 million. Professor Stephen Glaister, RAC Foundation director, observed: 'More women are working than ever, and it's the car that helps them get around.'

Authorities in the UK are currently investigating allegations that extremist groups may be exerting undue influence in several state schools across Birmingham. Khalid Mahmood, the local Member of Parliament, has voiced his concerns that Muslim students could be susceptible to indoctrination in these institutions. The expanding inquiry now involves over a dozen schools, following reports that non-Muslim staff members have been marginalized, halal food has been mandated in cafeterias, and sex education has been discontinued in certain cases.

The controversy began after the disclosure of a letter that allegedly detailed a 'Trojan Horse' strategy to influence school leadership, though the legitimacy of the document remains in question. Among the schools under scrutiny, Park View Academy was recently rated 'inadequate' by inspectors, with the decline reportedly linked to extremist involvement. Similarly, the head of Saltley School, who is not Muslim, has stated that he was forced to resign from his position.

Education Secretary Michael Gove is said to be personally overseeing the investigation, with officials from the Department for Education reviewing records and interviewing staff members at numerous schools. Mahmood, who also chairs the Tackling Terrorism All-Party Parliamentary Group, has called for a thorough, impartial review and expressed concerns that ultra-conservative ideas, associated with the Salafi group, may be influencing school practices—even though most pupils come from mainstream Sunni backgrounds.

Mahmood has welcomed the engagement of both the Department for Education and Ofsted in investigating the matter. He suggested that previous reluctance to intervene stemmed from fears of being labelled racist or anti-Islamic. Emphasizing that these are not religious schools, he highlighted worries about the treatment of non-Muslim staff and possible consequences for the students.

article_content: A common challenge with many electric scooters is their substantial weight, often over 35 pounds, which makes carrying and storing them difficult. A developer once noted that while lighter scooters are portable, they sometimes sacrifice stability. Interested in a balance of both, I tested NIU Technologies' new KQi Air electric kick scooter, constructed of 70% carbon fiber and 30% magnesium, and weighing just 26.2 pounds. NIU, also known for their e-bikes, touts the KQi Air as combining excellent power and portability for city commutes. Its specs include a 20 mph top speed, a 31-mile range, and up to 700 watts of power. The scooter can handle climbs on steep 20% grade hills. The carbon fiber frame, a material popular in high-performance cars and sports equipment, is evident in the handlebar weave. The scooter’s lithium-ion battery charges fully in five hours, and a left-hand lever operates dual-action aluminum alloy brakes for consistent stopping. The 9.5-inch tubeless tires provide extra grip. Additional features are cruise control, a headlight, individual left and right turn signal buttons, and five riding modes: sport, dynamic, e-save, cruise, and pedestrian. Assembly is simple, requiring six screws (with provided tools) to attach the handlebar to the neck—taking only minutes. The deck is a bit smaller than some other scooters, but the big difference is how effortless it is to lift and carry. The display is bright, displaying speed in miles per hour by default, though settings can be customized in an optional app. Riding the KQi Air, acceleration is smooth, but the low weight does make it feel somewhat wobbly at higher speeds, echoing prior warnings about ultra-light scooters. Climbing steep hills feels easy, and after adapting to the initially sensitive brakes, stopping became easier. Overall, the KQi Air excels for those seeking a lightweight, fast, and convenient scooter. It currently sells for $949, with an eventual retail price of $1,400.

article_content: India’s non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) are projected to record moderate growth of 16-18% this fiscal, as stated by Crisil Ratings. This outlook is influenced by the Reserve Bank of India’s recent move to tighten rules on unsecured retail loans, which had previously driven swift expansion. For the next fiscal year, Crisil predicts NBFCs’ assets under management (AUM) will grow by 14-17%, slightly less than this year, as lenders adapt to new regulations. Diversifying their product lines and funding sources will be critical for sustainable future growth, according to the report. Retail lending continues to thrive thanks to strong consumer demand for homes, vehicles, and durable goods. Crisil points out that NBFCs, supported by solid balance sheets, are well-positioned to capture this demand. Crisil Ratings managing director Gurpreet Chhatwal noted that the new regulatory measures primarily target unsecured loans and have minimal effect on secured segments such as home and vehicle finance. Housing finance companies (HFCs) remain unaffected by these changes. Home loans and vehicle financing each now make up roughly 25-27% of NBFC portfolios, and both sectors are expected to witness consistent growth. Crisil projects 12-14% growth in home loans next year, fueled by affordable housing initiatives, and expects vehicle loans to grow by 18-19% this year and 17-18% next year, spurred by solid underlying asset sales. Although unsecured loans have become the third-largest area for NBFCs, this segment will likely see slower growth ahead due to regulatory changes that impact both assets and liabilities. Crisil also estimates that borrowing costs for NBFCs from banks could rise by 25-50 basis points, though the extent will depend on each NBFC’s dependence on bank credit.

article_content: Sarah Palin’s surge to national prominence happened when John McCain picked her as his vice-presidential candidate in 2008. Prior to the August 29 announcement, she was relatively unknown outside Alaska, but within the state, she was celebrated as a reformer who challenged oil companies, collaborated across party lines, and introduced significant policy reforms, earning notably high approval ratings. Her move onto the national stage, however, marked the downturn of her popularity. The national media, knowing little of her, focused on rumors and speculation instead of her achievements, leading to a shift in her image from a pragmatic leader to a divisive social conservative. Throughout the 2008 campaign and beyond, intense scrutiny continued. Palin faced 18 ethics complaints (all dismissed) and received over 150 information requests, resulting in personal and financial stress. The public spotlight expanded to her family, with her teenage daughter becoming the subject of talk show jokes and her grandchild’s father openly discussing family matters. Political support in Alaska also waned, and some members of McCain’s own campaign staff leaked negative stories. By July the next year, her approval had dropped to the mid-50s percentile. In response to the ongoing challenges, Palin announced she would step down as governor effective July 26, 2009. This decision allowed her to leave behind the restrictions of office and continuous criticism, giving her the freedom to pursue new opportunities and defend her family. According to this source, Apple may introduce a graphene thermal system, which would significantly improve heat management due to graphene's high thermal conductivity—four times greater than that of copper. Additionally, the Pro series could feature a new battery with a metal shell for better heat dispersion. Reports from sources like MacRumors suggest Apple has been developing such technologies for some time, filing relevant patents ahead of these potential changes. While most overheating issues in the iPhone 15 have been largely addressed through software, any further hardware improvements aimed at maintaining device temperature would likely be welcomed by users.

article_content: In the past two months, several major airline incidents have occurred in the United States. On February 12, Continental Airlines Flight 3407 crashed while approaching Buffalo, New York, resulting in the deaths of 49 people. Earlier, on January 27, Empire Airlines Flight 8284 crashed 300 feet short of the runway during its approach to Lubbock International Airport in Texas after departing from Fort Worth. The aircraft was destroyed by the crash and subsequent fire, but both crew members suffered only minor injuries. On January 15, US Airways Flight 1549 made an emergency landing in the Hudson River while en route from LaGuardia Airport to Charlotte, North Carolina. All 155 people on board survived, with only minor injuries reported. On December 20, 2008, Continental Flight 1404 veered off the runway during takeoff from Denver International Airport, while heading to Houston. Thirty-eight passengers and crew were taken to hospitals, and five were admitted. Although there were no fatalities, the aircraft was heavily damaged and experienced a fire on the right side after the crash. CNN's Mike Ahlers contributed to this report.

article_content: Steve Ells, founder of Chipotle, has sold his four-bedroom townhouse in Manhattan's West Village for $11.4 million to music executive Lyor Cohen. Cohen, who previously dated designer Tory Burch, had rented the property for a year before purchasing it at a price reduced from its original $16.5 million listing. The 4,400-square-foot townhouse, built in 1898 in a Greek Revival style, features four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and a backyard terrace. The front brick façade adds historic appeal, while the back boasts modern floor-to-ceiling glass windows overlooking a grassy yard. Inside, the home is decorated with contemporary and post-modern furnishings, including pieces by Jonathan Adler and Ligne Roset, and features Andy Warhol flower prints. Multiple living spaces and a mid-century-style kitchen provide ample room, with each area offering views of the garden terrace. Ells bought the townhouse in 2008 for $13,425,000. It is unclear whether he ever lived there, as he also owns a Fifth Avenue penthouse and previously owned a West Village loft, purchased in 2008 for $5.753 million and sold in 2011 for $6.1 million. article_content: Labour leader Ed Miliband, whose parents were immigrants, has promised stricter immigration laws if his party wins the next general election. Campaigning with Labour’s Naushabah Khan in Rochester and Strood, Miliband praised immigrants’ positive impact but emphasized tightening rules to prevent abuses. Labour’s proposed legislation, which would be introduced immediately if they form the next government, includes enhanced border controls and a requirement for public sector workers to speak English. Businesses hiring employees from outside the EU would need to offer apprenticeships, and new laws would stop companies from using foreign workers to unfairly reduce wages. Recruitment agencies would also be banned from hiring only from abroad, and systematic checks would return at the borders. Miliband stressed that he would avoid unrealistic pledges on immigration. He committed to reforming EU regulations, such as extending the waiting time for benefit eligibility for newcomers, restricting child benefits for families living outside the UK, and calling for stricter controls when new EU countries join. The campaign ahead of the Rochester and Strood by-election is intense, particularly after Conservative MP Mark Reckless defected to UKIP. Recent polling suggests Reckless, now running for UKIP, leads; the Conservatives are polling second, and Labour is in third. Miliband urged core Labour supporters to remain loyal rather than shifting to UKIP, presenting Labour as the party for practical, meaningful change for working families. Meanwhile, both UKIP and the Conservatives criticized Labour’s past immigration policies and questioned the strength of Miliband’s new measures.

article_content: With Alabama reopening parts of its coastal waters and the fall shrimping season underway in the Gulf of Mexico, the National Resources Defense Council (NRDC) is urging enhanced safety measures for seafood from the region. The NRDC, backed by nearly two dozen coastal groups, has formally requested that the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) require comprehensive seafood contamination tests, share all data transparently, and prioritize protections for vulnerable populations, such as children, pregnant women, and subsistence fishers. Dr. Gina Solomon, a senior scientist at NRDC, emphasized the urgency of seafood safety now that fishing areas are reopening, underscoring the need for rigorous standards to ensure long-term food safety in the Gulf. Government officials, including Vice President Joe Biden and NOAA's chief fisheries scientist Steve Murawski, have insisted that Gulf waters will be reopened to fishing only when seafood meets strict safety and edibility criteria after the Deepwater Horizon oil spill. The disaster inflicted major harm on the Gulf's seafood industry and led to widespread fishing bans. Though some waters are once again open, fishermen like Louisiana's Anthony Bourgeoif are worried. He reports that only areas with small shrimp have reopened, leaving more profitable fishing grounds off-limits. Bourgeoif, struggling financially since the BP spill, is concerned about finding oil in his catch and potentially having to dispose of it, putting further pressure on his livelihood. Meanwhile, many shrimpers continue to assist BP by skimming oil and installing protective booms, as the full effects of the spill are still being assessed. Deborah Long of the Southern Shrimp Alliance notes it may take days to determine the overall impact on the shrimp catch. Contradicting a government report that claimed most oil is gone, a new University of Georgia study estimates 70–79% of the oil remains in the Gulf, posing ongoing risks to the ecosystem. The University of South Florida found oil had settled farther east and deeper than previously thought, and marine organisms showed toxic responses to this contamination. Researchers warn that dispersants used during the cleanup drove oil into deeper waters, where it now affects critical lower-level marine life. Experts also highlight that official estimates may undercount dissolved oil and gases like methane, which remain in the environment. The Deepwater Horizon oil spill began with an explosion on April 20, 2010, and millions of barrels of oil leaked until a temporary cap was placed on July 15. Efforts to permanently seal the well are ongoing, with federal coordinator Thad Allen stressing that safety is the top priority. Final sealing operations, such as 'bottom kill,' will proceed only after thorough technical review of pressure-related risks.

article_content: Luis Suarez has expressed his belief that Steven Gerrard should stay at Liverpool for his entire career, considering the club an essential part of Gerrard's life. Although Gerrard has faced speculation about transfers since his debut in 1998, it now appears unlikely that he will leave Liverpool as his career winds down. Suarez, who played with Gerrard for almost three years before transferring to Barcelona last summer, has shared how much Gerrard influenced him at Liverpool. Suarez explained that Gerrard's passion and loyalty to the club were central reasons he remained with Liverpool for an additional season—a year in which he scored 31 Premier League goals and helped secure a second-place league finish. The Uruguayan striker stated that it would be perfect for both Gerrard and Liverpool supporters if Gerrard were to end his career at Anfield, arguing that such a strong connection should never be broken. Suarez also commented that Gerrard's dedication to Liverpool is so deep, he would only contemplate leaving if the club did not want him. Gerrard’s leadership and devotion clearly left a significant mark on Suarez during their time together.

Jason Mullaney, a former Navy SEAL, faces up to 12 years in prison for defrauding 11 former teammates and a close friend out of $1.2 million. Through his scheme, Mullaney convinced his fellow servicemen to invest in Trident Global Financial Holdings, a business he claimed would support small loans but was actually a front for his own personal spending. He used the money to buy luxury items like a Mercedes Benz, a mansion, and to fund high-stakes gambling in Las Vegas.

The court in San Diego heard disturbing allegations that Mullaney physically assaulted one investor who demanded repayment, including beating him with a gun, tying him up, and allegedly severing a finger. However, no charges were filed in connection with this alleged assault.

Mullaney, who served with SEAL Team Five until 2003, invoked a sense of military brotherhood by naming his scheme 'Trident,' after the Navy SEAL insignia. He promised investors high returns, claiming they would get back their investments plus a 24% profit within a year, but none of the funds were returned. As a result, many investors suffered deep financial losses and personal hardships.

Several victims described their sense of betrayal and anger in court, with one calling Mullaney 'the most repugnant scum on Earth.' SEAL veterans Alexander Sonnenberg and Kevin Blackwell spoke out about their experiences, saying Mullaney manipulated their trust and prioritized his own gain over their well-being.

The emotional impact of the scam was severe, with investor Steven Elias forced to re-enlist in the military to recover from his losses, all while coping with family tragedies.

Mullaney pled guilty to four counts of fraud but later attempted to revoke his plea and has shown little remorse, according to court reports. His sentencing is scheduled for March 17.

சான் டியாகோ நீதிமன்றத்தில், 'Trident' என்ற நாடு இராணுவ சின்னத்தின் பெயரை வைத்து, இராணுவ சகோதரத்துவ உணர்வை பயன்படுத்தி ஏமாற்றம் செய்ததாகவும், ஒரு முதலீட்டாளரிடம் கடனை கேட்க வரும்போது அவரை துப்பாக்கியால் அடித்தும், கட்டியும், விரலை வெட்டி விட்டதாகவும் குற்றச்சாட்டு முன்வைக்கப்பட்டது. இதில் குற்றப்பத்திரிக்கை பதிவு செய்யப்படவில்லை.

SEAL Team Five-ல் 2003 வரை சேவை செய்த மலனி, முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு உயர்ந்த லாப விகிதம் மற்றும் 12 மாதங்களில் முதலீடு திரும்ப வரும் என்று கூறினார். ஆனால் எவரும் தங்கள் பணத்தை திரும்ப பெறவில்லை. பலரை கடுவான நிதி இழப்பு மற்றும் மனத்துன்பங்களால் பாதித்தது.

பதிவிட்டவர்கள் நீதி மன்றத்தில் தங்கள் அதிகமான ஏமாற்றத்தையும் கோபத்தையும் வெளிப்படுத்தினர். ஒருவரும் 'மிகக் கெட்டவனாக' மலனியை குறிப்பிட, முன்னாள் நேவி சீல் உறுப்பினர்கள் அலெக்சாண்டர் சோன்னென்பெர்க், கேவின் பிளாக்வெல் ஆகியோரும் அவருக்கு எதிராகக் கருத்து தெரிவித்தனர்.

முதலீட்டாளர் ஸ்டீவன் எலியாஸ் தன்னுடைய இழப்பை சமாளிக்க மறுபடியும் ராணுவத்தில் சேர வேண்டியதாகும், குடும்பத்தில் தற்போதைய இழப்புகளையும் சந்தித்திருந்தார்.

மலனி மோசடி குற்றவாளி என ஒப்புக்கொண்டதும், பின்னர் விசாரணையை திரும்பிக்கொள்ள முயற்சி செய்ததும், இரங்கல் காட்டவில்லை என்றும், அவரது தண்டனை மார்ச் 17 அன்று சொல்லப்படும் என நீதிமன்ற அறிக்கைகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.
